zh: 晚餐吃完了，{name}張開嘴巴。啊——咦？牙齒上有小小的糖糖蟲在開派對！
{name}拿起牙刷，像拿起一支小掃把。刷刷刷，前面的牙齒，轉小圈圈。
刷刷刷，後面的牙齒，也轉小圈圈。糖糖蟲一隻一隻溜走了。
爸爸說：「換我幫忙掃角落。」最裡面的牙齒也亮晶晶。
{name}對著鏡子笑一笑。牙齒白白的，好像小星星。晚安，乾淨的牙齒！
en: Dinner is done, and {name} opens wide. Ahh, oh! Tiny sugar bugs are having a party on the teeth!
{name} picks up the toothbrush like a little broom. Swish, swish, the front teeth, in tiny circles.
Swish, swish, the back teeth, in tiny circles too. One by one, the sugar bugs slip away.
"My turn to sweep the corners," says Dad. Now even the very back teeth sparkle.
{name} smiles in the mirror. The teeth shine like little stars. Goodnight, clean teeth!

questions: {name}用牙刷掃把把糖糖蟲趕走了，你最想先刷哪一顆牙？
刷完牙以後，嘴巴感覺怎麼樣？
zh.tip: 今晚刷牙時，一起唱一首短短的刷牙歌，唱完換爸媽幫忙「掃角落」。

questions: {name} swept the sugar bugs away. Which tooth do you want to brush first?
How does your mouth feel after brushing?
en.tip: Tonight, sing a short brushing song together, then take your turn to "sweep the corners" for your child.

zh: 天黑了，窗外的天空變成深深的藍色。{name}抱著軟軟的枕頭，看見一朵小雲朵飄呀飄，飄到窗戶前面。「你好，小雲朵。」{name}輕輕地說。
小雲朵打了一個大大的呵欠：「呼——我好睏，可是我不知道要睡在哪裡。」{name}想了想，說：「我們一起找一找吧。」
{name}和小雲朵先去問月亮。月亮笑咪咪地說：「我要整晚亮亮的，照著大家回家。你可以在我旁邊休息一下。」小雲朵靠一靠，可是月亮太亮了，眼睛閉不起來。
{name}和小雲朵又去問星星。星星一閃、一閃、又一閃：「我們要眨眼睛，跟大家說晚安。」小雲朵也眨呀眨，眨得頭都暈了，還是睡不著。
{name}拍拍{his}被子：「小雲朵，你看，被子軟軟的，就像你一樣。」小雲朵慢慢飄下來，變得好小好小，像一團白白的棉花。
{he}把小雲朵放在枕頭旁邊。風輕輕吹，呼——呼——；蟲兒輕輕唱，唧——唧——。小雲朵蹭了蹭{him}，呼吸也慢了下來。
「晚安，月亮。晚安，星星。晚安，小雲朵。」{name}小聲地說。媽媽走進來，親了親{name}的額頭。窗外的天空靜悄悄，{name}也慢慢閉上眼睛，睡著了。
en: It is getting dark, and the sky outside turns deep, deep blue. {name} hugs a soft pillow and sees a little cloud drifting, drifting, all the way to the window. "Hello, Little Cloud," {name} whispers.
Little Cloud gives a big, big yawn. "Hoo-oo... I'm so sleepy, but I don't know where to sleep." {name} thinks for a moment. "Let's look together."

First, {name} and Little Cloud ask the moon. The moon smiles. "I shine all night to light the way home. You can rest beside me." Little Cloud snuggles close, but the moon is too bright for sleepy eyes.

Next, {name} and Little Cloud ask the stars. Twinkle, twinkle, twinkle. "We blink to say goodnight to everyone," the stars sing. Little Cloud blinks and blinks until it feels dizzy, but it still can't sleep.
{name} pats {his} blanket. "Look, Little Cloud. My blanket is soft, just like you." Little Cloud floats down slowly and grows small, small, small, like a fluffy ball of cotton.
{he} tucks Little Cloud beside the pillow. The wind sighs, whoo, whoo. The crickets sing, chirp, chirp. Little Cloud nuzzles {him} and breathes slow and soft.

"Sleep well, bright moon. Sleep well, little stars. Sleep well, Little Cloud," {name} whispers. Mom comes in and kisses {name} on the forehead. The sky outside is quiet now, and {name} closes {his} eyes and falls asleep.

zh: 星期六早上，{name}和奶奶到森林裡散步。陽光從樹葉之間灑下來，地上一閃一閃的。走到一棵大橡樹下，{name}撿到一片大葉子，上面用細細的樹枝刻著彎彎的小路、三個記號，還有一個小小的叉叉。
「這是藏寶圖嗎？」{name}興奮地問。奶奶戴上眼鏡看了看：「看起來是有人很用心畫的。我們跟著走走看，可是要走在步道上，而且要一直待在奶奶看得到的地方。」{name}用力點點頭，把地圖拿得穩穩的。
第一個記號是一根空心的木頭。{name}對著洞口喊：「哈囉——」木頭裡傳回來：「哈囉——哈囉——」原來是回音！木頭旁邊的泥土上，有一排小小的腳印一路往前跑，好像在說：「這邊、這邊。」
第二個記號是一條小溪。溪上有一座木頭小橋，{name}牽著奶奶的手慢慢走過去，橋下的水嘩啦嘩啦地唱歌。橋的另一邊，三顆圓圓的橡實排成一個箭頭，指向一塊長滿青苔的大石頭。
第三個記號就是那塊大石頭。{name}蹲下來仔細看，石頭後面有一隻小松鼠，尾巴縮成一團，正在發抖，旁邊放著一小堆橡實。{name}想起地圖上的叉叉，忽然明白了：「這不是藏寶圖，是小松鼠回家的地圖！」
奶奶小聲說：「牠可能迷路了，又把地圖弄掉了。」{name}把葉子地圖輕輕放在小松鼠面前，再退後兩步，安安靜靜地等。小松鼠聞一聞地圖，抬頭看了{him}一眼，叼起一顆橡實，咻地爬上旁邊的大樹，正是叉叉畫的地方。
樹洞裡探出兩顆小腦袋，吱吱吱地叫個不停，好像在開歡迎會。{name}和奶奶相視一笑。回家的路上，{name}撿起一片新的葉子：「下次我也要畫一張地圖，送給下一個迷路的朋友。」奶奶摸摸{his}頭：「那一定是最棒的寶藏。」
en: On Saturday morning, {name} and Grandma went for a walk in the forest. Sunlight sprinkled through the leaves and made the ground sparkle. Under a big oak tree, {name} found a wide leaf with a map scratched onto it: a twisty path, three little marks, and a tiny X.

"Is this a treasure map?" {name} asked. Grandma put on her glasses. "Someone worked hard on this. Let's follow it, but we stay on the trail, and you stay where I can see you." {name} nodded and held the map steady.

The first mark was a hollow log. {name} leaned close and called, "Hello-o!" The log called back, "Hello-o... hello-o..." An echo! In the mud beside it, a row of tiny footprints raced ahead, as if saying, "This way, this way."

The second mark was a little stream with a wooden bridge. {name} held Grandma's hand and crossed slowly while the water splashed and sang below. On the other side, three round acorns lay in a row, shaped like an arrow pointing to a big, mossy rock.

The third mark was the rock itself. {name} crouched down for a closer look. Behind it sat a small squirrel, its tail curled tight, shivering beside a little pile of acorns. {name} thought of the X and suddenly understood. "It's not a treasure map. It's a map home!"

"It must have gotten lost and dropped its map," Grandma said softly. {name} set the leaf gently in front of the squirrel, took two steps back, and waited quietly. The squirrel sniffed the map, glanced up at {him}, grabbed an acorn, and zipped up the nearest tree, right where the X was drawn.

Two tiny heads popped out of a hole in the tree, chattering like a welcome-home party. {name} and Grandma smiled at each other. On the way home, {name} picked up a fresh leaf. "Next time, I'll draw a map too, for the next friend who gets lost." Grandma patted {his} head. "That will be the best treasure of all."

title.en: {name} and Glimmer Say Goodnight to the Moon

zh: 夜晚來了，天空藍藍的，好安靜。窗外的月亮圓圓的、亮亮的，可是旁邊一顆星星也沒有。{name}趴在窗邊，輕輕說：「月亮好像有一點寂寞。」一隻螢火蟲飛過來，打了個小呵欠，牠叫小光。小光的尾巴一閃一閃，好像在說：我們去陪月亮吧。
奶奶拿出一盞小小的紙燈籠，裡面亮著暖暖的光。她把燈籠放進{his}小手裡。「我們一起去小山上，跟月亮說晚安。」小光停在燈籠上，奶奶牽著{name}另一隻手。走出家門，夜風涼涼的，草地軟軟的，腳步沙沙、沙沙。蟋蟀在草叢裡唱：唧唧、唧唧。
走到小山腳下，一隻貓頭鷹在樹上叫：咕咕、咕咕。「你們要去哪裡呀？」{name}舉起燈籠說：「我們要去跟月亮說晚安。」貓頭鷹點點頭，眨眨大眼睛。牠說：「我也請你們幫我跟月亮說晚安。」抬頭一看，天上亮起了第一顆星星，一閃、一閃，好像在微笑。
他們慢慢往上走。路邊的小花都閉上眼睛了。一隻小兔子在洞口揉揉眼睛，{name}小聲說：「小兔子，晚安。」小兔子動動耳朵，鑽回窩裡。天上又亮起兩顆星星，一閃、一閃，三顆星星排在月亮旁邊。小光的光也變得慢慢的，牠又打了個小呵欠。
快到山頂了，{his}小腳有一點累。奶奶說：「我們休息一下，數數星星吧。」他們坐在軟軟的草地上，燈籠放在中間，暖暖亮亮。一顆、兩顆、三顆……{name}數著數著，天上又亮起好多星星，四顆、五顆、六顆。月亮好像笑了，光變得更柔和了。休息好了，大家再往上走。
終於到了山頂。月亮好大、好近，靜靜地掛在天上。{name}舉起小燈籠，輕輕揮一揮：「月亮，晚安。」小光也亮一亮：「月亮，晚安。」奶奶也小聲說：「月亮，晚安。」這時候，滿天的星星一顆接一顆亮起來，一閃、一閃，把月亮圍得暖暖的。月亮不寂寞了。
回家的路上，夜好安靜。蟋蟀不唱了，貓頭鷹也閉上眼睛。小光停在{his}手指上，睡著了，尾巴的光暗暗的。回到家，奶奶把燈籠放在窗邊，親親{name}。{name}躺進軟軟的被窩，看見月亮和星星在窗外輕輕地眨眼睛。晚安，月亮；晚安，星星；晚安，{name}。
en: Night came, blue and quiet. Outside the window, the moon was round and bright, but not one star was near it. {name} leaned on the windowsill and whispered, "The moon looks a little lonely." A sleepy firefly named Glimmer drifted by and yawned. Blink, blink went its glow: "Let's go keep the moon company."

Grandma brought out a tiny paper lantern with a warm light inside. She placed it in {his} hands. "Let's walk up the little hill and say goodnight to the moon." Glimmer settled on the lantern. Grandma held {his} other hand. The grass was soft. Swish, swish went their feet. Chirp, chirp sang the crickets.

At the bottom of the hill, an owl called from a tree. Hoo, hoo. "Where are you going?" {name} lifted the lantern. "We're going to say goodnight to the moon." The owl blinked its big eyes. "Please say goodnight for me, too." Then the first star switched on. Twinkle, twinkle. It seemed to smile.

Slowly, they climbed higher. The flowers by the path had closed their eyes. A bunny rubbed its eyes by its burrow. "Goodnight, little bunny," {name} whispered. The bunny wiggled its ears and hopped inside. Two more stars switched on. Twinkle, twinkle. Now three stars sat beside the moon. Glimmer's glow grew slow, and it yawned.

Near the top, {his} feet felt a little tired. "Let's rest and count the stars," said Grandma. They sat on the soft grass with the lantern glowing between them. One, two, three... As {name} counted, more stars appeared. Four, five, six! The moon seemed to smile, and its light grew gentle. Then everyone climbed on.

At last they reached the top. The moon looked big and close, hanging quietly in the sky. {name} waved the little lantern. "Goodnight, Moon." Glimmer glowed. "Goodnight, Moon." Grandma whispered, "Goodnight, Moon." Then star after star switched on across the whole sky, twinkling all around the moon. The moon was not lonely anymore.

Walking home, the night was hushed. The crickets stopped singing. The owl closed its eyes. Glimmer fell asleep on {his} finger, its glow soft and dim. At home, Grandma set the lantern by the window and kissed {name}. Snug in bed, {name} saw the moon and stars twinkling. Goodnight, Moon. Goodnight, stars. Goodnight, {name}.

title.en: {name} and the Snow Owl's Dream Library

zh: 下雪的傍晚，{name}和奶奶在院子裡堆雪人。奶奶坐在門廊上織圍巾，屋簷下的燈暖暖地亮著。忽然，一隻白色的老雪鴞輕輕落在雪人頭上，翅膀上掛著一個小布袋，袋子裡透出一閃一閃的光。「呼——呼——」牠低聲叫著，好像在打招呼。
「晚安，{name}。」老雪鴞說，「我叫白白，是夢境圖書館的館員。今天大家借走的夢，都要在全鎮睡著以前還回書架上。可是我的眼睛老花了，你願意幫我嗎？」{name}回頭看奶奶，奶奶放下毛線，笑著點點頭：「去吧，就在院子角落，我看得見你。」
白白用翅膀拍拍院子角落那座最高的雪堆，雪面上慢慢出現一扇小圓門。{name}彎下腰走進去，裡面暖暖的，一排排冰做的書架閃著藍光，安靜得只聽得見雪花落下的沙沙聲。白白說：「每個夢都有自己的名字，要放回原來的位置喔。」
{name}從布袋裡拿出第一個夢，它像一顆暖暖的玻璃球，裡面有麵包店老闆在雲上烤蛋糕。{name}把它放在「甜甜的夢」那一排。第二個夢裡，郵差先生騎著鯨魚送信，要放在「海洋的夢」。每放好一個，鎮上就有一扇窗的燈熄了。
一個、兩個、三個，{name}慢慢地放，白白慢慢地數。有一個夢調皮地滾到書架底下，{name}趴下來輕輕把它撿回來，裡面是一隻小狗在追自己的尾巴，繞著圈圈轉。白白笑得羽毛都抖了起來：「呼——呼——原來是隔壁小狗的夢！」{name}也忍不住笑了。
最後，布袋裡只剩一個夢，書架上卻找不到它的位置。它亮著淡淡的金光，裡面有一片安靜的雪地，和一扇亮著燈的窗。白白眨眨眼：「這個夢沒有被借走過，它是在等你的。今晚，就把它帶回家吧。」{name}小心地把夢捧在手心。
{name}走出雪堆，小圓門在身後悄悄不見了。白白飛上樹枝，輕輕叫著：「呼——呼——晚安。」奶奶牽起{his}手，一起走進溫暖的屋子。鎮上的燈一盞一盞熄了，窗外的雪也慢慢、慢慢地停了。{name}鑽進被窩，抱著那個金色的夢，閉上眼睛。晚安，{name}。
en: On a snowy evening, {name} was building a snowman in the backyard while Grandma knitted a scarf on the porch under a warm, glowing lamp. Suddenly, an old white snow owl landed on the snowman's head. A little cloth bag hung from its wing, twinkling with light. "Hoo-hoo," it called gently, as if saying hello.

"Good evening, {name}," said the owl. "I'm Snowdrop, the librarian of the Dream Library. Every dream borrowed today must go back on the shelves before the whole town falls asleep. But my eyes are tired. Will you help me?" {name} looked at Grandma, who set down her yarn and nodded. "Go ahead. I can see you."

Snowdrop tapped the tallest snowdrift in the corner of the yard, and a small round door appeared. {name} ducked inside. It was cozy and warm, with rows of ice shelves glowing blue, so quiet that only falling snowflakes whispered. "Every dream has its own name," said Snowdrop. "Each one goes back to its own place."

{name} took out the first dream, warm as a glass ball. Inside, the baker baked a cake on a cloud. {name} placed it on the Sweet Dreams shelf. In the second, the mail carrier rode a whale, so it went on the Ocean Dreams shelf. With each one, a window in town went dark.

One, two, three. {name} shelved slowly, and Snowdrop counted slowly. One playful dream rolled under a shelf, so {name} lay down and gently scooped it out. Inside, a puppy was chasing its tail, round and round. Snowdrop laughed until its feathers shook. "Hoo-hoo! That's the puppy next door!" {name} couldn't help laughing too.

At last, only one dream was left in the bag, but there was no place for it on any shelf. It glowed a soft gold, and inside was a snowy yard and a glowing window. Snowdrop blinked. "No one borrowed this one. It's been waiting for you. Take it home tonight." {name} held it carefully.

{name} stepped out of the snowdrift, and the little door disappeared. Snowdrop flew to a branch. "Hoo-hoo, good night." Grandma took {his} hand, and they went into the warm house. One by one, the town's lights went out, and the snow slowly, slowly stopped. Holding the golden dream, {name} closed {his} eyes. Good night, {name}.

zh: 晴朗的早上，{name}和媽媽來到動物園。陽光暖暖的，風兒輕輕的。管理員阿亮叔叔站在大象家門口，笑著向大家揮手。忽然，草地上傳來一個好奇怪的聲音：「嗝！」咦，是誰呀？{name}踮起腳，往前看一看，原來是小象圓圓在打嗝。
「嗝！」圓圓的長鼻子往上一彈。「嗝！」圓圓的大耳朵啪啪搧兩下。「嗝！」圓圓的小尾巴也跟著晃一晃。{name}忍不住小聲說：「好像彈簧喔！」阿亮叔叔點點頭說：「圓圓從早上就一直打嗝，我們一起來幫幫牠，好不好？」
阿亮叔叔牽著{name}，先去找長頸鹿高高。高高把長長的脖子低下來，慢慢地吸一口氣，再慢慢地吐出來。「呼——」{name}也跟著做，圓圓也學著做。大家都安安靜靜的。可是過了一下下，「嗝！」圓圓的鼻子又彈起來了，連高高都眨了眨眼睛。
他們又去找河馬胖胖。胖胖張開好大好大的嘴巴，打了一個長長的呵欠：「啊——」{name}也張大嘴巴，圓圓也張大嘴巴。三張大嘴巴排成一排，看起來好滑稽。可是，「嗝！」圓圓的嗝還是跑出來了，胖胖嚇得把嘴巴閉上，咕嚕咕嚕沉進水裡。
接著，他們來到猴子家。小猴子跳跳在樹上盪來盪去，吱吱吱，吱吱吱，想讓圓圓分心。{name}拍拍手，跟著唱：「跳跳跳，盪盪盪！」圓圓看得好認真，眼睛圓溜溜的。可是一安靜下來，「嗝！」又來了。阿亮叔叔抓抓頭，大家都有點煩惱了。
{name}想了一想，輕輕走到圓圓身邊。「圓圓，我來搔搔你的大耳朵喔！」{name}用{his}小手指輕輕地搔，搔呀搔，搔呀搔。圓圓的身體開始抖一抖，鼻子捲一捲，然後「噗哈哈哈！」笑得好開心，笑聲像小喇叭一樣響亮，連跳跳都笑了。
笑完了，大家靜靜等著。一、二、三……沒有「嗝」了！圓圓舉起長鼻子，開心地叫：「叭——」阿亮叔叔笑著說：「謝謝{name}，原來笑聲最有用！」圓圓用鼻子輕輕碰碰{name}的手，好像在說謝謝。{name}也笑了，跟圓圓說：「明天再來找你玩！」
en: One sunny morning, {name} and Mom went to the zoo. The sun was warm, and the breeze was soft. Zookeeper Leo waved hello by the elephant yard. Then a funny sound floated over the grass: "Hic!" Who could that be? {name} stood on tiptoe to look. It was Baby Elephant Bobo, and Bobo had the hiccups!

"Hic!" Bobo's trunk bounced up. "Hic!" Bobo's big ears went flap, flap. "Hic!" Bobo's little tail gave a wiggle. {name} whispered, "Bobo bounces like a spring!" Leo nodded with a smile. "Bobo has had the hiccups all morning," he said. "Shall we help our little friend together?" {name} nodded too.

First, Leo and {name} visited Tall Tilly the giraffe. Tilly bent her long neck down low. She breathed in slowly, then out slowly. "Whoosh." {name} did it too, and so did Bobo. Everyone was quiet and calm. But after a moment, "Hic!" Up bounced Bobo's trunk again. Even Tilly blinked in surprise.

Next, they visited Puffy the hippo. Puffy opened a huge, wide mouth and gave a long, sleepy yawn. "Aaah!" {name} opened wide too, and so did Bobo. Three big mouths in a row looked very silly! But then, "Hic!" Out popped another hiccup. Puffy shut tight and sank under the water, bubble, bubble.

Then they visited the monkeys. Little Hoppy swung from branch to branch, calling, "Ooh-ooh, ah-ah!" to keep Bobo busy. {name} clapped and sang along, "Hop, hop, swing, swing!" Bobo watched with big round eyes. But as soon as things got quiet, "Hic!" Back it came. Leo scratched his head. What could they try now?

{name} had an idea and tiptoed close to Bobo. "Bobo, I'm going to tickle your big ears!" {name} used {his} little fingers to tickle gently, tickle, tickle, tickle. Bobo began to wiggle and curl that long trunk. Then, "Ha-ha-ha!" Bobo giggled like a happy little trumpet, and even Hoppy laughed along.

After all the giggles, everyone waited quietly. One, two, three... no more hiccups! Bobo lifted that long trunk and trumpeted, "Pawoo!" Leo laughed. "Thank you, {name}. A giggle worked best!" Bobo gently touched {name}'s hand with the trunk, as if to say thanks. {name} smiled. "I'll come play again tomorrow, Bobo!"

zh: 星期六是洗衣日，陽光從窗戶灑進來，媽媽把一籃剛曬好的衣服放在沙發上。{name}自告奮勇幫忙配襪子，一雙一雙排得整整齊齊。可是排到最後，只剩下一隻紅白條紋的襪子孤零零地躺著，另一隻到底跑去哪裡了呢？
{name}皺起眉頭，像小偵探一樣蹲下來仔細觀察。籃子旁邊的地板上，有一根細細的紅色毛線，彎彎曲曲地指向走廊。「這一定是線索！」{name}小聲地說，拿起放大鏡，輕手輕腳地沿著毛線的方向前進，心裡怦怦跳，覺得自己好像在解開一個大謎題。
走廊盡頭是書房，書架最下層的書歪歪斜斜，好像有誰剛剛擠過去。{name}在地毯上發現幾根灰色的軟毛，摸起來毛茸茸的，還帶著一點暖意。「襪子不會掉毛啊，」{name}歪著頭想了想，「難道有共犯？」窗外的小鳥嘰嘰喳喳，好像也在幫忙猜答案。
接著，{name}走進廚房，看見貓咪的飯碗旁邊有一個小小的腳印，正好沾到灑出來的一點牛奶。腳印圓圓的，有四顆小豆豆。{name}忍不住笑出聲：「原來是梅花形狀的腳印！」爸爸從報紙後面探出頭，眨眨眼說：「偵探先生，需要幫忙嗎？」
{name}搖搖頭，決定自己把案子破完。腳印一路通往洗衣間，那裡有一個裝舊毛巾的籃子，正微微地一起一伏。{name}屏住呼吸，慢慢靠近，聽見裡面傳來輕輕的呼嚕呼嚕聲。{name}輕輕掀開最上面的毛巾，忍不住瞪大了眼睛。
灰色的貓咪麻糬蜷成一團，睡得正香，懷裡緊緊抱著那隻紅白條紋襪，還把它當成小枕頭。襪子上的毛線勾出了一個小洞，原來剛才的紅毛線就是從這裡來的。麻糬睜開一隻眼睛，「喵」了一聲，好像在說：「這是我的冒險夥伴！」
{name}想了想，從抽屜裡找出另一隻早就破了洞的舊襪子，塞了一點棉花，做成軟綿綿的小玩偶送給麻糬。麻糬開心地抱著新玩偶打滾，乖乖讓出條紋襪。媽媽笑著把襪子補好，{name}把它們配成一雙，覺得這是今天最棒的發現。
en: Saturday was laundry day. Sunshine poured through the window as Mom set a basket of fresh, warm clothes on the couch. {name} offered to match the socks and lined them up in neat pairs. But at the very end, one red-and-white striped sock lay all alone. Where had its partner wandered off to?

{name} frowned and crouched down like a real detective. On the floor beside the basket was a thin red thread, curling toward the hallway. "This must be a clue!" {name} whispered, grabbing a magnifying glass. Tiptoeing along the thread, {name} felt a happy flutter, as if a giant mystery was waiting to be solved.

At the end of the hallway was the study. The books on the bottom shelf leaned sideways, as if someone had squeezed past them. On the rug, {name} found a few soft gray hairs, still a little warm. "Socks don't shed," {name} said thoughtfully. "Maybe there's a partner in crime!" Outside, the birds chirped as if guessing too.

Next, {name} checked the kitchen. Beside the cat's bowl was a tiny footprint, stamped in a splash of spilled milk. It was round, with four little bean-shaped toes. {name} giggled. "A paw print!" Dad peeked out from behind his newspaper and winked. "Need any help, Detective?" he asked with a grin that said he knew something.

{name} shook {his} head, determined to crack the case alone. The paw prints led to the laundry room, where a basket of old towels was gently rising and falling. Holding a breath, {name} crept closer and heard a soft, rumbly purr. Slowly, {name} lifted the top towel, and eyes went wide with surprise.

Mochi, the gray cat, was curled up in a cozy ball, fast asleep and hugging the striped sock like a tiny pillow. A loose loop of red yarn dangled from a small hole, the very thread {name} had followed. Mochi opened one eye and said, "Meow," as if to say, "This is my adventure buddy!"

{name} had an idea. From a drawer came an old sock that already had a hole, and {name} stuffed it with cotton to make a squishy toy for Mochi. Mochi rolled around happily with the new friend and let the striped sock go. Mom stitched it up, and {name} matched the pair, smiling at the best discovery of the day.

zh: 今天是新學校的第一天。{name}牽著媽媽的手。走到教室門口，{name}停下來。心裡咚咚咚，咚咚咚。
媽媽蹲下來，抱一抱{name}。「放學時間，我一定來接你。」媽媽揮揮手，慢慢走了。{name}的眼淚，滴答滴答掉下來。
林老師走過來，輕輕抱住{name}。「想哭沒關係，老師陪你。」老師拿出一張藍色的紙。摺一摺，壓一壓，變成一艘小紙船。
{name}拿著小紙船，眼淚停了。教室裡好熱鬧。有人唱歌，有人堆積木。{name}好想說哈囉，可是說不出口。
角落有個小女孩，叫小米。小米也沒有說話。她抱著小熊，看著{name}的小紙船。{name}也看看小米。
{name}深深吸一口氣。走一步，再走一步。{name}把小紙船遞給小米。「給你看。」小米笑了，小小聲說：「好漂亮。」
老師幫大家倒水盆。兩人一起放紙船。船兒搖呀搖，水波嘩啦啦。接著吃點心，再午睡，又玩遊戲。一件接一件，{name}慢慢記住了。
太陽西斜，門口傳來聲音。「{name}，我來接你了！」真的是媽媽！{name}跑過去抱抱，再回頭揮手。「小米，明天見！」
en: Today is the first day at a new school. {name} holds Mom's hand tight. At the classroom door, {name} stops. Thump, thump goes {his} heart.
Mom kneels down for a big hug. "I will come back at pick-up time." Mom waves and slowly walks away. Drip, drop, tears fall from {name}'s eyes.
Ms. Lin comes over with a gentle hug. "It's okay to cry. I'm right here." She takes out blue paper. Fold, press, fold. Now it is a little paper boat!
{name} holds the boat. The tears stop. The room is busy and bright. Some kids sing. Some build blocks. {name} wants to say hello. But the word stays inside.
In the corner sits a girl named Mimi. Mimi is quiet too. She hugs her teddy bear. She looks at the paper boat. {name} looks back at Mimi.
{name} takes a big breath. One step, then another step. {name} holds out the boat. "Want to see?" Mimi smiles and whispers, "It's so pretty."
Ms. Lin fills a tub with water. Together they sail the boat. Splish, splash, it bobs along. Then snack time, nap time, game time. Step by step, {name} learns the day.
The sun sinks low. A voice calls at the door. "{name}, I'm here!" It's Mom, just like she promised! {name} runs for a hug, then waves. "See you tomorrow, Mimi!"

questions: {name}哭的時候，老師做了什麼？
媽媽有沒有回來接{name}？是什麼時候？
如果你看到一個害羞的小朋友，你會怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這週每天睡前，和孩子練習一句「放學我一定來接你」，再用一張紙一起摺小紙船，讓孩子帶去學校。

questions: What did the teacher do when {name} cried?
Did Mom come back for {name}? When?
What would you do if you saw a shy friend?
en.tip: Each night this week, practice saying "I always come back at pick-up time," then fold a little paper boat together for your child to bring to school.

zh: 週末清晨，{name}背起{his}小水壺，跟著爺爺來到山腳下。爺爺指著遠方雲霧裡的木頭平台說：「那就是瞭望台，站上去可以看見整座山谷喔！」{name}用力點頭，覺得自己一定能一口氣衝上去，腳步輕快得像小鹿一樣。
一開始，步道平平的，兩旁的樹葉沙沙作響。{name}走得飛快，還回頭催爺爺快一點。可是轉過一個彎，路突然變陡了，石階一層疊著一層，好像直直通到天上。{name}爬了幾階，腿開始發酸，呼吸也變得又急又重，只好停下來。
「好遠喔，我是不是爬不上去了？」{name}皺著眉頭坐在石頭上。爺爺沒有催促，只是陪著坐下，遞過水壺說：「我們不看山頂，只看下一棵樹。數十步就休息一下，好不好？」{name}半信半疑地站起來，小聲數著：「一、二、三……」
數到第十步，{name}真的停在一棵大樹旁。樹幹上有一隻小松鼠，抱著松果啃得喀喀響，尾巴蓬蓬地晃來晃去。{name}忍不住笑出聲，松鼠嚇了一跳，咻地鑽進樹洞，只留下半顆松果。爺爺笑說：「看來牠覺得你的笑聲比牠的點心還精彩。」
接下來，{name}一邊數步，一邊找新發現。第二個十步，看見石縫裡開著小小的紫色野花；第三個十步，聽見遠處的鳥叫「啾啾、啾啾」，像在替大家加油。{name}發現，原本累人的石階，現在好像變成一場尋寶遊戲，每一段都藏著驚喜。
快到山頂時，換爺爺停下來擦汗，喘著氣說：「哎呀，爺爺的腳也有點痠了。」{name}立刻牽起爺爺的手，認真地說：「爺爺別擔心，我們只看下一塊石頭，數十步就好！」兩人一起數著，一步一步，慢慢爬上最後一段陡坡，終於踏上了瞭望台。
眼前的山谷鋪滿綠色，白雲像棉花一樣飄在腳下，風輕輕吹過臉頰。爺爺摸摸{name}的頭說：「今天是你帶我上來的呢。」{name}望著來時彎彎曲曲的小路，想起松鼠、野花和鳥叫聲，覺得這一路上的每一小步，都和山頂的風景一樣美。
en: Early on Saturday morning, {name} packed {his} little water bottle and walked with Grandpa to the foot of the mountain. Grandpa pointed to a wooden platform peeking through the mist. "That's the lookout. From up there, you can see the whole valley!" {name} nodded hard, sure of zooming straight to the top like a speedy deer.

At first the trail was flat and easy, and the leaves rustled overhead. {name} hurried ahead, calling back for Grandpa to keep up. But around one bend, the path suddenly turned steep. Stone steps stacked up and up, as if they climbed into the sky. Soon {name}'s legs ached, and {his} breath came fast.

"It's so far. What if I can't make it?" {name} sighed, plopping onto a rock. Grandpa didn't rush. He sat down too and passed over the water bottle. "Let's forget the top. Just look at the next tree. Ten steps, then a rest. Deal?" {name} stood up, not quite sure, and whispered, "One, two, three..."

On step ten, {name} stopped beside a big tree. A little squirrel sat on the trunk, crunching a pinecone, its fluffy tail swishing back and forth. {name} giggled out loud. The squirrel jumped and zipped into a hole, leaving half its snack behind. Grandpa chuckled, "I think your laugh was more exciting than lunch."

After that, {name} counted steps and hunted for surprises. The next ten steps led to tiny purple flowers tucked between the rocks. Ten more brought birds singing, "Tweet-tweet, tweet-tweet," like a cheering crowd. Somehow, the tiring stairs had turned into a treasure hunt, with something new hiding along every stretch of the trail.

Near the top, it was Grandpa who stopped to wipe his forehead. "Whew, my old legs are tired too." {name} took his hand right away. "Don't worry, Grandpa. Just look at the next rock. Only ten steps!" Counting together, step by careful step, they climbed the last steep slope and finally stood on the lookout.

Green hills rolled across the valley, and fluffy clouds drifted below them as a cool breeze passed by. Grandpa smiled at {name}. "You're the one who brought me up here today." {name} looked back at the winding trail, remembering the squirrel, the flowers, and the birds. Every little step had been as beautiful as the view.

zh: 雨停了，太陽出來了。{name}穿上雨鞋，牽著媽媽的手，走進公園。滴答，滴答，樹葉上還有小水珠。草地亮亮的，空氣香香的。走著走著，{name}看見前面有一個好大好大的水窪，像一面圓圓的鏡子。媽媽說：「我們去看看吧！」
{name}蹲在水窪旁邊，媽媽也蹲下來。水裡有藍藍的天，還有白白的雲。風一吹，水面輕輕晃，一圈又一圈。{name}說：「媽媽，這是一片大海！」媽媽笑著點點頭：「那我們需要一艘船，才能去探險喔。」{name}開始東看看，西看看。
一片黃黃的樹葉，躺在長椅下面。{name}撿起樹葉，翻過來看一看，彎彎的，像一艘小船。{name}把樹葉輕輕放在水上。咻，樹葉船浮起來了！它不會沉，也不會翻。{name}拍拍手說：「船長準備好了，出發囉！」媽媽也一起拍拍手。
{name}輕輕吹氣，呼，呼，樹葉船往前走。可是水窪中間空空的，船要停在哪裡呢？{name}想了想，找到一顆圓圓的小石頭。撲通一聲，小石頭放進水裡，露出一點點頭。媽媽說：「哇，這是一座小島！」樹葉船慢慢漂向小島。
這時候，媽媽指著小島說：「你看，誰在那裡？」原來是一隻小蝸牛！牠背著捲捲的殼，慢慢爬，慢慢爬，觸角一伸一縮。小蝸牛好像想搭船。{name}讓樹葉船輕輕靠近小島，小蝸牛爬呀爬，終於爬上了樹葉船。
{name}小聲說：「歡迎上船，蝸牛先生！」呼，呼，{name}又輕輕吹氣，樹葉船載著小蝸牛，繞過小島，穿過雲朵的影子。一隻小鳥在樹上啾啾叫，好像在說加油。媽媽說：「船長，前面就是岸邊囉。」樹葉船慢慢停在濕濕的草地旁。
小蝸牛爬下樹葉船，爬進綠綠的草叢裡，慢慢回家了。{name}揮揮手說：「再見，蝸牛先生！」{name}把樹葉船放在長椅上，等下次再出航。太陽暖暖的，{name}牽著媽媽的手往前走。今天的探險，真好玩。
en: The rain stopped, and the sun came out. {name} put on rain boots, held Mom's hand, and walked into the park. Drip, drop went the wet leaves. The grass sparkled, and the air smelled fresh. Soon {name} spotted a big, big puddle, round and shiny like a mirror. "Let's go see," said Mom.

{name} crouched by the puddle, and Mom crouched down too. The water held the blue sky and fluffy white clouds. When the wind blew, little ripples spread out, round and round. "Mom, it's an ocean!" said {name}. Mom smiled and nodded. "Then we need a ship to go exploring." {name} looked here and there.

Under a bench lay a yellow leaf. {name} picked it up and turned it over. It curved just like a little boat. Gently, {name} set the leaf on the water. Whoosh! The leaf ship floated. It did not sink or tip. "The captain is ready. Off we go!" cheered {name}, and Mom clapped along happily.

{name} blew softly, whoo, whoo, and the leaf ship sailed ahead. But the middle of the puddle was empty. Where could the ship stop? {name} thought hard and found a small, round pebble. Plop! In it went, with its top peeking out. "Wow, an island!" said Mom. The leaf ship drifted slowly toward it.

Then Mom pointed at the island. "Look, who's there?" It was a little snail! It carried a curly shell and crept slowly, slowly, its feelers stretching in and out. The snail seemed to want a ride. {name} nudged the ship close to the island, and the snail crawled and crawled until it climbed aboard.

"Welcome aboard, Mr. Snail!" whispered {name}. Whoo, whoo, {name} blew again. The leaf ship carried the snail around the island and through the shadows of the clouds. A bird in a tree went tweet, tweet, as if cheering them on. "Captain, the shore is ahead," said Mom. The ship stopped beside the wet grass.

The snail slid off the leaf ship and crept into the green grass, slowly heading home. "Bye-bye, Mr. Snail!" said {name}, waving. {name} left the leaf ship on the bench, ready for another voyage someday. The sun felt warm as {name} held Mom's hand and walked on. What a wonderful adventure it had been!

title.en: {name} and the Map in the Bottle

zh: 晴朗的早晨，{name}和爸爸在沙灘上蓋沙堡。爸爸負責挖護城河，{name}負責堆高塔。挖著挖著，{his}小鏟子忽然「叩」的一聲，碰到一個硬硬的東西。{name}小心撥開濕沙，發現一個綠色的玻璃瓶，瓶口還用軟木塞緊緊塞住。
爸爸幫忙拔開木塞，從裡面倒出一張捲起來的紙。紙已經有點泛黃，上面畫著彎彎的海岸線、一座紅白相間的燈塔，還有一個大大的叉叉。旁邊用歪歪扭扭的字寫著：「從燈塔出發，往大石頭走二十步。」{name}睜大眼睛說：「爸爸，這是藏寶圖！」
爸爸笑著說：「那我們出發吧，不過要一起走喔。」他們沿著沙灘來到燈塔下。{name}找到一塊像烏龜殼的大石頭，一邊大聲數，一邊往前跨步。數到二十時，{he}停下腳步，發現沙子上插著一根褪色的小木棍，上面綁著一條藍色緞帶。
緞帶上掛著一個小牌子，寫著第二個線索：「去找會唱歌的地方。」{name}歪著頭想：沙灘上誰會唱歌呢？海鷗「嘎嘎」叫，可是牠們一直飛來飛去。這時一陣風吹過，旁邊的礁岩縫隙發出「嗚嗚」的聲音，好像有人在吹口哨。{name}高興地拉著爸爸跑過去。
在礁岩旁邊乾燥的沙地上，有一圈排成心形的小石頭。爸爸蹲下來，和{name}一起用手輕輕挖。沙子一層一層被撥開，終於露出一個生鏽的小鐵盒。{name}的心撲通撲通跳，連手都有點發抖。爸爸開玩笑說：「希望裡面不是一隻生氣的螃蟹。」
打開盒子，裡面是滿滿的貝殼：粉紅色的扇貝、白色的螺殼，還有一顆亮晶晶的小海螺。盒底有一張紙條：「我叫小薇，今年八歲。這是我最愛的貝殼。找到的人，請拿走一個，再放進一樣你的寶物，然後把盒子藏回去。」爸爸說，小薇現在應該已經長大了。
{name}挑了那顆小海螺，又從口袋拿出今天撿到的一塊光滑藍色海玻璃，輕輕放進盒子裡。{he}還在紙條背面畫了一座沙堡，寫上自己的名字。他們把盒子埋回原處，排好心形石頭。夕陽染紅了海面，{name}握著小海螺，牽著爸爸慢慢走回家。
en: On a sunny morning, {name} and Dad were building a sandcastle on the beach. Dad dug the moat, and {name} piled up the tallest tower. Suddenly, {his} little shovel hit something hard with a clink. {name} brushed away the wet sand and found a green glass bottle, its cork pushed in tight.

Dad helped pull out the cork, and a rolled-up paper slid into {name}'s hand. It was yellow with age. On it were a curvy shoreline, a red-and-white lighthouse, and a big X. Wobbly letters said, "Start at the lighthouse. Walk twenty steps to the big rock." "Dad, it's a treasure map!" {name} gasped.

"Then let's go," Dad grinned, "but we stay together." They walked along the sand to the lighthouse. {name} spotted a rock shaped like a turtle shell and began counting giant steps out loud. At twenty, {name} stopped. A faded little stick poked out of the sand, tied with a blue ribbon.

A tiny tag on the ribbon held the second clue: "Find the place that sings." {name} tilted {his} head. Who sings on a beach? The seagulls squawked, but they never stayed still. Then the wind blew, and the cracks in the nearby rocks whistled, "Whooo, whooo." {name} grabbed Dad's hand and hurried over.

On dry sand beside the rocks lay a ring of pebbles arranged in a heart. Dad knelt, and together they scooped gently with their hands. Layer by layer, the sand gave way until a rusty little tin box appeared. {name}'s heart thumped. Dad joked, "Let's hope there's no grumpy crab inside."

Inside, the box was full of shells: pink scallops, white swirly ones, and one shiny little conch. At the bottom was a note: "My name is Wei, and I am eight. These are my favorite shells. Finder, please take one, add a treasure of your own, and hide the box again." Dad said Wei must be grown up now.

{name} chose the shiny conch, then took a smooth piece of blue sea glass from a pocket and placed it gently inside. On the back of the note, {name} drew a sandcastle and signed it. They buried the box and rebuilt the pebble heart. As the sunset turned the sea pink, {name} held Dad's hand and walked home.

zh: 早安，早安！太陽出來了。奶奶提著菜籃子。{name}背著小背包。我們要去市場囉！叮叮咚，出發囉！
走呀走，走到轉角。前面有馬路。{name}伸出小手，牽住奶奶的手。奶奶笑咪咪：「牽好手，一起走。」
到了路邊，停！{name}站得好直。像一個小石像，一動也不動。奶奶說：「哇，好棒的小石像！」
看左邊，看右邊，再看左邊。嘟嘟嘟，機車來了！咻，咻，好快喔！{name}說：「機車跑好快。」奶奶點點頭。
對面有個小綠人。小綠人站著不動。我們也站著等。等呀等，等呀等。嗶嗶嗶！小綠人走路了！
{name}牽緊奶奶的手。一步，兩步，三步。眼睛還在看，耳朵還在聽。左看看，右看看。走過去了，真好！
穿過小巷子，巷子窄窄的。噗噗噗，機車也會來！{name}停在邊邊，看一看，聽一聽。安靜了，再牽手走。
市場到了！好熱鬧喔！有紅紅的蘋果，有香香的包子。奶奶買了包子，給{name}一個。熱呼呼，香噴噴。
回家路上，{name}還是牽著手。停，看，聽，等小綠人。奶奶說：「我們的小探險家！」{name}笑哈哈。
en: Good morning! The sun is up. Grandma has her basket. {name} has a little backpack. Off to the market we go!
Walk, walk, walk to the corner. There is a road ahead. {name} reaches out. {name} holds Grandma's hand. "Hold tight, walk right," says Grandma.
At the curb, stop! {name} stands so still. Still like a statue. Not one wiggle. "What a good statue!" says Grandma.
Look left. Look right. Look left again. Vroom, vroom! A scooter zooms by! Zoom, zoom, so fast! "Scooters are fast," says {name}.
Across the road is a little green man. He is standing still. So we stand still too. Wait, wait, wait. Beep beep! Now he walks!
{name} holds Grandma's hand tight. One step, two steps, three. Eyes still looking. Ears still listening. Left and right. We made it across!
Next comes a narrow alley. Putt, putt! Scooters come here too. {name} stops at the side. Look and listen. All quiet now. Hand in hand, they go.
Here is the market! So busy! Red apples. Warm buns. Grandma buys buns. One is for {name}. Warm and yummy!
On the way home, {name} holds Grandma's hand. Stop, look, listen, wait for green. "My little explorer!" says Grandma. {name} giggles.

questions: {name}走到路邊時，做了什麼？
在小巷子裡，為什麼也要停下來看一看、聽一聽？
我們出門過馬路時，你會牽誰的手？
zh.tip: 這週出門時，在路邊一起玩「小石像」遊戲：停下來，說「左、右、再左」，等小綠人走路再牽手過馬路。

questions: What did {name} do at the curb?
Why did {name} stop to look and listen in the little alley?
Whose hand will you hold when we cross the road?
en.tip: This week, play the statue game at every curb: stop, say "left, right, left again," and wait for the green walking man before crossing hand in hand.

zh: 早上，太陽亮亮的。{name}背好書包，要去幼兒園。爸爸笑著說：「今天你當我的馬路小偵探，好不好？」{name}用力點頭：「好！偵探要睜大眼睛！」爸爸伸出大手，{name}馬上牽緊。
他們走在人行道上。路邊停著好多機車，像排隊的小動物。爸爸說：「偵探，你看那條窄窄的小巷子。」{name}停下來看。噗噗噗！一台機車從巷子裡騎出來。「哇，好快！」{name}說。
「原來小巷子也會跑出車子。」{name}小聲說。爸爸點點頭：「所以我們走到巷口，先停一下。」{name}牽著爸爸的手，在巷口停好。左邊看看，右邊看看，再看左邊一次。沒有車了，他們才慢慢走過去。
前面是一條大馬路。叭叭！汽車一台接一台開過去。{name}的耳朵豎起來：「爸爸，我聽到好多車聲。」爸爸說：「偵探的耳朵也很厲害喔。現在要找一個線索，就是斑馬線。」
{name}東看看，西看看。「找到了！」路口有一條一條白白的線，像斑馬身上的花紋。{name}拉著爸爸走過去。到了人行道邊邊，{name}自己就停住了。爸爸說：「好棒的偵探，知道要在路邊停下來。」
對面有一個小燈。燈裡站著一個紅紅的小人，一動也不動。「紅色小人在說，等一下。」爸爸說。他們一起等。一台機車咻地轉彎，又一台汽車開過去。{name}握緊爸爸的手，耐心等待。
叮！小人變成綠色，還邁開腳在走路。旁邊有數字一直變少，二十、十九、十八。「綠色小人說可以走了！」{name}說。可是{name}先看左邊，再看右邊，又看左邊。爸爸笑了：「偵探真仔細。」兩人牽著手走過斑馬線，一邊走一邊注意車子。
他們安全走到對面。幼兒園的大門就在前面。老師在門口揮手。{name}抱抱爸爸：「爸爸，明天我還要當偵探！」爸爸摸摸書包說：「明天偵探再帶路。」{name}笑著跑進教室，心裡亮晶晶的。
en: The morning sun was bright. {name} put on a backpack for kindergarten. Dad smiled. "Will you be my road detective today?" {name} nodded hard. "Yes! Detectives keep their eyes wide open!" Dad held out a big hand, and {name} held on tight.

They walked along the sidewalk. Lots of scooters were parked in a row. Dad said, "Detective, look at that narrow alley." {name} stopped to look. Putt-putt-putt! A scooter zoomed out of the alley. "Wow, so fast!" said {name}.

"Even little alleys can have scooters," {name} whispered. Dad nodded. "So we stop at the corner first." Holding Dad's hand, {name} stopped. Look left. Look right. Look left again. No scooters. Then they walked on slowly.

Ahead was a big busy road. Beep, beep! Cars rolled by, one after another. {name} listened carefully. "Dad, I can hear lots of cars." Dad said, "Great detective ears! Now find our next clue. The zebra crossing."

{name} looked here and there. "Found it!" White stripes lay across the road, just like a zebra. {name} led Dad over. At the curb, {name} stopped all alone, right on the edge. "Smart detective," said Dad. "You stopped at the curb."

Across the road was a little light. Inside stood a red man, very still. "The red man says wait," said Dad. So they waited together. A scooter zipped around the corner. A car rolled past. {name} held Dad's hand and waited patiently.

Ding! The man turned green and started walking. Numbers counted down beside him. Twenty, nineteen, eighteen. "The green man says go!" said {name}. But first {name} looked left, right, and left again. Dad laughed. "Such a careful detective!" They crossed hand in hand, still watching for cars.

They reached the other side safely. The kindergarten gate was just ahead. The teacher waved hello. {name} hugged Dad. "Can I be a detective again tomorrow?" "Of course," said Dad. "You can lead the way." {name} ran inside, smiling and proud.

questions: {name}在小巷口看到什麼？{he}和爸爸怎麼做？
過馬路前，{name}要看哪幾個方向？
如果紅色小人亮著，你會怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這星期出門時，請孩子當「馬路小偵探」，在路邊一起停下來，牽手說：「左、右、再左」。

questions: What did {name} see at the alley, and what did {he} and Dad do?
Which ways did {name} look before crossing?
What would you do if the red man was showing?
en.tip: This week, let your child be your road detective. Stop together at each curb, hold hands, and say "left, right, left again."

zh: 晚上，媽媽牽著{name}去逛夜市。街上好熱鬧，燈一盞一盞亮起來。有香香的烤玉米，還有甜甜的糖葫蘆。出門前，媽媽蹲下來說：「如果看不到我，就站在原地等，我會回來找你。」{name}用力點點頭。
他們走過一攤又一攤。{name}看到一個大大的紅燈籠攤，燈籠圓圓的，像一顆顆小太陽。媽媽笑著說：「好漂亮！我們記住這裡喔。」{name}數了數，紅燈籠一共有五個。
再往前走，有一個撈金魚的攤子。小金魚在水盆裡游來游去，尾巴輕輕擺動。{name}蹲在旁邊看，看得好入迷。一個大哥哥撈到一條金魚，大家都拍手。{name}也開心地拍拍手。
{name}站起來，轉頭要叫媽媽。咦？媽媽不見了！身邊都是不認識的大人，腳步好多好快。{name}的心咚咚跳，眼睛有點熱熱的。這時候，{name}想起媽媽說過的話。
「站在原地等，媽媽會回來。」{name}深深吸一口氣。紅燈籠攤就在旁邊，亮亮的，好顯眼。{name}走到燈籠下站好，不再亂跑。{he}緊緊握著小拳頭，告訴自己要勇敢。
燈籠攤旁邊，有一個小小的服務亭。亭子裡坐著一位穿制服的警察阿姨。{name}記得，穿制服的人可以幫忙。{he}走過去，小聲說：「阿姨，我找不到媽媽了。」警察阿姨溫柔地蹲下來。
「別擔心，我們一起找。」警察阿姨問：「你知道媽媽的電話嗎？」{name}點點頭，一個數字一個數字慢慢說出來。這些數字，{name}在家早就背得好熟。阿姨馬上拿起電話撥出去。
沒多久，媽媽跑過來，一把抱住{name}。「你在原地等，又找人幫忙，好棒！」{name}笑了，向警察阿姨說謝謝。回家的路上，{name}牽著媽媽的手，抬頭看紅燈籠亮晶晶的。
en: One evening, Mom took {name} to the night market. The street was busy and bright. There was warm corn and sweet candied fruit. Before they went in, Mom knelt down. "If you can't see me, stay right there. I will come find you." {name} nodded.

They walked past stall after stall. {name} saw a big lantern stall. The red lanterns were round, like little suns. "How pretty!" said Mom. "Let's remember this place." {name} counted five red lanterns.
Next came a goldfish game. Little fish swam in a wide tub. Their tails swished softly. {name} crouched down to watch. A big kid scooped up a goldfish. Everyone clapped, and {name} clapped too.
{name} stood up to call Mom. But Mom was gone! Grown-ups hurried by on every side. {name}'s heart went thump, thump. {his} eyes felt warm and wet. Then {name} remembered Mom's words.

"Stay right there. Mom will come back." {name} took a deep breath. The lantern stall glowed close by. {name} stood under the bright lanterns and did not wander. {he} squeezed {his} hands and felt brave.

Next to the lanterns was a small help booth. A police officer in a uniform sat inside. {name} knew people in uniforms could help. {he} walked over and said, "I can't find my mom." The officer knelt down kindly.

"Don't worry. We'll find her together," she said. "Do you know Mom's phone number?" {name} nodded and said it slowly, one number at a time. {name} had practiced it at home. The officer called right away.

Soon Mom came running and hugged {name} tight. "You stayed put and asked for help. Wonderful!" {name} smiled and thanked the officer. On the way home, {name} held Mom's hand. The red lanterns twinkled goodbye.

questions: {name}看不到媽媽的時候，做了什麼？
如果你在外面找不到爸爸媽媽，可以請誰幫忙？
你記得爸爸或媽媽的電話號碼嗎？可以說說看嗎？
zh.tip: 這週每天睡前，和孩子一起唸一次你的全名和電話號碼，可以編成小歌來背。出門時，也一起約好一個顯眼的「等待地點」。

questions: What did {name} do when Mom was gone?
If you can't find your grown-up when you're out, who could you ask for help?
Do you know Mom's or Dad's phone number? Can you say it?
en.tip: Each night this week, say your full name and phone number together, maybe as a little song. When you go out, pick a bright meeting spot together.

zh: 星期六早上，爸爸帶{name}去城市裡最大的百貨公司買新的畫筆。出門前，爸爸蹲下來說：「如果我們不小心走散了，還記得我們的約定嗎？」{name}點點頭，小聲背了一遍爸爸的名字和電話號碼。
百貨公司好熱鬧！天花板上掛著彩色的氣球，玻璃櫃裡的玩具閃閃發亮。{name}牽著爸爸的手，搭著手扶梯慢慢往上升，像坐在一座會動的樓梯上，覺得自己正在探險。
到了三樓，{name}被一隻會轉圈跳舞的機器小狗吸引住了。小狗「汪汪」叫著，搖著尾巴轉了一圈又一圈。{name}看得好開心，等{he}抬起頭時，身邊只有許多陌生的大人，爸爸不見了！
{name}的心怦怦跳，好想跑去找爸爸。可是{he}想起爸爸說過的話：「看不到我的時候，就停下來，站在原地，我會回來找你。」{name}深深吸一口氣，站在機器小狗旁邊，雙腳像釘在地上一樣，一動也不動。
等了一會兒，{name}看見一位穿著藍色制服、胸前別著名牌的姐姐，正在整理架子上的玩具。{name}記得，穿制服的店員是可以幫忙的人。{he}走過去，有禮貌地說：「姐姐，我找不到爸爸了，可以請妳幫忙嗎？」
店員姐姐溫柔地笑了：「謝謝你來找我，你做得很好。我們一起去旁邊的服務台，好嗎？」服務台就在手扶梯旁邊，櫃台上放著一支電話和一個小鈴鐺。另一位叔叔請{name}坐在椅子上，還遞給{him}一杯溫水。
「你知道爸爸的名字和電話嗎？」叔叔問。{name}挺起胸膛，一個數字一個數字，清清楚楚地背了出來。叔叔撥了電話，沒多久就說：「找到了！爸爸馬上就到。」接著，廣播裡也傳來輕柔的聲音，請爸爸到三樓服務台。
不一會兒，爸爸快步走來，緊緊抱住{name}。「你記得我們的約定，真棒！」{name}笑著說：「我停下來等你，還請穿制服的姐姐幫忙喔！」他們謝過店員，一起去買了新的畫筆。回家的路上，{name}覺得這是一場最勇敢的冒險。
en: On Saturday morning, Dad took {name} to the biggest department store in the city to buy new paintbrushes. Before they left, Dad knelt down and asked, "If we ever get separated, do you remember our plan?" {name} nodded and quietly recited Dad's name and phone number.

The store was buzzing with life! Colorful balloons floated near the ceiling, and toys sparkled behind glass. Holding Dad's hand, {name} rode the escalator slowly upward. It felt like riding a magic moving staircase on a real adventure.

On the third floor, a robot puppy caught {name}'s eye. It barked, "Woof! Woof!" and spun in circles, wagging its tail. {name} watched happily. But when {name} looked up, there were only strangers all around. Dad was gone!

{name}'s heart thumped. Running off to search was tempting, but {name} remembered Dad's words: "If you can't see me, stop and stay right where you are. I'll come back for you." So {name} took a deep breath and stood still beside the robot puppy, feet planted firmly.

After a little while, {name} noticed a young woman in a blue uniform with a name badge, tidying the toy shelves. Staff in uniform are helpers, {name} remembered. {name} walked over and said politely, "Excuse me, I can't find my dad. Could you please help me?"

The staff member smiled kindly. "Thank you for coming to me. You did great. Let's go to the service counter together, okay?" The counter was right beside the escalator, with a telephone and a little bell on top. A man there offered {name} a chair and a cup of warm water.

"Do you know your dad's name and phone number?" he asked. {name} sat up tall and said each number slowly and clearly. The man made the call and soon smiled. "Found him! Your dad is on his way." A gentle announcement also invited Dad to the third-floor service counter.

Soon Dad hurried over and hugged {name} tight. "You remembered our plan. Wonderful!" {name} grinned. "I stopped and waited, and I asked a helper in uniform!" They thanked the staff and bought the new paintbrushes. On the way home, {name} felt it had been the bravest adventure ever.

questions: {name}發現看不到爸爸的時候，第一件事做了什麼？
如果你在商店裡找不到大人，你可以去找誰幫忙？
你能背出爸爸或媽媽的名字和電話嗎？
zh.tip: 這個星期每天玩一次「電話號碼接龍」，和孩子輪流說出家長的手機號碼，直到孩子能自己完整背出來。

questions: What did {name} do first after noticing Dad was gone?
If you couldn't find your grown-up in a store, who could you ask for help?
Can you say your parent's name and phone number by heart?
en.tip: This week, play a daily "phone number relay," taking turns saying each digit of your phone number until your child can recite it all alone.

zh: 早上，幼兒園的鈴聲叮叮響。林老師笑著說：「今天要玩一個特別的遊戲！」{name}眼睛亮亮的，好想知道是什麼。老師說：「我們要練習地震來了怎麼辦。」
林老師慢慢蹲下來。「大家來變小烏龜！」她說，「第一步，趴下來，像烏龜趴在地上。」小朋友一起蹲低，{name}也趴得好穩。大家咯咯笑，好像真的變成一群小烏龜。
「第二步，鑽進殼裡！」老師指著桌子說，「堅固的桌子，就是我們的殼。」{name}鑽到桌子下，用小手護住頭和脖子。桌子底下暗暗的，好像一個小山洞。
「第三步，抓緊不放手！」老師說。{name}握住桌腳，緊緊不放。好朋友小米在旁邊的桌下，也抓得牢牢的。老師搖搖鈴，說：「搖晃的時候，烏龜不出殼喔。」
小米小聲問：「可以跑出去嗎？」老師搖搖頭，溫柔的說：「搖的時候，不跑出去，也不去樓梯。」她又指指窗戶和高高的書櫃。「也要離窗戶和會掉的東西遠一點。」{name}認真點點頭。
鈴聲停了。老師說：「搖完了，跟著老師走。」大家排好隊，一個接一個，慢慢走到操場。沒有人推，也沒有人跑。{name}覺得自己像勇敢的探險隊員。
傍晚，太陽下山了，{name}和媽媽一起回家。吃完晚餐，客廳的燈突然晃呀晃。地板輕輕搖，杯子叮叮響。是真的地震！{name}想起小烏龜，馬上說：「趴下、掩護、穩住！」
{name}趴下來，鑽到堅固的餐桌下，護著頭，抓緊桌腳。媽媽也鑽進來，抱著{him}一起等。一下子，搖晃停了。媽媽說：「搖完了，跟媽媽慢慢走。」媽媽摸摸{his}頭：「你是最棒的小烏龜。」{name}笑了，睡前還輕輕說：「晚安，烏龜殼。」
en: The school bell rang in the morning. Miss Lin smiled. "Today we will play a special game!" {name} sat up, eyes bright. "We will practice what to do in an earthquake."

Miss Lin crouched down low. "Let's all become little turtles!" she said. "Step one: drop down, like a turtle on the ground." Everyone got low. {name} dropped down nice and steady. The children giggled like a bunch of turtles.
"Step two: get into your shell!" Miss Lin pointed at the desks. "A sturdy desk is our shell." {name} crawled under a desk. Little hands covered head and neck. It felt like a tiny cave.

"Step three: hold on tight!" said Miss Lin. {name} grabbed the desk leg and held on. Under the next desk, best friend Mimi held on too. Miss Lin shook a bell. "While it shakes, turtles stay in their shells."

Mimi whispered, "Can we run outside?" Miss Lin gently shook her head. "Not while it shakes. And not to the stairs." She pointed to the windows and the tall bookshelf. "Stay away from glass and things that can fall." {name} nodded.
The bell stopped. "The shaking is over," said Miss Lin. "Follow me." Everyone lined up. One by one, they walked calmly to the playground. Nobody pushed. Nobody ran. {name} felt like a brave explorer.

That evening, the sun went down. {name} went home with Mom. After dinner, the lamp began to wobble. The floor shook a little. The cups went clink, clink. A real earthquake! {name} remembered the turtles. "Drop, cover, hold on!"

{name} dropped down and crawled under the sturdy table. Hands covered head, and fingers held the table leg. Mom crawled in too and hugged {him}. Soon the shaking stopped. "Now we walk out slowly," Mom said. "You were a wonderful little turtle." At bedtime, {name} whispered, "Goodnight, turtle shell."

questions: 地震來的時候，小烏龜{name}做了哪三個動作？
搖晃的時候，為什麼不要跑去樓梯或窗戶旁邊？
如果家裡突然搖起來，你會躲在哪張桌子下面？
zh.tip: 今晚一起在家找一張堅固的桌子當「烏龜殼」，玩一次「趴下、掩護、穩住」的遊戲，再練習搖完後跟著大人慢慢走。

questions: What three things did {name} do when the ground shook?
Why should we stay away from stairs and windows while it shakes?
If our home shook, which table would you hide under?
en.tip: Tonight, pick a sturdy table at home as your "turtle shell" and play "Drop, cover, hold on." Then practice walking out slowly together after the pretend shaking stops.

title.en: {name} and the Fort Under the Table

zh: 星期六下午，{name}坐在客廳地毯上畫畫，畫的是一艘要飛去月亮的太空船。弟弟小樂在旁邊堆積木，媽媽在廚房洗水果，窗外的陽光暖暖的，一切都好安靜。
忽然，桌上的蠟筆開始喀啦喀啦地滾動，吊燈也輕輕搖晃起來。「咦？」{name}抬起頭，發現地板在微微晃動。小樂嚇得張大眼睛，手裡的積木掉了下來。
{name}想起老師在學校演練時說過的話。{he}沒有往樓梯跑，而是牽起小樂的手，說：「跟我來，我們去餐桌下面！」兩個人蹲低身體，一起鑽進那張又厚又堅固的木頭餐桌底下。
「用手把頭和脖子護好，另一隻手抓住桌腳。」{name}一邊說，一邊做給小樂看。小樂學著{name}，把小手放在頭上，緊緊抓住桌腳。餐桌像一座小堡壘，把他們好好地保護著。
媽媽很快也蹲下來，爬到餐桌底下。「做得好！我們一起在這裡等。」她說。櫃子裡的碗盤叮叮噹噹地響，窗戶也在嗡嗡作響。{name}看了看窗邊，心想：還好我們離窗戶和書櫃遠遠的。
{name}握著小樂的手，輕聲數數：「一、二、三……」數到二十的時候，搖晃慢慢變小，最後停了下來。吊燈不再擺動，屋子又安靜了。小樂小聲問：「我們可以出去了嗎？」媽媽說：「先等一下，我看看四周。」
媽媽檢查了門口和走廊，確定沒有東西倒下來，才帶著兩個孩子慢慢走出來。「剛剛{name}帶著弟弟躲得又快又穩，真像一位冒險隊長。」媽媽笑著說。{name}覺得心裡暖暖的。
接著，全家打開放在門邊的緊急避難包。{name}負責清點：手電筒、水、餅乾、哨子，還有急救包。小樂把一包新的電池放進去。{name}拿起畫紙，在太空船旁邊畫了一張堅固的小餐桌，上面寫著「我們的堡壘」。
en: On Saturday afternoon, {name} sat on the living room rug, drawing a spaceship on its way to the moon. Little brother Leo was stacking blocks nearby, and Mom was washing fruit in the kitchen. Warm sunlight came through the window, and everything was quiet.

Suddenly, the crayons began to rattle and roll across the paper. The ceiling lamp swayed back and forth. "Huh?" {name} looked up and felt the floor trembling. Leo's eyes grew wide, and the block in his hand tumbled down.

{name} remembered the drill at school. Instead of running for the stairs, {name} took Leo's hand. "Come with me, under the dining table!" They crouched down low and crawled beneath the big, sturdy wooden table together.

"Put one hand over your head and neck, and hold the table leg with the other," said {name}, showing Leo how. Leo copied every move and gripped the leg tight. The table felt like a little fort keeping them safe.

Mom hurried over, dropped down, and crawled in beside them. "Well done! We'll wait right here together," she said. Dishes clinked in the cupboard, and the windows hummed. {name} glanced at the glass and the tall bookshelf, glad they were far away from both.

Holding Leo's hand, {name} counted softly, "One, two, three..." By twenty, the shaking grew smaller and then stopped. The lamp was still. "Can we come out now?" Leo whispered. "Wait a moment," said Mom. "Let me look around first."

Mom checked the doorway and the hall to make sure nothing had fallen. Then she led them out slowly. "{name}, you helped your brother get safe so quickly. You were a real adventure captain!" {name} felt warm inside.

Next, the family opened the emergency backpack by the front door. {name} checked each item: flashlight, water, crackers, a whistle, and a first-aid kit. Leo added a pack of fresh batteries. Then {name} drew a sturdy little table beside the spaceship and wrote, "Our Fort."

questions: 地板開始搖晃的時候，{name}帶著弟弟做了哪些事？
為什麼{name}沒有跑去樓梯，而是躲在餐桌下等媽媽？
如果在學校遇到地震，你會怎麼做、聽誰的話？
zh.tip: 這週在家玩一次「趴下、掩護、穩住」小演練：大人喊「地震來了」，孩子找到家裡最堅固的桌子躲好，數到二十再等大人說可以出來。

questions: What did {name} and Leo do when the floor started shaking?
Why did {name} stay under the table with Mom instead of running to the stairs?
If the ground shook at school, what would you do, and who would you listen to?
en.tip: This week, play a quick "Drop, Cover, Hold On" game: call out "Earthquake!" and have your child find the sturdiest table, take cover, count to twenty, and wait for you to say it's safe to come out.

zh: 遊覽車沿著蜿蜒的山路緩緩爬升，窗外雲霧繚繞，青山層層疊疊。{name}和同學們要去花蓮山上的一所小學校交流。校門口，一群一二年級的小朋友早已翹首以待，揮著小手大喊：「歡迎光臨！」
山上的林老師笑著說：「花蓮常常有地震，所以我們每個月都練習。今天請大哥哥大姊姊當小老師，好嗎？」{name}自告奮勇，帶著三個小朋友練習：阿凱、小米，還有總是抱著布兔子的妹妹晴晴。
「地震來了，先趴下！」{name}蹲低身子，「然後躲到堅固的桌子底下，用手護住頭和脖子。最後抓緊桌腳，不要放手。」阿凱噗哧一笑：「好像烏龜縮進殼裡！」{name}點點頭：「對，我們就是最聰明的烏龜。」大家練了一遍又一遍，越做越熟練。
午餐時間到了，桌上擺滿香噴噴的炒米粉和熱騰騰的玉米湯。晴晴正要喝第一口湯，忽然，地板輕輕一晃，接著整間教室喀啦喀啦地搖起來。窗戶嗡嗡作響，牆上的掛圖左右擺盪。
阿凱嚇得站起來想往門口衝。「阿凱，趴下！」{name}一把拉住他的袖子，迅速鑽進桌底，「樓梯和外面現在都不安全，跟我一起當烏龜！」三個小朋友立刻擠進來，{name}一手護著頭，一手緊緊抓著桌腳，還提醒小米：「離窗戶遠一點，靠過來。」
桌子上的湯碗叮叮咚咚地跳著舞。晴晴的眼眶紅了，{name}輕聲說：「我們來數數，數到二十，烏龜就可以探頭了。」大家小聲地數：「一、二、三……」數到十六的時候，搖晃漸漸停了。教室裡鴉雀無聲，只聽見林老師沉穩的聲音：「大家先別動，聽老師指令。」
老師確認安全後，大家護著頭，排好隊，跟著老師不疾不徐地走到操場。點完名，人人平安無事。晴晴把布兔子塞給{name}：「謝謝烏龜隊長！」林老師笑著拍拍{his}肩膀。{name}這才發現，原來今天真正的小老師，是在搖晃中依然冷靜的自己。
en: The bus crawled up the winding mountain road while mist curled around the green peaks. {name}'s class was visiting a tiny village school in the mountains of Hualien. At the gate, a crowd of first and second graders bounced on their toes, waving and shouting, "Welcome!"

Ms. Lin, the village teacher, smiled. "We get earthquakes here, so we practice every month. Will you big kids be our helpers today?" {name} volunteered right away and got three little partners: Kai, Mimi, and tiny Ching, who never let go of her stuffed rabbit.

"When the ground shakes, drop down first," {name} explained, crouching low. "Then crawl under a sturdy table and cover your head and neck. Last, hold on to a table leg and don't let go." Kai giggled. "We look like turtles hiding in our shells!" {name} grinned. "Exactly. The smartest turtles around." They practiced again and again until it felt easy.

Then came lunch: steaming fried noodles and sweet corn soup. Ching lifted her spoon for the very first sip. Suddenly the floor gave a little bump. Then the whole classroom began to rattle and rumble. The windows hummed, and the posters on the wall swung back and forth.

Kai jumped up and started toward the door. "Kai, drop!" {name} caught his sleeve and ducked under the table. "The stairs and outside aren't safe right now. Be a turtle with me!" All three kids squeezed in. {name} covered {his} head with one hand and gripped the table leg with the other. "Mimi, scoot away from the window. Come closer."

Above them, the soup bowls clinked and danced. Ching's eyes filled with tears, so {name} whispered, "Let's count. At twenty, turtles can peek out." Together they counted softly, "One, two, three..." By sixteen, the shaking faded away. The room went perfectly still. Then came Ms. Lin's calm voice: "Stay where you are, everyone. Listen for my directions."

When the teachers said it was safe, everyone covered their heads, lined up, and followed them out to the playground, slow and steady. Every name was called, and everyone was fine. Ching pushed her rabbit into {name}'s hands. "Thank you, Turtle Captain!" Ms. Lin patted {his} shoulder, and {name} realized that the real helper today had been the one who stayed calm when the ground shook.

questions: 地震來的時候，{name}和小朋友們做了哪三個動作？
阿凱想跑出去時，{name}為什麼叫他留在桌子底下？
如果你在家裡遇到地震，你會躲在哪裡？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子在家玩一次「烏龜演習」：喊出「地震來了！」後一起趴下、掩護、穩住，並找出家裡最堅固的桌子和遠離窗戶的位置。

questions: What three things did {name} and the little kids do when the ground shook?
Why did {name} ask Kai to stay under the table instead of running out?
If the ground shook while you were at home, where would you go?
en.tip: This week, play a "turtle drill" at home: call out "Earthquake!" and practice drop, cover, and hold on together, then find the sturdiest table in the house that's away from windows.

zh: 星期六早上，陽光暖暖的。{name}和爺爺一起去公園探險。爺爺帶著一個小水壺，{name}背著{his}小背包。背包裡有一個放大鏡，還有一本畫畫本。「今天要找什麼寶藏呢？」爺爺笑著問。
{name}說：「我要找最漂亮的葉子！」爺爺坐在大樹下的長椅上。「爺爺在這裡看著你喔。」{name}點點頭。{he}在草地上慢慢走，用放大鏡看葉子。有一片紅葉子，像一顆小愛心。
{name}又找到一隻小瓢蟲。瓢蟲紅紅的，背上有七個黑點點。牠爬上一根小草，又飛走了。{name}開心地畫下來。這時候，一位叔叔走了過來。{name}從來沒見過他。
叔叔笑得很親切。他說：「小朋友，我的小狗不見了。牠好像跑到那邊的樹叢後面。你可以陪我去找嗎？」他還拿出一顆亮晶晶的糖果。「幫忙的話，這個送你喔。」
{name}看看糖果，又看看樹叢。{he}想起媽媽說過的話。「不認識的人，不跟他走。不認識的人給的東西，也不能拿。」爸爸也說過：「只跟爸媽說好的大人走。」{name}深深吸了一口氣。
{name}大聲說：「不要！我要去找爺爺！」聲音大大的，像小獅子一樣勇敢。{he}轉身就跑，一路跑回大樹下。爺爺馬上站起來，張開手臂抱住{him}。「怎麼了？慢慢說。」
{name}把事情告訴爺爺。爺爺摸摸{his}頭說：「你做得非常好。你說不要，又馬上來找我。」爺爺牽著{name}的手，去找穿制服的公園警衛。警衛阿姨仔細聽完，說：「謝謝你們告訴我。找小狗的事，交給我們大人。」
警衛阿姨打電話請同事幫忙。爺爺和{name}又回到長椅。{name}拿出畫畫本，畫了紅葉子、小瓢蟲，還畫了一隻大聲說不的小獅子。爺爺笑著說：「這是今天最棒的寶藏。」{name}也笑了，緊緊靠著爺爺。
en: On Saturday morning, the sun felt warm. {name} and Grandpa went to the park for an adventure. Grandpa brought a water bottle. {name} carried a little backpack with a magnifying glass and a drawing book. "What treasure will we find today?" Grandpa asked.

"The prettiest leaf!" said {name}. Grandpa sat on a bench under a big tree. "I'll watch you from right here." {name} nodded and walked slowly across the grass. Through the magnifying glass, {name} found a red leaf shaped like a tiny heart.
Next, {name} spotted a ladybug with seven black dots. It climbed a blade of grass, then flew away. {name} drew it happily. Just then, a man walked over. {name} had never seen him before.
The man smiled kindly. "My puppy is lost," he said. "I think he ran behind those bushes. Will you help me look?" He held out a shiny candy. "You can have this if you help."

{name} looked at the candy, then at the bushes. {name} remembered what Mom always said. "Don't go with people you don't know. Don't take things from them, either." Dad said, "Only go with grown-ups we agreed on." {name} took a deep breath.

"No!" {name} shouted. "I'm going to Grandpa!" The voice was big and brave, like a little lion. {name} turned and ran straight back to the bench. Grandpa stood up and opened his arms wide. "What happened? Take your time."

{name} told Grandpa everything. Grandpa gave a gentle hug. "You did so well. You said no, and you came right to me." Holding hands, they found the park guard in her uniform. She listened carefully. "Thank you for telling me. The grown-ups will handle the puppy."

The guard called a coworker to help. Grandpa and {name} went back to the bench. {name} opened the drawing book and drew the red leaf, the ladybug, and a little lion shouting no. "That's the best treasure today," Grandpa said, smiling. {name} snuggled close.

questions: 叔叔請{name}幫忙找小狗，還給糖果時，{name}做了什麼？
如果有你不認識的人叫你跟他走，你會怎麼說？會去找誰？
哪些大人是爸媽說好可以跟他走的？我們一起數一數。
zh.tip: 今晚玩「大聲說不」小遊戲：大人扮演陌生人邀請孩子，孩子練習大聲說「不要！」然後跑來找你、告訴你。

questions: What did {name} do when the man asked for help and offered a candy?
If someone you don't know asked you to come along, what would you say, and who would you go to?
Which grown-ups have we agreed you can go with? Let's name them together.
en.tip: Tonight, play the "Loud No" game: pretend to be a stranger inviting your child along, and let them practice shouting "No!" then running to you to tell you.

zh: 廚房裡香香的。奶奶在煮雞湯。大鍋咕嘟咕嘟響。白白的蒸氣飄呀飄，彎彎的，像一隻愛睏的小龍。{name}睜大眼睛說：「哇，有龍！」
{name}想去看小龍。{he}踮起小腳尖，慢慢走過去。奶奶笑著說：「小龍很燙喔。我們站遠遠看。」{name}退後一步，再退一步。
嗶嗶嗶！水壺叫起來了。壺嘴也冒出小白煙。「又一隻小龍！」{name}說。奶奶點點頭：「水壺燙燙的，大人來拿。」奶奶用手套把水壺拿下來。
電鍋也噗噗響。小洞噴出熱熱的氣。{name}站得好好的，大聲喊：「奶奶，電鍋在冒煙！」奶奶走過來說：「謝謝你叫我，好棒的小幫手。」
爐子上的火藍藍的。奶奶說：「爐子也是大人的喔。」{name}點點頭：「大鍋燙，水壺燙，電鍋燙，爐子燙。都給奶奶！」奶奶抱抱{him}。
雞湯煮好了。奶奶盛了一小碗，放在桌上。小碗也冒著小小的龍。{name}好想喝。奶奶說：「等一等，還太燙。我們一起來趕走小龍。」
奶奶吹一吹，呼——{name}也吹一吹，呼——呼——小龍越來越小，越來越小。奶奶摸摸碗說：「再吹一下。」呼——小龍不見了！
奶奶說：「好了，不燙了。」{name}拿起{his}小湯匙，喝一口。哇，暖暖的，香香的！{name}笑著說：「謝謝奶奶，謝謝小龍！」
en: The kitchen smells so good. Grandma is making chicken soup. The big pot goes bubble, bubble. White steam curls up high. It looks like a sleepy dragon. {name} says, "Wow, a dragon!"
{name} wants to see the dragon. {he} tiptoes closer and closer. Grandma smiles. "That dragon is hot. Let's watch from far away." {name} takes one step back. Then another.
Beep, beep, beep! The kettle starts to sing. Steam puffs from its spout. "Another dragon!" says {name}. Grandma nods. "The kettle is hot. Grown-ups lift it." She uses her mitt.
The rice cooker goes puff, puff. Hot steam shoots from its hole. {name} stays right where {he} is. "Grandma! The rice cooker is steaming!" Grandma comes over. "Thank you for calling me, helper."
The stove has a blue flame. "The stove is for grown-ups too," says Grandma. {name} nods. "Hot pot, hot kettle, hot cooker, hot stove. All for Grandma!" Grandma gives {him} a hug.
The soup is ready. Grandma fills a little bowl. A tiny dragon rises from it. {name} wants a sip. "Wait, it's still too hot," says Grandma. "Let's blow the dragon away together."
Grandma blows. Whoo! {name} blows too. Whoo, whoo! The dragon gets smaller and smaller. Grandma touches the bowl. "One more time." Whoo! The dragon is gone!
"Now it's just right," says Grandma. {name} picks up {his} little spoon. One sip. Mmm, warm and yummy! {name} smiles. "Thank you, Grandma! Thank you, dragon!"

questions: {name}看到電鍋冒煙時，做了什麼？
家裡有哪些燙燙的東西是給大人碰的？
湯太燙的時候，我們可以怎麼做？
zh.tip: 今天吃飯時，一起玩「趕走小龍」：大人說可以了才開吃，先一起對著碗吹三下。

questions: What did {name} do when the rice cooker was steaming?
What hot things in our home are only for grown-ups to touch?
What can we do when soup is too hot?
en.tip: At mealtime tonight, play "blow the dragon away": blow on the bowl together three times and wait until you say it's ready.

zh: 嗶嗶嗶！小機器人叮叮醒了。叮叮的燈一閃一閃。「我好累，我沒電了。」叮叮慢慢走，咚，咚，咚。{name}抱起叮叮，輕輕拍拍它。
叮叮拿起一支紅色蠟筆。它指著牆上的插座說：「我要把蠟筆插進去，就有電了！」{name}趕快搖搖頭。「不行不行，叮叮等一下！」
{name}說：「插座是大人用的。手指不碰，蠟筆也不碰。」叮叮眨眨眼：「那我怎麼充電？」{name}笑了：「跟我來，我們去探險！」
{name}當隊長，叮叮當隊員。走過沙發，繞過小桌子。踏踏踏，踏踏踏。「隊長，我們去哪裡？」「去找大人的充電角落！」
廚房裡，水龍頭嘩啦啦。{name}剛洗完手，小手濕濕的。叮叮說：「隊長，那邊有電線！」{name}停下來。「濕濕的手，不靠近電線。」
{name}拿毛巾擦呀擦。擦乾了，再擦一擦。叮叮也學著擦擦小手臂。走廊上，有一條舊電線。叮叮喊：「隊長快看，它破了一個洞！」
{name}拉著叮叮往後退一步。「破的電線不能碰，我們去告訴媽媽。」媽媽來了，把插頭拔掉。「謝謝你們告訴我，真棒！」
媽媽帶他們到書桌旁的充電角落。媽媽插好充電線，叮叮躺在小座上。滴，滴，滴，叮叮的燈亮了！「謝謝隊長！」{name}笑咪咪，跟叮叮擊掌。
en: Beep, beep, beep! Little robot Ding woke up. Ding's light blinked slowly. "I'm so tired. I have no power." Ding walked slowly, clunk, clunk. {name} picked Ding up gently.
Ding grabbed a red crayon. Ding pointed at the wall socket. "I'll poke this in. Then I'll get power!" {name} shook {his} head fast. "No, no! Wait, Ding!"
"Sockets are for grown-ups," said {name}. "No fingers. No crayons." Ding blinked. "Then how do I charge?" {name} smiled. "Follow me. Let's go exploring!"
{name} was the captain. Ding was the crew. Past the sofa, around the table. Tap, tap, tap! "Captain, where are we going?" "To the grown-up charging corner!"
In the kitchen, the tap went splash. {name} had just washed up. Little hands were dripping wet. "Captain, a cord!" said Ding. {name} stopped. "Wet hands stay away."
{name} rubbed {his} hands on a towel. Rub, rub, all dry! Ding dried its arms too. In the hall lay an old cord. "Look, Captain! It has a hole!"
{name} stepped back and held Ding close. "We don't touch broken cords. Let's tell Mom." Mom came and pulled the plug. "Thank you for telling me!"
Mom led them to the charging corner. She plugged in the charger. Ding sat on its little dock. Ding, ding, ding! Its light glowed bright. "Thanks, Captain!" {name} gave Ding a high five.

questions: 叮叮想把蠟筆插進插座時，{name}做了什麼？
如果你的手濕濕的，看到電線要怎麼做？
如果你看到破掉的電線，你會去告訴誰？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起在家裡「巡邏」，指出插座和充電角落，練習說：「插座是大人用的，我會叫大人。」

questions: What did {name} do when Ding wanted to poke a crayon into the socket?
What should you do if your hands are wet and you see a cord?
If you saw a broken cord, who would you tell?
en.tip: Tonight, go on a little home "patrol" together to find sockets and the charging corner, and practice saying, "Sockets are for grown-ups. I'll get a grown-up."

zh: 今天，全家到山上野餐。森林裡好安靜，只聽見鳥兒啾啾叫。走著走著，嘩啦嘩啦！前面有一條小溪。溪水亮晶晶的，像在對人招手。{name}跑到草地上，眼睛都亮了。
「我想去玩水！」{name}拉著媽媽說。媽媽正在鋪野餐墊，手上拿著水壺。「等我一下喔，我要看著你玩。」{name}點點頭，站在野餐墊旁邊等。{he}數著樹上的松果，一、二、三……
媽媽放好籃子，走了過來。她拿出一件橘色的救生衣。「穿上它，就像穿上會浮的外套。」{name}把手伸進去，媽媽幫忙扣好扣子。喀、喀、喀！{name}覺得自己像個勇敢的探險家。
媽媽牽著{name}，慢慢走到溪邊。她指著淺淺的地方。「在腳踩得到的地方玩。」{name}踩進水裡，哇，涼涼的！小魚游過{his}腳邊，癢癢的。水只到{his}膝蓋，好安心。
溪邊有好多扁扁的石頭。{name}撿起一顆，放進淺水裡。再放一顆，又放一顆。「看！是踏石星星！」石頭排成一條彎彎的小路。{name}一步一步跳過去，媽媽在岸邊拍手。
這時，表哥小傑也來了。他也穿著救生衣，在旁邊玩。突然，小傑的腳一滑，坐進水裡。水流推著他，他抓不到石頭。小傑大叫：「救命！」{name}心裡怦怦跳。
{name}沒有跳進水裡。{he}大聲喊：「媽媽！快來！」{he}抓起旁邊的游泳圈，用力丟過去。游泳圈浮呀浮，飄到小傑身邊。小傑緊緊抱住它。媽媽馬上跑來，把小傑拉上岸。
小傑笑了：「謝謝你，{name}！」媽媽摸摸{name}的頭：「你做得真好。」太陽慢慢下山，森林變成金黃色。大家坐在野餐墊上吃三明治。{name}看著溪裡的踏石星星，開心地笑了。
en: Today the family has a picnic in the mountains. The forest is quiet. Birds go tweet, tweet. Then, splish, splash! There is a little stream ahead. The water sparkles in the sun. {name} runs onto the grass, eyes shining.

"Can I play in the water?" {name} asks Mom. Mom is spreading the picnic blanket. "Wait for me, please. I want to watch you play." {name} nods and waits by the blanket. {he} counts pinecones in the tree. One, two, three...

Mom puts down the basket and comes over. She holds up a bright orange life vest. "It's like a coat that floats." {name} slips {his} arms inside. Mom does up the buckles. Click, click, click! {name} feels like a brave explorer.

Mom holds {name}'s hand. They walk slowly to the stream. Mom points to a shallow spot. "Play where your feet can touch." {name} steps in. Ooh, it's cool! Tiny fish tickle {his} toes. The water only reaches {his} knees.

There are many flat stones by the stream. {name} sets one in the shallow water. Then another, and another. "Look! Stepping-stone stars!" The stones make a curvy little path. {name} hops across. Mom claps from the bank.

Cousin Jack comes to play too. He wears a life vest as well. Suddenly, Jack slips and sits down in the water. The current pushes him along. He can't grab a stone. "Help!" Jack shouts. {name}'s heart goes thump, thump.
{name} does not jump in. {he} shouts, "Mom! Come quick!" {name} grabs the swim ring nearby. {he} throws it hard. The ring floats over to Jack. Jack hugs it tight. Mom runs over and helps Jack out.

"Thank you, {name}!" Jack says with a grin. Mom smiles. "You did just right." The sun sinks low, and the forest turns gold. Everyone eats sandwiches on the blanket. {name} looks at the stepping-stone stars and smiles.

questions: {name}想玩水的時候，為什麼要先等媽媽？
小傑滑倒時，{name}做了哪兩件事？如果是你，你會怎麼做？
你下次去河邊或海邊玩，要在哪裡玩、穿什麼？
zh.tip: 這週玩個「喊大人、丟浮東西」小遊戲：大人說「朋友在水裡需要幫忙！」，孩子練習大聲喊「大人快來！」並丟出一顆枕頭。

questions: Why did {name} wait for Mom before playing in the water?
What two things did {name} do when Jack slipped? What would you do?
Next time you play at a river or beach, where will you play and what will you wear?
en.tip: This week, play a quick "shout and throw" game: you say "A friend needs help in the water!" and your child practices shouting "Grown-up, come quick!" and tossing a pillow.

zh: 暑假到了，{name}跟著舅舅和表姊小葵、表弟阿豆來到墾丁。海水藍得像打翻的顏料，沙灘燙得大家跳來跳去。{name}抱著游泳圈，興奮得迫不及待，只想立刻衝進浪花裡。
「先別急，」舅舅指著遠方說，「看到那兩支紅黃相間的旗子嗎？」高高的瞭望台上，救生員哥哥戴著帽子，正對他們揮手。{name}瞇起眼睛，發現旗子一左一右，中間的海面閃閃發亮。
救生員哥哥走過來，笑著說：「兩支旗子中間，是我眼睛一直盯著的地方。」他又指向另一邊插著的紅旗：「那裡的水流很調皮，會把人悄悄拉走。」{name}點點頭，把兩種旗子牢牢記在心裡。
舅舅幫每個人穿好救生衣，拉緊扣帶，「喀嚓」一聲。「我們只玩到水到腰的地方，腳要踩得到沙。」舅舅站在淺水裡，像一座穩穩的燈塔。{name}在兩支旗子中間跳浪，海水一波波撲來，大家笑得東倒西歪。
阿豆躺在他的鯊魚造型浮板上曬太陽，舒服得快睡著了。誰知一陣風颳來，浮板竟然被吹得越漂越遠！阿豆已經回到岸邊喝水，可是浮板上還放著他最心愛的小水壺。「我的鯊魚！」阿豆急得直跺腳。
{name}心頭一緊，雙腳差點就要往前衝。可是{he}想起那支紅旗，想起舅舅說的「腳要踩得到沙」。{name}深吸一口氣，轉身朝瞭望台大喊：「救生員哥哥！東西漂走了！」聲音大得連海鷗都嚇得飛起來。
救生員哥哥立刻跑來，舅舅也大步走近。這時{name}看見沙灘上掛著一個橘色救生圈，連忙抱給救生員。「拋這個可以嗎？」救生員哥哥豎起大拇指，用力一拋，救生圈穩穩落在浮板旁，再把繩子一圈圈拉回來，鯊魚浮板竟然被勾回岸邊了！
阿豆抱著浮板和小水壺，破涕為笑。救生員哥哥拍拍{name}的肩膀：「你做得比很多大人還好，大喊、拋會浮的東西，自己留在岸上。」夕陽把海染成橘子色，大家牽著手走回民宿，{name}在心裡偷偷決定，明天還要再看一次那兩支旗子。
en: It was summer break, and {name} went to Kenting with Uncle Wei and two cousins, Kuei and little Dou. The sea was as blue as spilled paint, and the hot sand made everyone hop. {name} hugged a swim ring, itching to run straight into the waves.

"Hold on," said Uncle Wei, pointing. "See those two red-and-yellow flags?" On a tall chair sat a lifeguard in a wide hat, waving at them. {name} squinted. One flag stood on the left, one on the right, and the water between them sparkled.

The lifeguard strolled over with a grin. "Between those flags is where my eyes never leave," he said. Then he pointed to a plain red flag farther away. "Over there, the water is sneaky. It can tug you out without a sound." {name} nodded and remembered both flags.

Uncle Wei buckled everyone into life jackets. Click! "We stay where the water reaches our waists and our feet touch the sand." He stood in the shallows like a steady lighthouse. {name} jumped waves between the flags, and everyone laughed until they tumbled over.

Dou had been floating on his shark-shaped board, sleepy in the sun. Then he waded back to shore for a drink, leaving his favorite little bottle on the board. Suddenly a gust of wind pushed the shark out, farther and farther. "My shark!" Dou wailed, stomping his feet.

{name}'s heart jumped, and {his} feet almost ran forward. But {name} remembered the red flag and Uncle Wei's words about feet touching the sand. Taking a deep breath, {name} turned to the tall chair and shouted, "Lifeguard! Something's drifting away!" It was so loud the seagulls flapped off.

The lifeguard sprinted over, and Uncle Wei hurried close. Then {name} spotted an orange ring hanging by the sand and carried it to the lifeguard. "Can we throw this?" He gave a thumbs-up and threw it. The ring landed right beside the board, and with one careful pull of the rope, the shark came sliding back!

Dou hugged his shark and his bottle, smiling through his tears. The lifeguard patted {name}'s shoulder. "You shouted, you found something that floats, and you stayed on shore. Perfect." As the sunset turned the sea orange, everyone walked back hand in hand, and {name} planned to check the flags again tomorrow.

questions: 阿豆的浮板漂走時，{name}做了哪兩件事？為什麼沒有自己游過去？
下次去海邊或游泳池，玩水前你要先找誰、穿上什麼？
如果朋友在水裡需要幫忙，你可以拋什麼會浮的東西？
zh.tip: 這週玩一個「大喊加拋拋」遊戲：一人假裝在水裡，孩子練習大喊「大人快來！」並拋出枕頭或球。下次出遊前，一起找找救生員和旗子在哪裡。

questions: When Dou's board drifted away, what two things did {name} do? Why didn't {name} swim after it?
Next time you go to the beach or pool, who do you find first, and what do you wear?
If a friend needs help in the water, what floating things could you throw?
en.tip: This week, play a "shout and throw" game: one person pretends to be in the water while your child practices shouting "Grown-up, come quick!" and tossing a pillow or ball. On your next trip, look for the lifeguard and the flags together first.

zh: 滾呀滾，咕嚕嚕！{name}的小球滾進沙發底下。{name}趴下來看一看。小熊也跟著趴下來。暗暗的，小小的。咦？那是什麼呢？
{name}伸手摸一摸。摸到一個小瓶子！瓶子裡有圓圓的顆粒。紅色的，黃色的，還有綠色的。搖一搖，沙沙沙。好像糖果喔！
{name}看看小熊。小熊也看看{name}。「這是糖果嗎？」{name}小聲問。可是瓶子不像糖果袋。上面有小小的字。{name}看不懂。
{name}想起媽媽說過的話。「藥藥會長得像糖果。」「不知道的東西，不放進嘴巴。」{name}點點頭，把瓶蓋拿得好好的。不打開，也不嚐。
「小熊，我們出任務！」{name}抱起小熊。一隻手拿瓶子，一隻手抱小熊。噠噠噠，走過客廳。廚房沒有媽媽，只有滴答響的時鐘。
噠噠噠，走到陽台門邊。媽媽不在陽台上。再走到臥室門口。房間裡傳來哼歌聲，啦啦啦。是媽媽！媽媽正在摺衣服。
「媽媽，我找到這個！」{name}把瓶子交給媽媽。媽媽看一看，眼睛亮亮的。「這是維他命，不是糖果。謝謝你拿來給我看！」媽媽給{name}一個大大的抱抱。
媽媽把瓶子放回高高的櫃子上。那裡只有大人的手摸得到。「要吃藥時，媽媽會給你。」{name}笑了，小熊也像在笑。媽媽拿出真的糖果，三個一起吃點心。任務完成！
en: Roll, roll, bump! {name}'s little ball rolls under the sofa. {name} lies down to look. Teddy lies down too. It is dark and small. Oh! What is that?
{name} reaches in. It is a little bottle! Inside are round, tiny dots. Red ones, yellow ones, green ones too. Shake, shake, rattle. They look like candy!
{name} looks at Teddy. Teddy looks at {name}. "Is this candy?" {name} whispers. But it is not a candy bag. It has tiny words on it.
{name} remembers what Mom said. "Medicine can look like candy." "Don't taste things you don't know." {name} nods and keeps the lid shut tight. No opening, no tasting.
"Teddy, it's mission time!" {name} picks Teddy up. One hand holds the bottle. One arm hugs Teddy. Tap, tap, tap, across the room. The kitchen is empty. Tick, tock goes the clock.
Tap, tap, tap, to the balcony door. Mom is not there. Then to the bedroom door. Someone is humming, la, la, la. It's Mom! She is folding clothes.
"Mom, I found this!" {name} gives Mom the bottle. Mom looks and smiles. "These are vitamins, not candy. Thank you for bringing them!" Mom gives {name} a big hug.

Mom puts the bottle up high. Only grown-up hands reach there. "I'll give you medicine when you need it." {name} grins. Teddy seems to grin too. Then Mom brings real snacks for all three. Mission complete!

questions: {name}找到小瓶子時，做了什麼？
糖果和藥藥有時候長得很像，我們要怎麼辦？
如果你在家裡找到小瓶子，你會去找誰？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子玩「找大人任務」：放一個空瓶子，讓孩子找到後拿給你看，並一起說「不嚐，找大人！」。

questions: What did {name} do after finding the little bottle?
Candy and medicine can look alike. What should we do?
If you found a bottle at home, who would you bring?
en.tip: This week, play a "Find a Grown-Up" game: hide an empty, clean bottle, and when your child finds it, have them bring it to you while you both say, "No tasting, get a grown-up!"

zh: 今天是颱風天，學校放假了！一大早，窗外的風呼呼地吹。樹枝搖來搖去，雨點打在玻璃上，答答答。{name}跑到客廳，眼睛亮亮的。爸爸笑著說：「今天我們要一起完成三個任務喔！」
第一個任務，是搶救陽台的小盆栽。爸爸打開落地窗，風一下子衝了進來。爸爸說：「你站在門邊，我把盆栽遞給你。」{name}站在門邊，小心接過小番茄、薄荷和小仙人掌，一盆一盆排在客廳地上。
爸爸最後搬進那盆大大的九重葛，趕快把窗戶關好。「任務一完成！」爸爸和{name}擊掌。小薄荷的葉子還在發抖，{name}輕輕摸摸它說：「別怕，你現在在家裡了。」
第二個任務，是準備好多好多水。媽媽拿出空水壺和大水瓶，{name}把它們排成一排。媽媽在廚房裝水，{name}負責把蓋子轉緊。一瓶、兩瓶、三瓶，像一排站得直直的小士兵。
第三個任務最像探險：找手電筒！爸爸說它躲在家裡某個地方。{name}找了沙發底下，沒有。又找了鞋櫃，也沒有。最後在走廊的抽屜裡，{name}找到了它！按一下開關，一道亮光照在牆上。
這時候，風吼得更大聲了。{name}跑到窗邊說：「我想出去看看大風！」爸爸牽起{his}小手，帶{him}離開窗戶。「颱風天外面很危險，河邊和海邊都不能去。等颱風走了，大人說安全，我們再出去。」
「那我們在家裡探險吧！」媽媽抱來好多毯子和枕頭。爸爸用椅子當柱子，{name}把毯子蓋上去。一座軟綿綿的毯子城堡蓋好了，就在離窗戶遠遠的客廳中間。
一家人鑽進城堡裡，打開手電筒。外面的風呼呼地唱，雨嘩啦啦地打鼓。{name}靠在爸爸媽媽身邊，聽著颱風的聲音，一點也不怕。「這是最棒的颱風天探險！」{name}開心地說。
en: Today was a typhoon day, so there was no school! Outside, the wind went whoosh. Branches swayed, and rain tapped on the glass. {name} ran to the living room. Dad smiled. "Today we have three missions!"

Mission one was to rescue the balcony plants. Dad opened the door, and the wind rushed in. "Stay by the door," Dad said. "I'll hand them to you." {name} carefully took the tomato, the mint, and the tiny cactus.

Last, Dad carried in the big flower pot and shut the door tight. "Mission one, done!" Dad and {name} gave a high five. The mint leaves still trembled. {name} patted them gently. "Don't worry. You're inside now."

Mission two was to get lots of water ready. Mom brought out empty bottles, and {name} lined them up. Mom filled them in the kitchen. {name} twisted each cap on tight. One, two, three bottles stood in a row, like little soldiers.

Mission three felt like a real adventure: find the flashlight! Dad said it was hiding somewhere. {name} checked under the sofa. No. The shoe cabinet? No. At last, {name} found it in the hallway drawer! Click! A bright beam lit the wall.

Then the wind roared even louder. {name} ran to the window. "I want to go out and see the wind!" Dad took {his} hand and led {him} away from the glass. "It's not safe outside today. No rivers, no beaches. We'll go out when grown-ups say it's safe."

"Then let's explore inside!" said Mom. She brought blankets and pillows. Dad set up chairs as posts, and {name} spread the blankets over them. Soon a cozy blanket fort stood in the middle of the room, far from the windows.

The family crawled inside and switched on the flashlight. Outside, the wind sang and the rain drummed. {name} snuggled between Mom and Dad, listening to the storm, safe and warm. "This is the best typhoon adventure ever!" {name} said.

questions: {name}幫家人完成了哪三個颱風天任務？
風很大的時候，爸爸為什麼帶{name}離開窗戶？
如果你想出去看大風，你可以怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起找出家裡的手電筒放在哪裡，並練習說：「颱風天，我們待在家，等大人說安全再出去。」

questions: What three typhoon missions did {name} help the family with?
Why did Dad lead {name} away from the window when the wind was strong?
What could you do if you wanted to go out and see the wind?
en.tip: This week, find your home's flashlight together and practice saying, "On typhoon days we stay home until grown-ups say it's safe."

zh: 星期六下午，{name}窩在客廳的沙發上，平板裡開著最愛的線上畫畫遊戲「彩虹島」。這一關的任務是畫出一座漂浮城堡，{name}全神貫注，一筆一畫勾勒出高塔、吊橋，還有一條繞著雲朵飛翔的紙龍。媽媽在廚房烤餅乾，奶油香氣飄滿整個屋子，真是個完美的冒險午後。
作品一上傳，聊天框就「叮」地跳出訊息。一個叫「星狐」的玩家寫著：「哇，你的紙龍畫得出神入化！你一定是天才小畫家！」{name}心裡像放了煙火，嘴角忍不住上揚。接下來幾關，星狐一直送來閃亮的星星貼圖，還教{name}怎麼用漸層讓天空更夢幻。兩人一來一往，聊得不亦樂乎。
過了一會兒，星狐又傳來訊息：「你讀哪一所學校呀？我說不定就住在你家附近喔。」{name}的手指停在螢幕上方。接著又跳出一行字：「傳一張自拍給我嘛，我想看看大畫家長什麼樣子。這是我們兩個的小祕密，別告訴爸爸媽媽喔。」
{name}盯著螢幕，眉頭慢慢皺起來。學校的名字？自拍？還要保密？這些問題跟畫城堡一點關係也沒有。肚子裡像有一隻小蝴蝶在亂撲，怪怪的。{name}想起，真正的朋友才不會要人瞞著家人。於是{name}只回了一句：「我不能說。」然後放下平板，深吸一口氣。
「媽媽，可以來看一下嗎？」{name}拿著平板走進廚房。媽媽擦擦手，仔細讀完每一則訊息，然後蹲下來，給了{name}一個大大的擁抱。「你做得太好了，什麼資料都沒說，還馬上來找我。不管在網路上遇到什麼，都可以來告訴我，你不會被罵的。」{name}心裡的小蝴蝶，一下子安靜了。
媽媽和{name}並肩坐下，像兩個偵探一樣展開行動。她們先截圖留下證據，再一起找到「封鎖」和「檢舉」的按鈕。{name}親手按下去，星狐的名字瞬間從清單上消失。媽媽說：「網路另一頭的人，不一定是他說的那個人。說住附近、想見面的，更要小心。」{name}點點頭，心想：原來那隻「星狐」，也許根本不是小朋友呢。
烤箱「叮」的一聲，餅乾出爐了。{name}咬了一口熱呼呼的餅乾，重新打開彩虹島，把城堡的大門畫成一道閃閃發亮的盾牌。媽媽笑著問那是什麼，{name}得意地說：「這是防護盾，只有家人知道密碼！」這場午後冒險，{name}成了守護自己的小勇士。
en: On Saturday afternoon, {name} curled up on the living room couch with the tablet, playing a favorite online drawing game called Rainbow Isle. Today's quest was to draw a floating castle. {name} concentrated hard, sketching tall towers, a drawbridge, and a paper dragon swooping through the clouds. In the kitchen, Mom was baking cookies, and buttery smells drifted through the house.

The moment the picture was posted, a chat bubble popped up. A player called StarFox wrote, "Wow, your dragon is amazing! You must be a genius artist!" {name} felt like fireworks were going off inside. For the next few levels, StarFox sent sparkly star stickers and even shared a trick for making skies glow with color. The two of them chatted happily.

After a while, a new message appeared. "Which school do you go to? Maybe I live near you!" {name}'s finger froze above the screen. Then another line blinked up: "Send me a selfie. I want to see what the great artist looks like. This is our little secret, okay? Don't tell your parents."

{name} stared at the screen and slowly frowned. A school name? A selfie? A secret? None of that had anything to do with drawing castles. A fluttery, uneasy feeling wriggled in {his} stomach. Real friends don't ask you to hide things from your family. So {name} typed just four words, "I can't share that," set the tablet down, and took a deep breath.

"Mom, can you look at something?" {name} carried the tablet into the kitchen. Mom wiped her hands and read every message carefully. Then she knelt down and gave {name} a big hug. "You did exactly right. You didn't share anything, and you came straight to me. Whatever happens online, you can always tell me. You won't be in trouble."

Side by side, like two detectives, they got to work. First they took screenshots as evidence. Then they found the Block and Report buttons together, and {name} pressed them. StarFox vanished from the list. "People online aren't always who they say they are," Mom said. "Especially someone who says they live nearby or wants to meet." {name} nodded. Maybe StarFox wasn't a kid at all.

Ding! The cookies were ready. {name} munched a warm one and opened Rainbow Isle again, turning the castle gate into a shining shield. When Mom asked what it was, {name} grinned. "It's a safety shield. Only family knows the password!" That afternoon's adventure had turned {name} into a brave guardian of {his} own castle.

questions: 星狐問學校和要自拍的時候，{name}做了什麼？為什麼？
如果網路上有人要你保守祕密，你會怎麼做？
你覺得在網路上可以跟遊戲朋友分享哪些事，哪些不行？
zh.tip: x

questions: What did {name} do when StarFox asked about school and a selfie?
What would you do if someone online asked you to keep a secret?
en.tip: This week, sit together and practice finding the Block and Report buttons in a game or app your child uses, and agree on a family phrase like "Something feels weird, can you look?"

zh: 海邊好藍好藍。浪花嘩啦啦。{name}穿上新泳衣。泳衣上有小鯨魚。一隻，兩隻，三隻。小鯨魚噴水，噗噗噗！{name}開心轉圈圈。
媽媽輕輕唱歌：「小鯨魚，游呀游。泳衣蓋住的地方，是{name}自己的。不給別人看，不給別人摸。」{name}跟著唱：「是我的！是我的！」
媽媽牽著{name}的手。一起走進淺淺的水。浪來了，嘩啦啦！浪走了，沙沙沙。{name}踢踢小腳。小鯨魚也在游泳。
回到沙灘上，{name}要蓋城堡。挖挖挖，拍拍拍。哎呀，城堡倒了！{name}嘟起小嘴巴。媽媽笑著說：「再試一次吧。」
這次{name}慢慢拍。拍一下，再拍一下。城堡站起來了！{name}插上小貝殼。「我做到了！」媽媽拍拍手。
表哥小安跑過來。他幫{name}搔癢癢。哈哈哈，哈哈哈！一直搔，不停下。{name}大聲說：「停！我不要了！」小安馬上停手。「好，對不起喔。」
媽媽抱抱{name}。「說得真好！不喜歡就說不要。心裡怪怪的，就告訴媽媽。」{name}點點頭。太陽慢慢下山了。該回家囉。
回到家，媽媽放好溫水。媽媽幫{name}洗澡澡。洗得香香的，暖暖的。媽媽輕輕唱：「洗澡、看醫生，媽媽都在旁邊。」{name}抱著小鯨魚泳衣。晚安，小鯨魚。
en: The sea is blue, so blue. Splash, splash go the waves. {name} wears a new swimsuit. It has little whales on it. One, two, three whales! Puff, puff, they spout. {name} spins around and giggles.
Mom sings a soft song. "Little whales, swim and play. What your swimsuit covers is yours. Nobody looks. Nobody touches." {name} sings too. "It's mine! It's mine!"
Mom holds {name}'s hand. They step into the shallow water. Here comes a wave, whoosh! There it goes, shhh. {name} kicks little feet. The whales are swimming too.
Back on the sand, {name} builds a castle. Dig, dig, pat, pat. Oh no, it falls down! {name} makes a little pout. Mom smiles. "Let's try again."
This time {name} pats slowly. Pat, and pat again. The castle stands up tall! {name} adds a little shell. "I did it!" Mom claps and claps.
Cousin Sam runs over. He tickles {name}. Ha ha ha! Ha ha ha! The tickles do not stop. {name} says loudly, "Stop! I don't want that!" Sam stops right away. "Okay, sorry."
Mom gives {name} a hug. "You said it so well! Say no when you don't like it. Feel funny inside? Tell Mom." {name} nods. The sun goes down slowly. Time to go home.

At home, Mom fills a warm bath. Mom helps {name} wash. Clean and cozy, warm and snug. Mom sings, "Bath time, doctor time, Mom is right there." {name} hugs the whale swimsuit. Goodnight, little whales.

questions: 媽媽唱的歌說，泳衣蓋住的地方是誰的？
小安一直搔癢，{name}怎麼做？
如果你覺得不舒服，或有人要你保守讓你擔心的秘密，你會告訴誰？
zh.tip: 今晚洗澡時，和孩子一起唱小鯨魚的歌，並練習大聲說「停！我不要！」。也可以告訴孩子：驚喜可以保密，讓人擔心的秘密一定要說；大人若需要協助，可撥打113保護專線。

questions: In Mom's song, who do the parts your swimsuit covers belong to?
What did {name} do when Sam's tickles wouldn't stop?
If something feels funny, or someone asks you to keep a worrying secret, who would you tell?
en.tip: At bath time tonight, sing the little whale song together and practice saying "Stop! I don't want that!" in a big voice. Explain that surprises can be kept, but worrying secrets are always told to a grown-up; adults in Taiwan who need help can call the 113 child protection hotline.

zh: 今天幼兒園好熱鬧。大家都帶了小熊來。林老師笑著說：「我們來幫小熊做泳衣吧！」{name}抱著棕色小熊，眼睛亮亮的。桌上有彩色紙、剪刀和膠水。
{name}想剪一件藍色泳衣。可是剪刀不聽話，紙歪歪的。{name}嘆了一口氣，好想放棄。旁邊的小安說：「慢慢來，我陪你。」{name}點點頭，再剪一次。
這次{name}剪得很慢、很小心。藍色泳衣終於剪好了！{name}還貼上一顆黃色星星。穿在小熊身上，剛剛好。{name}開心得拍拍手。
林老師舉起自己的小熊說：「泳衣蓋住的地方，是很特別的地方。那是屬於你自己的，叫做隱私的地方。」小朋友摸摸小熊的泳衣，認真地聽。
林老師又問：「如果有人想看或摸那裡，怎麼辦？」{name}舉手說：「說不要，然後告訴大人！」老師點頭：「對！就算對方叫你保密，也可以說。那不是你的錯。」
小安問：「那洗澡的時候呢？」老師說：「爸爸媽媽幫你洗澡，是為了乾淨。醫生檢查，是為了健康，爸媽也會在旁邊。」{name}把小熊抱得緊緊的。
過了幾天，{name}和爸爸去診所做健康檢查。醫生阿姨笑著說：「我每一步都會先告訴你喔。」她聽聽心跳，看看耳朵。爸爸一直牽著{name}的手。
醫生說：「現在要看看肚子下面，確定你很健康。」{name}看看爸爸，爸爸點點頭。{name}想起小熊的泳衣，小聲說：「這是為了健康，爸爸也在。」檢查很快就好了。回家路上，{name}抱著小熊，笑得好甜。
en: Kindergarten was busy today. Everyone brought a teddy bear. Ms. Lin smiled. "Let's make swimsuits for our bears!" {name} hugged a brown bear. The table had colored paper, scissors, and glue.

{name} wanted a blue swimsuit. But the scissors went wobbly. The paper came out crooked. {name} sighed and almost gave up. A classmate named Ann said, "Go slowly. I'll help." {name} nodded and tried again.
This time {name} cut slowly and carefully. The blue swimsuit was finished! {name} added a yellow star sticker. It fit the bear just right. {name} clapped with joy.
Ms. Lin held up her own bear. "The parts a swimsuit covers are special. They belong to you. We call them private parts." The children touched their bears' swimsuits and listened.
"What if someone wants to see or touch there?" asked Ms. Lin. {name} raised a hand. "Say no, and tell a grown-up!" "Yes!" said Ms. Lin. "Even if they say keep it secret. It's never your fault."
Ann asked, "What about bath time?" Ms. Lin said, "Parents help you get clean. Doctors check you to stay healthy. And your parent is right there." {name} hugged the bear tight.

A few days later, {name} went to the clinic with Dad. The doctor smiled. "I'll tell you each step first." She listened to {his} heartbeat. She looked in {his} ears. Dad held {name}'s hand the whole time.

"Now I'll check below your tummy to make sure you're healthy," said the doctor. {name} looked at Dad. Dad nodded. {name} remembered the bear's swimsuit. "It's for staying healthy, and Dad is here." Soon it was done. On the way home, {name} smiled big.

questions: 小熊的泳衣蓋住的地方，為什麼很特別？
如果有人想看或摸那裡，{name}說應該怎麼做？你會怎麼做？
在診所時，為什麼{name}覺得那次檢查是可以的？
zh.tip: 今晚洗澡時，和孩子一起練習說「這是我的身體，不要！」，並告訴孩子任何事都可以來找你說。若成人需要協助，可撥打113保護專線。

questions: Why are the parts the bear's swimsuit covers special?
What did {name} say to do if someone wants to see or touch there? What would you do?
At the clinic, why did {name} feel the check-up was okay?
en.tip: At bath time tonight, practice saying "This is my body. No!" together, and remind your child they can tell you anything. Adults in Taiwan who need help can call the 113 protection hotline.

zh: 城市的街角有一間鄰里運動中心，玻璃窗裡的游泳池閃閃發亮。星期六早上，媽媽牽著{name}的手走進去，{name}要開始上游泳課了。小表弟阿樂也跟著來，他抱著一條印著小鯨魚的藍色浴巾，好奇地東張西望。
教練是笑咪咪的林老師。她說：「第一課，我們先學把臉放進水裡吐泡泡。」{name}深吸一口氣，把臉埋進水裡，可是水跑進鼻子，{he}嗆得咳個不停。{name}有點想放棄，但看見媽媽在池邊比讚，就又試了一次。
一次、兩次、三次……第五次的時候，{name}終於吐出一串圓圓的泡泡，咕嚕咕嚕地浮上水面。林老師拍拍手說：「你很有毅力，一直沒有放棄！」{name}笑得好開心，覺得自己像一條勇敢的小魚。
下課後，大家到更衣室換衣服。阿樂指著{name}的泳衣問：「為什麼游泳一定要穿這個？」媽媽蹲下來說：「泳衣蓋住的地方，是每個人的隱私部位，只屬於自己。別人不可以要求看或摸，也不可以要你看或摸他們的。」
阿樂眨眨眼睛，好像還不太懂。{name}想了一想，拿起阿樂的小鯨魚浴巾，披在{his}肩膀上，說：「我們來玩披風遊戲！我是泳衣守護隊長。浴巾披風會保護泳衣蓋住的地方，那裡是你的祕密基地，你就是基地的主人。」
「那要是有人想進基地呢？」阿樂問。{name}雙手叉腰，大聲說：「就說『不可以！』然後跑去告訴爸爸媽媽或老師。就算是搔癢搔不停、不想要的抱抱，或是叫你保守讓你擔心的祕密，也都可以說不，而且絕對不是你的錯。」
阿樂又問：「可是我洗澡的時候，媽媽會幫我洗呀？」{name}點點頭：「那是為了讓身體乾淨。還有醫生檢查的時候，爸爸媽媽會在旁邊，醫生也會說明為什麼要看。這是為了健康，不一樣喔！」媽媽在一旁微笑，輕輕摸了摸{name}的頭。
回家的路上，阿樂披著小鯨魚浴巾，一路喊著：「我是基地的主人！」{name}牽著媽媽的手，心裡暖暖的。今天，{he}學會了吐泡泡，也學會了當一個好隊長。下星期，{name}還想學會踢水呢！
en: On a busy city corner stood a neighborhood sports center, its pool sparkling behind big glass windows. One Saturday morning, Mom walked {name} inside for a first swimming lesson. Little cousin Leo came too, hugging a blue towel covered in tiny whales and staring at everything.

The coach, Ms. Lin, had a friendly smile. "Today we'll learn to put our faces in the water and blow bubbles," she said. {name} took a deep breath and dipped down, but water rushed up into {his} nose. Coughing, {name} wanted to quit, then saw Mom giving a thumbs-up and tried again.

Once, twice, three times. On the fifth try, a line of round bubbles went gurgling up to the surface! Ms. Lin clapped. "You kept going and never gave up!" {name} grinned from ear to ear, feeling like a brave little fish.

After class, everyone went to the changing room. Leo pointed at {name}'s swimsuit. "Why do we have to wear these?" Mom knelt down. "The parts your swimsuit covers are private, and they belong to you. Nobody should ask to see or touch them, or ask you to see or touch theirs."
