Leo blinked, still puzzled. {name} had an idea and draped Leo's whale towel over {his} shoulders like a cape. "Let's play a game! I'm Captain of the Swimsuit Guard. My cape protects the parts a swimsuit covers. That's your secret base, and you're the boss of it."

"What if someone wants to get into my base?" Leo asked. {name} put hands on hips. "Say 'No!' in a big voice, then go tell Mom, Dad, or a teacher. You can say no to a tickle that won't stop, a hug you don't want, or a secret that worries you. And it's never your fault."

"But Mom helps me in the bath," Leo said. {name} nodded. "That's to keep you clean. And when the doctor checks you, your mom or dad is right there, and the doctor tells you why. That's for staying healthy, so it's different!" Mom smiled and gently patted {name}'s head.

On the walk home, Leo wore the whale towel and shouted, "I'm the boss of my base!" Holding Mom's hand, {name} felt warm inside. Today {he} had learned to blow bubbles and to be a great captain. Next week, {name} wanted to learn to kick, too!

questions: {name}用浴巾披風跟阿樂說了什麼？泳衣蓋住的地方屬於誰？
如果有人搔癢搔不停，或要你保守讓你擔心的祕密，你會怎麼做？會告訴誰？
什麼時候大人可以幫忙碰觸泳衣蓋住的地方？為什麼？
zh.tip: 今晚洗澡時，和孩子一起玩「基地主人」遊戲，練習大聲說「不可以！」並一起說出三位可以求助的大人。若您需要協助，可撥打 113 保護專線。

questions: What did {name} tell Leo with the towel cape? Who do the parts your swimsuit covers belong to?
What would you do if a tickle wouldn't stop or someone asked you to keep a worrying secret? Who would you tell?
When is it okay for a grown-up to help with the parts your swimsuit covers, and why?
en.tip: At bath time tonight, play the 'boss of my base' game: practice a big 'No!' together and name three grown-ups your child can tell. If you need support, Taiwan's 113 child protection hotline can help.

zh: 星期六早上，爸爸小聲說：「{name}，我們來做一個祕密計畫。」{name}眨眨眼睛，靠過去聽。爸爸說：「下星期是奶奶生日，我們偷偷幫她做蛋糕，給她一個驚喜！」{name}開心得跳起來，又趕快捂住嘴巴，嘻嘻笑。
每天下午，{name}和爸爸躲在廚房練習。{name}負責攪拌麵糊，手臂好痠，可是沒有停。第一次，麵糊灑到桌上，黏答答的。爸爸笑著遞來抹布，說：「沒關係，再試一次。」第二次，{name}慢慢攪，麵糊變得又滑又亮。
奶奶來家裡喝茶，問：「你們在忙什麼呀？」{name}心裡癢癢的，好想說出來。可是{he}想到奶奶驚喜的笑臉，就忍住了，只說：「是秘密喔！」這個祕密讓{name}心裡暖暖的，像藏著一顆小太陽。爸爸偷偷比了一個讚。
有一天，媽媽帶{name}去公園玩。媽媽坐在長椅上，看著{name}溜滑梯。一個大哥哥走過來，小聲說：「我剛剛拿了別人的球。你看到了，不准說，永遠都不能告訴別人。」說完，他就跑走了，留下{name}站在原地。
{name}的肚子突然扭來扭去，好像打了一個結。{he}不想再溜滑梯了，慢慢走回長椅邊。這個祕密一點都不暖，反而冷冷的、沉沉的。{name}想起蛋糕的祕密，很快就會說出來，大家都會笑。可是這個祕密，大哥哥說要「永遠」藏著。
{name}拉拉媽媽的衣角，深深吸一口氣。「媽媽，有人叫我保守一個祕密，可是我肚子怪怪的。」媽媽蹲下來，看著{name}的眼睛，輕輕說：「謝謝你告訴我。你可以把它說出來。」{name}就把大哥哥的話，一句一句說給媽媽聽。
媽媽溫柔地抱住{name}。「你做得很好，這不是你的錯，你也不會被罵。」媽媽陪{name}去找公園的管理員，一起幫小朋友找回那顆球。回家的路上，{name}的肚子不再打結了，腳步變得好輕好輕，像一根小羽毛。
奶奶生日那天，{name}和爸爸端出蛋糕，大喊：「驚喜！」奶奶睜大眼睛，笑得好開心。蠟燭亮晶晶的，大家一起唱生日快樂歌，拍手歡呼。{name}看著奶奶的笑臉，心想：好祕密，說出來的時候，大家都會笑呢。
en: On Saturday morning, Dad whispered, "{name}, let's make a secret plan." {name} leaned close. "Grandma's birthday is next week. Let's bake her a surprise cake!" {name} jumped with joy. Then {he} covered {his} mouth and giggled.

Every afternoon, {name} and Dad practiced in the kitchen. {name} stirred the batter. Stirring made {his} arm tired, but {name} kept going. The first time, batter splashed everywhere. Dad smiled and passed a cloth. "That's okay. Try again." The second time, {name} stirred slowly. The batter turned smooth and shiny.

Grandma came over for tea. "What are you two up to?" she asked. {name} really wanted to tell. But {he} pictured Grandma's surprised smile. "It's a secret!" {name} said. That secret felt warm, like a tiny sun inside. Dad gave a quiet thumbs-up.

One day, Mom took {name} to the playground. Mom sat on a bench nearby, watching {name} slide. A bigger boy came close and whispered. "I took someone's ball. You saw it. Don't tell. Never, ever tell anyone." Then he ran off.

Suddenly, {name}'s tummy felt twisty, like a knot. {name} didn't want to slide anymore. This secret wasn't warm. It felt cold and heavy. {name} thought about the cake secret. That one would be shared soon, and everyone would smile. But this one was meant to stay hidden forever.

{name} tugged Mom's sleeve and took a deep breath. "Mom, someone told me to keep a secret. It makes my tummy feel funny." Mom knelt down and looked at {name} kindly. "Thank you for telling me. You can share it with me." So {name} told her everything.

Mom gave {name} a big, gentle hug. "You did the right thing. It's not your fault, and you're not in trouble." Together, they found the park helper. Soon the little ball was back with its owner. On the way home, {name}'s tummy felt calm. {name} skipped along, light as a feather.

On Grandma's birthday, {name} and Dad carried out the cake. "Surprise!" they shouted. Grandma's eyes went wide, and she laughed with delight. The candles sparkled. Everyone sang and clapped and cheered. {name} watched Grandma's happy face. Good secrets end with smiles.

questions: 蛋糕的祕密和大哥哥的祕密，讓{name}的心裡感覺有什麼不一樣？
{name}肚子怪怪的時候，{he}做了什麼？
如果有人叫你保守一個讓你不舒服的祕密，你可以告訴誰？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起列出三位「可以說心事的大人」，並告訴孩子：「不管什麼事，你告訴我，永遠不會被罵。」若您需要協助，可撥打113保護專線。

questions: How did the cake secret and the big boy's secret feel different to {name}?
What did {name} do when {his} tummy felt twisty?
If someone asked you to keep a secret that felt bad, who could you tell?
en.tip: Tonight, name three trusted grown-ups together, and say: "You can tell me anything, and you will never be in trouble for telling." In Taiwan, adults who need help can call the 113 child protection hotline.

zh: 星期一早上，林老師神祕地關上教室門，小聲說：「我們來幫陳伯伯辦一個感謝派對吧！他每天把走廊掃得亮晶晶，還幫我們修好搖搖晃晃的椅子。」大家興奮地點頭。{name}舉手說：「我們先保密，星期五給他一個驚喜！」
接下來幾天，大家偷偷準備。{name}和小宇負責畫一張大卡片，上面有掃把、太陽和好多笑臉。每次陳伯伯推著清潔車經過，他們就趕快把卡片藏進抽屜，忍不住偷偷笑。這個祕密讓{name}心裡暖暖的，像口袋裡藏著一顆糖。
星期三下課時，{name}看見小宇一個人坐在走廊的長椅上，眼眶紅紅的。「我的點心錢不見了，」小宇小聲說，「有個高年級的哥哥拿走了，他還說絕對不可以告訴任何人。」小宇緊緊抓著空空的錢包，肩膀縮成一團。
那天下午，{name}一直沒辦法專心，數學題寫了又擦，擦了又寫。「絕對不可以告訴任何人」這句話，像一顆小石頭卡在{his}肚子裡，悶悶的、沉沉的。{name}想起卡片的祕密，那個祕密讓人想笑，可是這個祕密只讓人想皺眉頭。
放學前，{name}在心裡把兩個祕密排排站。派對的祕密星期五就會揭曉，大家都會開心；小宇的祕密卻讓人害怕又擔心，而且被要求永遠不能說。{name}深吸一口氣，輕輕拉著小宇的手說：「這種祕密不該藏起來，我陪你去找林老師。」
林老師蹲下來，專心聽兩個人說完。小宇小聲問：「說出來，我們會被罵嗎？」林老師溫柔地搖搖頭：「告訴老師是對的，你們一點都不會惹上麻煩，這也不是你們的錯。接下來交給大人處理。」小宇的肩膀慢慢放鬆了，{name}肚子裡的小石頭也不見了。
第二天，林老師告訴他們，學校的老師已經和那位高年級的哥哥好好談過，點心錢也還給小宇了。小宇笑著買了一個熱呼呼的饅頭，掰了一半給{name}。兩個人坐在長椅上，一邊吃一邊討論卡片上還要加什麼顏色。
星期五，陳伯伯一走進教室，大家一起大喊：「陳伯伯，謝謝您！」他驚訝地張大眼睛，接過{name}和小宇的大卡片，笑得眼角都彎了。「這是我收過最棒的驚喜！」陳伯伯說。{name}看著大家的笑臉，心裡亮晶晶的，好像也被掃得乾乾淨淨。
en: On Monday morning, Ms. Lin closed the classroom door and whispered, "Let's throw a thank-you party for Mr. Chen! He keeps our halls sparkling, and he fixed our wobbly chairs." Everyone nodded with shining eyes. {name} raised a hand. "Let's keep it a secret until Friday. A surprise!"

All week, the class got ready in secret. {name} and Yu painted a giant card covered in brooms, suns and smiling faces. Whenever Mr. Chen rolled his cleaning cart past, they slid the card into a desk and giggled. This secret felt warm, like candy hidden in a pocket.

On Wednesday at recess, {name} found Yu alone on the hallway bench with red, teary eyes. "My snack money is gone," Yu whispered. "An older kid took it, and he said never, ever tell anyone." Yu clutched an empty coin purse and hunched up small.

That afternoon, {name} couldn't focus. Math problems got written, erased, and written again. "Never tell anyone" sat in {his} tummy like a heavy little stone. The card secret made {name} want to smile. This new secret only made {name} want to frown.

Before the bell, {name} lined the two secrets up side by side. The party secret would end on Friday, and everyone would be happy. Yu's secret felt scary and worrying, and it was supposed to stay hidden forever. Taking a deep breath, {name} held Yu's hand. "This kind of secret shouldn't be kept. I'll come with you to Ms. Lin."

Ms. Lin knelt down and listened to every word. "Are we in trouble for telling?" Yu asked softly. Ms. Lin shook her head kindly. "You did the right thing. You are not in trouble at all, and it isn't your fault. Now the grown-ups will take care of it." Yu's shoulders relaxed, and the stone in {name}'s tummy melted away.

The next day, Ms. Lin said the teachers had talked calmly with the older kid, and the snack money was back with Yu. Yu bought a warm steamed bun and broke off half for {name}. The two friends sat on the bench, munching and planning more colors for the card.

On Friday, when Mr. Chen walked in, the whole class shouted, "Thank you, Mr. Chen!" His eyes went wide. He took the giant card from {name} and Yu, and his smile crinkled all the way up. "This is the best surprise ever!" he said. Looking around at all the happy faces, {name} felt bright and sparkly inside.

questions: 派對的祕密和小宇的祕密，給{name}的感覺有什麼不一樣？
{name}聽到「絕對不可以告訴任何人」時，做了什麼？
如果有人要你保守一個讓你擔心的祕密，你會去告訴誰？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起列出三位「可以信任的大人」，並練習一句話：「我有一個讓我不舒服的祕密，想告訴你。」也讓孩子知道，說出來永遠不會被罵。若大人需要協助，可撥打113保護專線。

questions: How did the party secret feel different to {name} from Yu's secret?
What did {name} do after hearing "never tell anyone"?
If someone asked you to keep a secret that made you worried, who would you tell?
en.tip: This week, list three trusted grown-ups together and practice the phrase, "I have a secret that feels bad, and I want to tell you," reminding your child they will never be in trouble for telling. Adults in Taiwan who need support can call the 113 child protection hotline.

zh: 山上的小木屋飄著淡淡的松木香。{name}和表弟小豆、表妹露露擠在閣樓，壓低聲音開祕密會議：明天是爺爺七十歲生日，他們要送爺爺一根親手做的登山杖！美阿姨已經幫忙把木棍削好，孩子們負責磨砂紙、畫花紋。「噓——這是驚喜，明天才能揭曉！」露露說完，自己先咯咯笑了出來。
接下來兩天，大家忙得不亦樂乎。{name}把砂紙捲在手指上，一圈又一圈磨掉粗糙的木刺；小豆在杖身畫了一隻歪歪扭扭的松鼠，還堅持說那是「抽象派」。每次爺爺的腳步聲靠近，三個人就手忙腳亂把木杖塞進床底，裝得若無其事。{name}發現，守著這個祕密，胸口像裝了一瓶汽水，咕嘟咕嘟冒著快樂的泡泡。
傍晚，十四歲的表哥阿凱溜進閣樓。「杖頭還少一顆漂亮的石頭，」他神祕兮兮地說，「明天天一亮，我們偷偷去山下的溪邊撿。大人都還在睡，不准叫醒他們。」他伸出小指，表情很認真：「發誓，這件事永遠不能告訴任何人。」小豆和露露面面相覷，慢吞吞地勾了手指。
{name}也勾了，可是那天晚上翻來覆去，怎麼也睡不著。溪水又冷又急，天還沒亮，連路都看不清楚。這個祕密一點也不像汽水，倒像一顆石頭，沉甸甸地壓在肚子上。{name}心想：「登山杖的祕密明天就會變成笑聲，可是這個祕密，阿凱說要藏一輩子。」越想，心裡越是七上八下。
會不會被說是愛告狀呢？{name}咬咬嘴唇，還是輕手輕腳走下樓。美阿姨正坐在爐邊泡茶。「阿姨，我有一件事，心裡很不舒服……」{name}一口氣把溪邊的計畫全說了出來。美阿姨放下杯子，溫柔地抱了抱{him}：「謝謝你告訴我。讓人擔心的事，跟我說永遠不會挨罵。你做得很對。」
第二天清晨，美阿姨把所有人叫醒，連睡眼惺忪的阿凱也不例外。「想去溪邊？好主意，我們一起去！」阿凱的臉一下子紅了，小聲說：「我只是想來場冒險。」美阿姨拍拍他的肩：「冒險很好，但要有大人陪。」大家手牽手走到岸邊，在碎石堆裡翻找，露露最後挑中一顆圓滾滾、像雞蛋一樣光滑的白石頭。
生日蛋糕點上蠟燭時，孩子們捧出登山杖，白石頭穩穩鑲在杖頭。爺爺驚喜得說不出話，接著從櫃子深處拿出一根舊木杖——杖頭竟然也嵌著一顆白石頭！「這是我小時候，跟我的爺爺在同一條溪邊撿的。」{name}摸著兩顆石頭，覺得胸口的汽水泡泡又回來了，而且比以前更多。
en: The little mountain cabin smelled of pine. Up in the loft, {name} and two younger cousins, Dou and Lulu, huddled together for a top-secret meeting. Tomorrow was Grandpa's seventieth birthday, and they were going to give him a hiking stick they had made by hand! Aunt Mei had already trimmed the wood. Their job was sanding and painting. "Shh, it's a surprise until tomorrow!" Lulu whispered, then giggled loudly anyway.

For two days, everyone worked busily. {name} wrapped sandpaper around a finger and rubbed away every prickly splinter. Dou painted a wobbly squirrel on the stick and insisted it was modern art. Whenever Grandpa's footsteps came near, all three shoved the stick under the bed and tried to look innocent. Keeping this secret, {name} noticed, felt like having a soda in your chest, fizzing with happy bubbles.

That evening, their fourteen-year-old cousin Kai slipped into the loft. "The stick needs a cool stone on top," he said mysteriously. "Tomorrow at dawn, we'll sneak down to the river and find one. The grown-ups will be asleep, and nobody wakes them." He held out his pinky. "Swear you'll never, ever tell anyone." Dou and Lulu glanced at each other, then slowly hooked fingers.

{name} hooked a finger too, but that night sleep would not come. The river was cold and fast, and before sunrise you could barely see the path. This secret didn't fizz like soda. It sat in {name}'s stomach like a heavy rock. "The stick secret turns into laughing tomorrow," {name} thought, "but Kai wants this one hidden forever." The more {name} thought, the tighter the knot grew.

Would everyone call it tattling? {name} chewed a lip, then tiptoed downstairs anyway. Aunt Mei was making tea by the stove. "Aunt Mei, something is making me feel really uneasy." The whole river plan tumbled out in one breath. Aunt Mei set down her cup and gave {name} a warm hug. "Thank you for telling me. You will never be in trouble for telling me a worry like that. You did exactly right."

Early the next morning, Aunt Mei woke everyone, even a very sleepy Kai. "Want to visit the river? Great idea. Let's all go together!" Kai's cheeks turned pink. "I just wanted an adventure," he mumbled. Aunt Mei patted his shoulder. "Adventures are wonderful, with a grown-up along." Holding hands, they walked to the bank and searched the pebbles. Lulu finally picked a round white stone as smooth as an egg.

When the birthday candles were lit, the children carried out the hiking stick, the white stone set firmly on top. Grandpa was speechless. Then he pulled an old wooden stick from the back of a cupboard. On top sat a white stone, too! "My grandpa and I found this at the very same river when I was little." {name} touched both stones, and the happy bubbles came fizzing back, more than ever.

questions: 登山杖的祕密和阿凱的祕密，讓{name}的心裡有什麼不一樣的感覺？
{name}跟美阿姨說了之後，美阿姨做了什麼？
如果有人要你保守一個讓你擔心的祕密，你會想去找誰說？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起列出三位「可以說任何心事的大人」，並練習一句話：「我有一個祕密，讓我心裡不舒服。」若大人自己需要協助，可撥打113保護專線諮詢。

questions: How did the hiking stick secret and Kai's secret feel different inside {name}?
What did Aunt Mei do after {name} told her?
If someone asked you to keep a secret that made you worried, who would you tell?
en.tip: Tonight, name three grown-ups your child can tell anything, and practice the phrase together: "I have a secret that doesn't feel right." Parents in Taiwan who need support can call the 113 child protection hotline.

zh: 叮咚！叮咚！門鈴響了。是阿明舅舅來了！舅舅笑咪咪。{name}跑過去。「舅舅好！」{name}好開心。舅舅說：「我們來玩遊戲！」
舅舅舉起手。手指動一動。「我是搔癢怪獸！」舅舅說。「咕嚕咕嚕，嗷嗚嗷嗚！」{name}咯咯笑。快跑！快跑！{name}躲到沙發後面。
搔癢怪獸找到了！搔搔腳底。搔搔肚子。{name}哈哈哈。哈哈哈。好好玩！再一次！再一次！{name}笑得滾來滾去。
可是，笑呀笑。{name}好累了。肚子有點痠。{name}不想玩了。搔癢怪獸還在搔。{name}深深吸一口氣。
{name}大聲說：「請停下來！」舅舅馬上停手。手指不動了。舅舅笑一笑。「好，停了！謝謝你告訴我。」{name}鬆了一口氣。
舅舅坐下來。「要不要喝水？」{name}點點頭。咕嘟咕嘟。好舒服。舅舅問：「下次想玩，再叫我喔。」{name}笑了。
晚餐時間到了。香香的湯。軟軟的飯。吃飽了，舅舅說：「給舅舅親一個？」{name}想一想。{he}搖搖頭。「我想擊掌。」
舅舅伸出大手。啪！擊掌好響亮！媽媽說：「好棒的選擇。」爸爸也來擊掌。啪！啪！大家都笑了。{name}心裡暖暖的。
en: Ding-dong! Ding-dong! Who is at the door? It is Uncle Ming! Uncle Ming smiles big. {name} runs to say hi. "Let's play a game!" says Uncle.
Uncle wiggles his fingers. "I am the Tickle Monster!" Grr, grr! Roar, roar! {name} giggles and runs. Run, run, run! {name} hides behind the sofa.
The Tickle Monster finds {name}! Tickle, tickle, toes. Tickle, tickle, tummy. Ha ha ha! Ha ha ha! "Again! Again!" {name} rolls and laughs.
Then {name} gets tired. {his} tummy feels a bit sore. {name} does not want more. But the tickles keep going. {name} takes a big breath.
"Stop, please!" says {name}. Uncle stops right away. His fingers are still. He smiles. "Okay, all done! Thank you for telling me." {name} feels better.
Uncle sits down. "Want some water?" {name} nods. Glug, glug, glug. Ahh, much better. "Tell me when you want to play again," says Uncle.
Now it is dinner time. Warm soup. Soft rice. Yum, yum! "Kiss for Uncle?" he asks. {name} thinks. {name} shakes {his} head. "High five, please!"
Uncle holds up his big hand. Smack! What a loud high five! "Good choice," says Mom. Dad wants one too. Smack, smack! Everyone smiles. {name} feels warm inside.

questions: {name}不想再被搔癢時，說了什麼？舅舅怎麼做？
如果你不想被親親或抱抱，你可以怎麼說、怎麼做？
如果有人跟你說「不要」，你會怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子練習一句話：「請停下來！」玩搔癢或打鬧時，孩子一說就立刻停，並謝謝孩子告訴你；也可以約定擊掌或揮手當作打招呼的選擇。

questions: What did {name} say when the tickles were too much? What did Uncle do?
If you don't want a kiss or a hug, what could you say or do instead?
What will you do when someone tells you "no" or "stop"?
en.tip: This week, practice the phrase "Stop, please!" during tickle or play time, and stop right away every time, thanking your child for telling you. Let them pick a high five or a wave as a greeting for relatives.

zh: 農曆新年到了，全家去公園野餐。草地上鋪著紅色的大野餐墊。墊子上有年糕，還有香香的橘子。好多家人都來了！爺爺、奶奶來了，姑婆也來了。阿姨帶著小表妹小芽，舅舅也笑咪咪地走來。
「哇，{name}長這麼大了！」阿姨跑過來，抱得緊緊的。舅舅笑著捏捏{his}臉頰。「好可愛喔！」姑婆也彎下腰，想親一下。{name}覺得臉熱熱的，肩膀縮了起來。{he}不喜歡這樣，可是話卡在嘴巴裡。
{name}跑到媽媽身邊，小聲地說：「媽媽，我不想一直被抱。可是我怕大家會難過。」媽媽蹲下來，牽起{his}小手。「你的身體是你的，你的感覺也很重要。你可以說不，也可以換個方式打招呼喔。」
{name}想了又想，眼睛忽然一亮。{he}拿出蠟筆和一張白紙。第一個圖，是舉高的手，代表擊掌。第二個圖，是搖搖的手，代表揮手。第三個圖，是張開的手臂，代表抱抱。最上面寫著：「打招呼菜單」。媽媽說：「好棒的點子！」
{name}拿著菜單，走到舅舅面前。{his}心怦怦地跳，聲音小小的。「舅舅，今天我想選擊掌，好嗎？」舅舅眨眨眼，接著哈哈大笑。「當然好！」他舉起大大的手。啪！{name}也笑了。原來說出來，沒有那麼難。
阿姨也想試試看。{name}選了揮手，阿姨就開心地揮揮手。姑婆也揮了揮手。奶奶指著抱抱的圖，問：「奶奶可以抱你嗎？」{name}點點頭，給奶奶一個暖暖的抱抱。爺爺選了擊掌，還大喊：「耶！」
這時，{name}看見小芽躲在阿姨後面。阿姨張開手說：「小芽，來抱一個！」小芽搖搖頭，抱緊她的小兔子玩偶。{name}走過去，把菜單拿給她看。「小芽，你想選哪一個？」小芽想了好久。她伸出小手，指了指揮手。
阿姨笑著說：「好，那我們揮揮手！」{name}和小芽一起揮手，小芽終於咯咯笑了。太陽暖暖的，大家一起分橘子吃。媽媽輕聲說：「你記得問小芽，好貼心。」{name}把菜單收進口袋。明年新年，還要帶著它來！
en: It was Lunar New Year. The family had a picnic in the park. A big red blanket covered the grass. There were rice cakes and sweet oranges. Grandma, Grandpa, and Great-Aunt came. Auntie came with little cousin Xiaoya. Uncle came too.

"Wow, {name}, you've grown so much!" Auntie gave a big, tight squeeze. Uncle laughed and pinched {his} cheek. "So cute!" Great-Aunt bent down for a kiss. {name} felt hot and squished. The words got stuck inside.

{name} ran to Mom and whispered, "I don't want so many hugs. But I don't want anyone to be sad." Mom knelt and held {his} hand. "Your body belongs to you. Your feelings matter. You can say no, and choose another hello."

{name} thought hard. Then came a bright idea! Out came crayons and paper. {name} drew a hand up high for a high five. Then a waving hand for a wave. Then open arms for a hug. On top: "Greeting Menu." "Great idea!" said Mom.

Holding the menu, {name} walked up to Uncle. Thump, thump went {his} heart. "Uncle, today I choose a high five. Okay?" Uncle blinked, then laughed. "Of course!" Slap! {name} smiled. Saying it wasn't so hard after all.

Auntie wanted to try too. {name} chose a wave, so Auntie waved. Great-Aunt waved too. Grandma pointed at the hug. "May I have a hug?" {name} nodded and gave Grandma a warm hug. Grandpa picked a high five. "Yay!"

Then {name} saw Xiaoya hiding behind Auntie. Auntie opened her arms. "Come give me a hug!" Xiaoya shook her head and held her toy bunny tight. {name} showed her the menu. "Which one do you want?" Xiaoya pointed to the wave.

"Okay, a wave it is!" said Auntie. {name} and Xiaoya waved together, and Xiaoya giggled. Everyone shared sweet oranges in the warm sun. Mom whispered, "You asked Xiaoya. That was kind." {name} tucked the menu away for next New Year.

questions: {name}不想被抱的時候，{he}想出了什麼好辦法？
如果有人想抱你、親你或搔你癢，可是你不想要，你可以怎麼說？
小芽搖頭說不要的時候，{name}和阿姨是怎麼做的？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起畫一張家裡的「打招呼菜單」，練習說「我今天想擊掌就好」，並在聚會前提醒長輩尊重孩子的選擇。若您需要協助或諮詢，可撥打 113 保護專線。

questions: When {name} didn't want hugs, what idea did {he} come up with?
If someone wants to hug, kiss, or tickle you and you don't want it, what could you say?
When Xiaoya shook her head, what did {name} and Auntie do?
en.tip: Tonight, draw your own family greeting menu together and practice saying, "Today I'd like a high five," then let relatives know before gatherings that your child gets to choose. If you ever need help or advice in Taiwan, the 113 child protection hotline is available for adults.

zh: 幼兒園裡，陽光照進教室。林老師發下白紙和彩色筆。「今天，我們來做一隻安全手。」{name}把小手平放在紙上。彩色筆沿著手指，慢慢畫了一圈。紙上出現一隻小手，五根手指張得開開的。
「每根手指，寫一個你信任的大人。」林老師說。「遇到害怕的事，就去找他們。」{name}想了好久。大拇指寫媽媽，食指寫爺爺。中指寫林老師，無名指寫保健室的陳護理師。小指寫樓下的美美阿姨。
林老師蹲下來看，眼睛亮亮的。「有家人，也有學校和鄰居的大人，真棒！」她又笑著說：「如果一個大人沒聽到，就再說一次，或去找下一根手指。」{name}點點頭。{he}把安全手摺好，放進口袋裡。
放學了，爺爺來接{name}。他們一起走到學校旁邊的公園。爺爺坐在沙坑旁的長椅上，跟鄰居伯伯聊天。{name}在沙坑裡堆城堡。堆好一座高高的塔，{name}開心地拍拍手。
一個大哥哥走過來，看了看城堡。「好醜喔！」他說。「你好慢，像小烏龜。」{name}低下頭，沒有說話。大哥哥又說了一次，還說了好幾次。{name}的心怦怦跳，肚子也緊緊的，有點害怕。
{name}跑到長椅旁。「爺爺，那個哥哥一直說我。」爺爺正聊得開心，揮揮手說：「沒事，小孩在玩啦。」{name}站在原地，眼睛熱熱的。{he}摸摸口袋裡的安全手。對了，還有別的手指呀！
這時，美美阿姨正好走過長椅旁。{name}跑過去，大聲說：「美美阿姨，我需要幫忙！」美美阿姨馬上蹲下來，認真聽完。「謝謝你告訴我，這不是你的錯。」她牽起{name}的手，一起走到爺爺身邊。
爺爺聽完，緊緊抱住{name}。「對不起，爺爺剛剛沒有好好聽。你一直說，真勇敢。」爺爺和美美阿姨去找大哥哥，大哥哥小聲說了對不起。第二天，林老師在小指旁畫了一顆星星。{name}看著{his}安全手，笑得好甜。
en: At kindergarten, sunshine filled the classroom. Teacher Lin handed out paper and crayons. "Today, let's make a safety hand." {name} laid one small hand flat on the paper. The crayon went slowly around each finger. Soon a little paper hand smiled up, fingers spread wide.

"On each finger, write a grown-up you trust," said Teacher Lin. "If something scares you, go to them." {name} thought hard. The thumb said Mom. Next came Grandpa, then Teacher Lin. The fourth finger said Nurse Chen. The pinky said Auntie Mei downstairs.

Teacher Lin knelt down to look. "Family, school, and a neighbor too. Wonderful!" Then she smiled. "If one grown-up doesn't hear you, say it again. Or go to the next finger." {name} nodded, folded the safety hand, and tucked it into a pocket.

After school, Grandpa came to pick {name} up. They walked to the park next to the school. Grandpa sat on a bench by the sandbox, chatting with a neighbor. {name} built a sand castle. When the tall tower was done, {name} clapped happily.

A big kid walked over and looked at the castle. "That's so ugly!" he said. "You're slow, like a little turtle." {name} looked down and said nothing. The big kid said it again, and again. {name}'s heart thumped. {his} tummy felt tight and scared.

{name} ran to the bench. "Grandpa, that kid keeps saying mean things." Grandpa was busy talking. He waved and said, "It's fine, kids are just playing." {name} stood still, eyes stinging. Then {he} touched the safety hand in the pocket. There were more fingers!

Just then, Auntie Mei walked past the bench. {name} ran over and spoke up loudly. "Auntie Mei, I need help!" Auntie Mei knelt down right away and listened. "Thank you for telling me. This is not your fault." She took {name}'s hand and walked back to Grandpa.

Grandpa listened and gave {name} a big hug. "I'm sorry I didn't really listen. You kept telling. That was brave." Grandpa and Auntie Mei talked to the big kid, who quietly said sorry. The next day, Teacher Lin drew a star by the pinky. {name} looked at {his} safety hand and smiled.

questions: 爺爺一開始沒有好好聽的時候，{name}做了什麼？
如果你遇到害怕的事，你的安全手上會寫哪幾位大人？
如果第一個大人很忙，沒聽到你說話，你可以怎麼做？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起描手掌，在每根手指寫一位信任的大人，至少包含一位家人以外的人（例如老師或護理師），並練習說：「我需要幫忙！」如果大人需要協助，可撥打 113 保護專線。

questions: What did {name} do when Grandpa didn't really listen at first?
If something scared you, which grown-ups would you put on your safety hand?
If the first grown-up is busy and doesn't hear you, what can you do?
en.tip: Tonight, trace your child's hand together and write one trusted grown-up on each finger, including at least one person outside the family, like a teacher or school nurse. Practice saying "I need help!" in a clear, loud voice.

zh: 漁港夏令營的第三天，海風帶著鹹鹹的味道。{name}跟著林老師來到碼頭，看見補網的海伯伯坐在一大片藍色漁網中間，手指飛快地穿來穿去。海鷗在頭頂「嘎嘎」叫，好像在催他動作快一點。
「伯伯，這張網為什麼這麼牢？」{name}好奇地問。海伯伯舉起一個小結：「一個結，連一條小魚都抓不住；幾百個結連在一起，大浪來了也不怕。」他遞給{name}一條細繩。{name}綁了半天，結一拉就散開，軟趴趴的像一碗麵。大家都笑了，{name}也笑著再試一次。
這一次，{name}綁得又緊又牢。林老師蹲下來說：「每個人也需要一張網。想一想，遇到困難的時候，你會想找哪些大人？」{name}一邊想，一邊在繩上打結：媽媽、爸爸、阿嬤，還有學校保健室的陳阿姨。打到第五個結時，{name}抬起頭，看著林老師笑了。
「第五個是我嗎？」林老師眨眨眼。{name}用力點頭，把有五個結的小繩子繫在背包上。走回營地的路上，{name}輕輕摸著那些結，心裡像放了一顆小小的錨，穩穩當當，再大的浪也不怕。
下午，營隊在港邊的公車站排隊，準備去參觀魚市場。大家站在黃線後面，等老師帶著上車。{name}忽然看見最小的營員小圓被兩個大孩子擠出隊伍。「你太慢了，去最後面啦！」他們說完就轉過身，不讓她靠近。小圓抱著水壺，眼眶紅紅的。
{name}趕緊跑去找輔導員阿杰哥哥。阿杰哥哥正忙著點名，手裡的名單被風吹得啪啪響。「等一下喔，我在數人數！」他頭也沒抬。{name}站在原地，心跳得好快。說了一次，沒有人聽見，怎麼辦？{name}摸到背包上的繩結。一個結，抓不住魚。
{name}轉身跑向林老師：「老師，小圓被擠出隊伍，他們還不讓她排！」林老師立刻放下手上的東西，蹲下來仔細聽，然後牽著{name}走過去。她請兩個大孩子說說發生了什麼事，他們低下頭，向小圓道歉，把位置讓了回來。阿杰哥哥也跑過來說：「謝謝你沒有放棄，一直找人幫忙！」
上了公車，小圓坐在{name}旁邊，盯著那條繩子看。{name}從口袋拿出海伯伯多給的一段細繩，教她打第一個結。那個結又鬆又歪，像一隻睡著的小蝦，兩個人笑成一團。窗外的漁船慢慢靠岸，小圓認真綁好第二個結，說：「這個是給林老師的。」
en: On the third day of summer camp at the fishing harbor, the wind smelled salty. {name} followed Teacher Lin down to the dock, where old Uncle Hai sat inside a huge blue fishing net, mending it. His fingers zipped in and out. Seagulls squawked overhead, as if telling him to hurry.

"Why is your net so strong?" {name} asked. Uncle Hai held up one tiny knot. "One knot can't catch even a little fish. But hundreds of knots together? They hold up against the biggest waves." He handed {name} a thin cord. {name} tied and tugged, and the knot flopped open like a noodle. Everyone laughed, {name} too, and tried again.

This time the knot held tight. Teacher Lin knelt down. "People need a net too. When something feels wrong, which grown-ups would you go to?" {name} thought and tied a knot for each one: Mom, Dad, Grandma, and Ms. Chen, the school nurse. At the fifth knot, {name} looked up at Teacher Lin and smiled.

"Is the fifth one me?" Teacher Lin asked with a wink. {name} nodded hard and tied the five-knot cord to {his} backpack. On the walk back to camp, {name} kept touching the knots. They felt like a tiny anchor, holding everything steady.

That afternoon, the campers lined up at the harbor bus stop, waiting behind the yellow line for the teachers to lead them onto the bus to the fish market. Then {name} saw two big kids squeeze little Yuan, the youngest camper, out of line. "You're too slow. Go to the back!" they said, and turned away so she couldn't come close. Yuan hugged her water bottle, her eyes watery.

{name} hurried over to Counselor Jay. He was busy taking attendance, his list flapping in the wind. "Hang on, I'm counting heads!" he said without looking up. {name} stood still, heart pounding. Telling once hadn't worked. Now what? {name} touched the knots on the backpack. One knot can't catch a fish.

{name} turned and ran to Teacher Lin. "Yuan got pushed out of line, and they won't let her back in!" Teacher Lin put everything down, knelt, and listened carefully. Then she walked over with {name} and asked the big kids what happened. They looked at their shoes, said sorry to Yuan, and gave back her spot. Counselor Jay jogged over. "Thanks for not giving up and finding someone to help!"

On the bus, Yuan sat next to {name}, staring at the knotted cord. {name} pulled out a spare piece Uncle Hai had given and showed her how to tie the first knot. It came out loose and crooked, like a sleepy shrimp, and they both giggled. As fishing boats drifted into the harbor, Yuan carefully tied a second knot. "This one's for Teacher Lin."

questions: 阿杰哥哥太忙沒聽見的時候，{name}做了什麼？
如果你的網也有五個結，你會選哪五個大人？其中有沒有家人以外的人，像老師或保健室阿姨？
如果你告訴一個大人，他沒有聽見，你接下來會去找誰？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起拿一條繩子，每打一個結就說出一位信任的大人（至少一位是家人以外的人），掛在書包上，並一起練習說：「我要再說一次，我需要幫忙。」大人若需要協助，可撥打113保護專線。

questions: What did {name} do when Counselor Jay was too busy to listen?
If your net had five knots, which five grown-ups would you choose? Is one of them outside the family, like a teacher or the school nurse?
If you told a grown-up something and they didn't hear you, who would you go to next?
en.tip: This week, tie a cord together with your child, naming one trusted grown-up for each knot (at least one outside the family), and hang it on their backpack. Practice the phrase "I need to tell you again: I need help."

zh: 秋天的早晨，陽光從樹葉縫隙灑下來，班上要去森林步道校外教學。同學們嘰嘰喳喳，像一群興奮的小麻雀。只有{name}走在隊伍最後面，心事重重，覺得背包好像塞滿了松果，一步比一步還要沉。
那份沉重，是從好幾個星期前開始的。有一天下課，一個高年級的大孩子拉{name}玩搔癢遊戲。{name}大聲說：「停！我不喜歡！」可是對方沒有停，還笑著說：「這是我們的祕密，不准告訴別人喔。」從那天起，{name}就把話鎖在心裡。
步道旁長著一叢蕨類，葉尖捲成小小的漩渦。陳老師蹲下來說：「蕨類的新葉會一點一點舒展開來，不用急。」話才剛說完，一顆松果「咚」地一聲掉在老師的帽子上。大家笑得東倒西歪，連{name}也忍不住揚起嘴角。
中午，大家坐在倒下的大樹幹上吃飯糰。樹上的松鼠吱吱叫個不停，好像在聊天。{name}捏著飯糰，看看陳老師，又看看地上的落葉。好幾次張開嘴，話卻卡在喉嚨裡。最後，{name}深深吸一口氣，鼓起勇氣走了過去。
「陳老師，我可以跟你說一件事嗎？」老師放下水壺，蹲到和{name}一樣高，安安靜靜地聽。{name}支支吾吾，慢慢把搔癢遊戲的事說出來：「我有說停，可是對方不停，還叫我保守祕密。我好幾個星期都不敢說。」
陳老師的眼神很溫柔。「謝謝你告訴我，你真的很勇敢。」老師一字一句地說：「這從來都不是你的錯。等了好幾個星期才說，也不是你的錯。就算那時候你沒有說出『停』，也一樣不是你的錯。」
「你的身體是你的，從腳趾頭到泳衣蓋住的地方，都由你決定。」老師接著說：「保護小孩，是大人的工作。接下來我會和校長，還有你的家人一起處理，你不用自己扛。」{name}點點頭，覺得背包裡的松果一顆顆滾走了，如釋重負。
回程路上，陳老師輕聲說：「我跟你說喔，我小時候也曾經鼓起勇氣，告訴老師一件很難開口的事。」{name}睜大眼睛，接著笑了。{name}腳步輕快地追上同學，經過那叢蕨類時，彷彿看見一片新葉，正慢慢舒展開來。
en: One autumn morning, sunlight sprinkled through the leaves as the class set off on a forest trail trip. Everyone chattered like excited sparrows. Only {name} trailed at the very back, feeling as if {his} backpack were stuffed with pinecones, each step heavier than the last.

That heavy feeling had started weeks ago. At recess, an older kid had pulled {name} into a tickle game. {name} shouted, "Stop! I don't like it!" But the older kid didn't stop, and grinned, "This is our secret. Don't tell anyone." Since then, {name} had kept quiet.

Beside the trail grew a clump of ferns, their tips curled into tiny spirals. Teacher Chen crouched down. "New fern leaves open a little at a time. No rush." Just then, a pinecone went bonk on her hat. Everyone giggled, and even {name} couldn't help smiling.

At lunch, the class perched on a fallen log, munching rice balls. Squirrels chattered in the branches above. {name} squeezed {his} rice ball, glanced at Teacher Chen, then at the crunchy leaves below. The words kept getting stuck. Finally, {name} took a deep breath and walked over.

"Teacher Chen, can I tell you something?" She set down her water bottle, knelt to {name}'s height, and listened quietly. Slowly, {name} told her about the tickle game. "I said stop, but the older kid kept going and told me to keep it secret. I didn't tell anyone for weeks."

Teacher Chen's eyes were kind. "Thank you for telling me. That was really brave." She spoke slowly and clearly. "This was never your fault. Waiting weeks to tell isn't your fault either. And even if you hadn't said stop, it still wouldn't be your fault."

"Your body belongs to you, from your toes to the parts your swimsuit covers. You get to decide." She went on, "Keeping kids safe is the grown-ups' job. I'll work on this with the principal and your family. You don't have to carry it alone." {name} nodded. The pinecones seemed to roll right out of {his} backpack.

On the walk back, Teacher Chen said softly, "You know, when I was little, I once found the courage to tell my teacher something hard too." {name}'s eyes went wide, then {he} smiled. Skipping ahead to catch up with friends, {name} passed the ferns and spotted one new leaf, slowly unfolding.

questions: {name}說出搔癢遊戲的事時，陳老師說了什麼、做了什麼？
如果有人讓你對自己的身體感到不舒服，或叫你保守讓你擔心的祕密，你會想告訴誰？
為什麼陳老師說，就算{name}等了很久才說，也不是{name}的錯？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起列出三位「可以說任何事」的大人，並練習一句話：「不管發生什麼事，都不是你的錯，你可以告訴我。」若大人需要協助，可撥打113保護專線。

questions: What did Teacher Chen say and do when {name} told her about the tickle game?
If someone ever made you feel uncomfortable about your body, or asked you to keep a worrying secret, who would you tell?
Why did Teacher Chen say it wasn't {name}'s fault, even though {he} waited weeks to tell?
en.tip: This week, name three grown-ups your child can tell anything, and practice saying, "Whatever happens, it's never your fault, and you can always tell me." If you need support as an adult in Taiwan, you can call the 113 child protection hotline.

zh: 晚餐吃完了。{name}張開嘴巴笑。咦？牙齒上好熱鬧！小小糖糖蟲，正在開派對。蹦蹦跳，嘻嘻笑，糖糖蟲好開心。
「哈囉，糖糖蟲！」{name}說。糖糖蟲搖搖手：「我們愛甜甜！我們要跳舞！」咚咚咚，咚咚咚，派對好吵喔。
爸爸笑著走過來。「我們去刷牙吧！」爸爸拿來小牙刷。「這是牙刷小掃把。」{name}點點頭。擠一點點牙膏，像小豌豆。
{name}唱起刷牙歌：「刷刷刷，轉圈圈，小小圈，輕輕刷。」先刷前面的牙。刷刷刷，轉圈圈。糖糖蟲咯咯笑：「好癢喔！」
再刷旁邊的牙。刷刷刷，轉圈圈。上面刷一刷，下面刷一刷。糖糖蟲拿起小帽子：「派對結束囉！」掰掰，掰掰！
後面的角落呢？有一隻還在躲。{name}張大嘴巴：「啊——」爸爸說：「換我幫忙收尾。」刷刷刷，輕輕刷。最後一隻也溜走了。
咕嚕咕嚕，漱漱口。呸！{name}對著鏡子笑。牙齒亮晶晶，像小星星。爸爸說：「好棒的笑容！」{name}又笑了一次。
「明天早上也要刷喔？」{name}問。爸爸點點頭：「早上刷，晚上刷。」{name}打個小呵欠，抱著小熊上床。晚安，亮晶晶的牙齒。
en: Dinner is all done. {name} opens wide and smiles. Oh! The teeth look so busy! Tiny sugar bugs are having a party. Hop, hop! Giggle, giggle!
"Hello, sugar bugs!" says {name}. The bugs wave. "We love sweets! We want to dance!" Stomp, stomp, stomp! What a noisy party!
Dad comes over, smiling. "Let's brush our teeth!" He brings a little toothbrush. "Here is your toothbrush broom." {name} nods. A pea of toothpaste goes on top.
{name} sings the brushing song. "Brush, brush, round and round. Little circles, soft and slow." First the front teeth. Round and round! The sugar bugs giggle. "That tickles!"
Next, the side teeth. Brush, brush, round and round. Brush the top. Brush the bottom. The bugs grab their tiny hats. "Party's over!" Bye-bye, bye-bye!
What about the back corners? One bug is hiding there. {name} opens wide. "Ahhh!" Dad says, "My turn to finish." Brush, brush, gently. Off goes the last bug!
Swish, swish, swish. Spit! {name} smiles at the mirror. The teeth shine like little stars. "What a great smile!" says Dad. {name} smiles again.
"Do we brush in the morning too?" asks {name}. Dad nods. "Every morning and every night." {name} yawns and hugs Teddy in bed. Goodnight, shiny teeth.

questions: {name}用牙刷小掃把怎麼刷牙？我們也來轉小圈圈好嗎？
後面角落的糖糖蟲，是誰幫忙刷走的？
我們每天什麼時候要刷牙呢？
zh.tip: 今晚刷牙時，一起唱「刷刷刷，轉圈圈」，孩子自己刷完後，由你幫忙刷後面的牙齒收尾。

questions: How did {name} brush with the toothbrush broom? Can we make little circles too?
Who helped sweep the sugar bug from the back corner?
When do we brush our teeth every day?
en.tip: Tonight, sing "Brush, brush, round and round" together, and after your child brushes, finish the back teeth for them.

zh: 星期六早上，爸爸帶{name}去動物園。出門前，{name}先刷了牙。「刷乾淨，才能笑得亮亮的！」爸爸說。{name}咧嘴一笑，牙齒白白的，真好看。
動物園裡好熱鬧。長頸鹿在吃樹葉，猴子在盪來盪去。忽然，{name}聽到一個聲音：「河馬要刷牙囉！」很多小朋友都跑過去看。爸爸牽著{name}的手，也走了過去。
池塘邊有一隻大河馬，名叫胖胖。飼育員阿芳姐姐拿著一支好大的刷子。那支刷子，比{name}的手臂還長！「胖胖，張大嘴巴！」阿芳姐姐笑著說。
胖胖慢慢張開嘴，哇，好大好大！裡面的牙齒，像一顆顆大石頭。阿芳姐姐輕輕地刷，一圈又一圈。前面刷一刷，後面也刷一刷。胖胖舒服得眯起眼睛，還「哼哼」叫了兩聲。
「為什麼要刷這麼仔細呢？」{name}問。阿芳姐姐說：「每一顆都要刷到喔。這樣糖糖蟲就不會來住。」最後，她還檢查了一遍。胖胖打了一個好大的呵欠，大家都笑了。
太陽下山了，爸爸和{name}一起回家。吃完晚餐，洗好澡，就要睡覺了。爸爸拿出一個小沙漏。「沙子流完以前，我們來刷牙吧！」{name}拿起{his}小牙刷，說：「我要像胖胖一樣！」
{name}輕輕地刷，畫著小圓圈。先刷前面的牙，再刷後面的牙。咬東西的那一面，也刷得沙沙響。沙子慢慢往下流，{name}的牙刷也一直沒停。最後，爸爸幫{him}再刷一遍，好像阿芳姐姐在檢查。
沙子流完了！{name}漱漱口，對著爸爸張大嘴巴。「你看，河馬的笑容！」爸爸哈哈大笑：「好亮的牙齒呀！」{name}抱著爸爸說晚安，嘴巴香香的，帶著笑睡著了。
en: On Saturday morning, Dad took {name} to the zoo. First, {name} brushed every tooth. "Clean teeth make shiny smiles!" said Dad. {name} grinned a big, bright grin.

The zoo was busy and fun. Giraffes munched leaves. Monkeys swung from branch to branch. Then someone called, "Hippo tooth time!" Children hurried over. Dad held {name}'s hand, and they went to see too.
By the pond stood a big hippo named Chubby. A keeper named Fen held a giant brush. It was longer than {name}'s arm! "Open wide, Chubby!" said Fen with a smile.

Chubby opened slowly. Wow, what a huge mouth! The teeth looked like big stones. Fen brushed gently, in little circles. She brushed the front. She brushed the back. Chubby closed his eyes and gave a happy grunt.
"Why do you brush so carefully?" asked {name}. "Every tooth needs a turn," said Fen. "Then sugar bugs stay away." She checked once more at the end. Chubby gave a giant yawn, and everyone laughed.

The sun went down, and they went home. After dinner and a bath, it was almost bedtime. Dad held up a little sand timer. "Let's brush until the sand runs out!" {name} picked up {his} small brush. "Just like Chubby!"

{name} brushed gently in little circles. First the front teeth, then the back teeth. Then the chewing sides went swish, swish. The sand trickled down, and the brush kept going. At the end, Dad helped finish, just like Fen checking.
The sand ran out! {name} rinsed and opened wide for Dad. "Look, a hippo smile!" Dad laughed. "What shiny teeth!" {name} hugged Dad goodnight and fell asleep smiling, with a fresh, minty mouth.

questions: 阿芳姐姐是怎麼幫胖胖刷牙的？
{name}晚上刷了牙齒的哪些地方？
你明天早上刷牙時，想給誰看你的河馬笑容？
zh.tip: 今晚刷牙時用計時器或唱一首短歌，讓孩子輕輕畫小圓圈刷每一面，最後由您幫忙再刷一遍。

questions: How did Fen brush Chubby's teeth?
Which parts of {his} teeth did {name} brush at night?
Who will you show your hippo smile to after brushing tomorrow morning?
en.tip: Tonight, use a timer or a short song while your child brushes every side in little circles, then take a turn to finish.

zh: {name}有一隻小熊。小熊叫做咕咕。咕咕軟軟的，胖胖的。{name}去哪裡，咕咕就去哪裡。今天，咕咕好像有話要說。
「咕咕也想學上廁所！」{name}笑著說。「好呀，我們一起學。」小熊點點頭，好像在說好。{name}抱著咕咕，走到小馬桶旁邊。
小馬桶小小的，圓圓的。像一張小王座！{name}讓咕咕先坐坐。咕咕坐得好端正。「國王咕咕！」{name}咯咯笑。
咕嚕咕嚕，咕嚕咕嚕。{name}的小肚子在說話。小肚子說：「該去了喔！」{name}跑去找媽媽。「媽媽，我要尿尿！」
媽媽說：「好棒，你有說出來！」{name}坐上小王座。咕咕坐在旁邊陪著。嘩啦啦，嘩啦啦。尿尿出來了！
沖水囉！轟隆隆，轟隆隆。{name}揮揮小手：「掰掰！」咕咕也揮揮小熊手。「掰掰，尿尿！」兩個一起笑哈哈。
再來洗洗手。抹上香香的肥皂。泡泡多多，泡泡圓圓。搓搓搓，搓搓搓。沖一沖，擦一擦。小手香噴噴！
下午玩積木，玩得好開心。哎呀！褲子濕濕的。{name}有點不好意思。媽媽抱抱{him}：「沒關係，大家都會。」
媽媽和{name}一起擦乾淨。換上乾乾的新褲子。咕咕說：「下次再試試！」{name}點點頭，親親咕咕。我們都在學呀！
en: {name} has a teddy bear. Teddy's name is Coco. Coco is soft and round. Where {name} goes, Coco goes. Today Coco has a big idea.
"Coco wants to learn the potty!" says {name}. "Okay, let's learn together." Coco gives a little nod. {name} carries Coco to the little potty.
The potty is small and round. It looks like a tiny throne! Coco sits on it first. Coco sits up so straight. "King Coco!" giggles {name}.
Rumble, rumble, rumble. {name}'s tummy is talking. It says, "Time to go!" {name} runs to find Mom. "Mom, I need to pee!"
"Great job telling me!" says Mom. {name} sits on the little throne. Coco sits close by. Tinkle, tinkle, tinkle. Pee comes out!
Time to flush! Whoosh, whoosh! {name} waves, "Bye-bye!" Coco waves a fuzzy paw. "Bye-bye, pee!" They both laugh and laugh.
Now wash those hands. Squish on the soap. Bubbles, bubbles, round and round. Rub, rub, rub. Rinse and dry. Clean hands smell so sweet!
Later, {name} plays with blocks. Oops! The pants are wet. {name} feels a little shy. Mom gives a hug. "That's okay. It happens to everyone."
Mom and {name} wipe it clean. On go fresh, dry pants. "Let's try again next time!" says Coco. {name} nods and kisses Coco. We are learning together!

questions: {name}的小肚子說話時，{name}做了什麼？
沖完水以後，{name}和咕咕接著做什麼？
如果不小心尿濕了，你可以怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這週每次上完廁所，一起揮手說「掰掰」再沖水，然後唱一首短短的洗手歌。

questions: What did {name} do when {his} tummy talked?
After flushing, what did {name} and Coco do next?
What can you do if you have an oops?
en.tip: This week, after each potty try, wave and say "Bye-bye!" as you flush, then sing a short handwashing song together.

zh: 今天是第一天。{name}要上幼兒園了。媽媽牽著{his}小手。走呀走，走到校門口。媽媽拿出一顆小石頭。圓圓的，滑滑的。
媽媽說：「這是約定石。」「放學時，媽媽會回來。」{name}握緊小石頭。媽媽抱一抱，親一親。「掰掰，媽媽愛你。」
媽媽走了。{name}的眼淚掉下來。嗚嗚，嗚嗚。林老師蹲下來。輕輕拍拍{his}背。「想媽媽，可以哭喔。」「老師陪你。」
{name}摸摸小石頭。圓圓的，滑滑的。媽媽會回來。{name}擦擦眼淚。牽著老師的手，走進教室。
點心時間到了。有香蕉，有牛奶。小美坐在旁邊。小美說：「我們一起吃！」咬一口，甜甜的。{name}摸摸小石頭。還在，還在。
唱歌時間到了。拍拍手，跺跺腳。啦啦啦，啦啦啦。{name}和小美一起跳。轉一圈，笑哈哈。小石頭在口袋裡，陪著{him}。
午睡時間到了。小被子，軟軟的。老師輕輕唱歌。{name}握著小石頭。眼睛閉起來。呼嚕，呼嚕，睡著了。
下午，鈴聲響了。叮咚，叮咚！校門打開了。是媽媽！媽媽回來了！{name}跑過去，抱緊緊。「明天，我還要來！」
en: Today is the first day. {name} is going to kindergarten. Mom holds {his} hand. They walk to the gate. Mom gives {name} a pebble. It is round and smooth.
"This is a promise pebble," Mom says. "I come back at pick-up time." {name} holds it tight. Hug, hug. Kiss, kiss. "Bye-bye. I love you."
Mom waves and goes. {name} starts to cry. Boo-hoo, boo-hoo. Teacher Lin kneels down. She pats {his} back. "It's okay to cry. I'm right here."
{name} rubs the pebble. Round and smooth. Mom will come back. {name} wipes away the tears. Hand in hand with Teacher Lin, {he} walks inside.
Snack time! Bananas and milk. Mei sits close by. "Let's eat together!" says Mei. Munch, munch. So sweet! {name} checks the pebble. Still there.
Song time! Clap, clap. Stomp, stomp. La la la! {name} dances with Mei. Spin around. Ha ha ha! The pebble stays in {his} pocket.
Nap time! The blanket is soft. Teacher Lin sings softly. {name} holds the pebble. Eyes close slowly. Snore, snore. Fast asleep.
Afternoon comes. Ding-dong, ding-dong! The gate opens. There is Mom! {name} runs to her. A big, big hug. "I want to come back tomorrow!"

questions: {name}哭的時候，林老師做了什麼？
{name}在學校做了哪些好玩的事？
如果你想媽媽，你可以怎麼做？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起挑一個小小的「約定物」，說好：「放學時，我一定會回來接你。」每天接送時都重複這句話。

questions: What did Teacher Lin do when {name} cried?
What fun things did {name} do at school?
What could you do if you miss Mom or Dad?
en.tip: Tonight, pick a small promise object together and say, "I always come back at pick-up time." Repeat the same words at every drop-off.

zh: 明天，{name}要上幼兒園了。晚上，爸爸坐在床邊，笑著說：「我們來發明一個再見的暗號吧！」{name}眨眨眼睛，好奇地問：「什麼暗號呀？」爸爸伸出拳頭，說：「先碰碰拳頭，再眨一下眼睛。」
「最後要說什麼？」{name}問。爸爸說：「要說『四點見』！幼兒園四點放學，我四點一定來接你。」{name}和爸爸練習了好多次。碰拳頭，眨眼睛，四點見！兩個人都笑得好開心。
第二天早上，陽光亮亮的。{name}牽著爸爸的手，走進幼兒園的大門。教室裡好吵，有好多不認識的小朋友。{name}的心咚咚跳，小手握得緊緊的。「爸爸，我有點緊張。」爸爸蹲下來，輕輕抱了抱{him}。
到了說再見的時候，{name}的眼淚掉下來了。爸爸沒有生氣，溫柔地說：「哭一下沒關係。」他們碰碰拳頭，眨眨眼睛。「四點見！」爸爸揮揮手，走出了教室。{name}還是抽抽噎噎的，眼睛紅紅的。
這時，王老師走過來了。她蹲得低低的，遞給{name}一張衛生紙。「想爸爸，對不對？老師也會想家喔。」王老師牽起{his}小手，說：「我帶你去看一個好地方。」{name}擦擦眼淚，慢慢跟著走。
她們來到教室的角落，那裡有好多彩色積木！紅的、藍的、黃的，堆得像小山。一個男孩正在蓋高塔，他叫小凱。塔太高了，搖來搖去。{name}趕快伸手扶住。「謝謝你！」小凱笑了，「我們一起蓋城堡好嗎？」
{name}和小凱一塊一塊往上疊。城堡有門，有窗，還有一座尖尖的塔。接著，大家一起唱歌，吃點心，在院子裡玩溜滑梯。午睡後，王老師說：「每天都是這樣喔，你會越來越熟悉。」{name}點點頭，覺得心裡暖暖的。
時鐘的短針指到四。{name}跑到門口一看，爸爸就站在那裡！{name}衝過去，碰碰拳頭，眨眨眼睛。「四點見！」爸爸笑著說：「我說到做到喔。」{name}向小凱揮揮手：「明天見！」然後，牽著爸爸的手，開心地回家了。
en: Tomorrow, {name} will start kindergarten. At bedtime, Dad sits by the bed. "Let's invent a secret goodbye," he says. {name} blinks. "What kind of secret?" Dad holds out his fist. "First a fist bump. Then a wink."
"And what do we say last?" asks {name}. "We say, 'See you at four!'" says Dad. "School ends at four. I'll come at four." They practice again and again. Bump, wink, see you at four! They both laugh.

The next morning is bright and sunny. {name} holds Dad's hand at the school gate. The classroom is loud and busy. There are so many new faces. {name}'s heart goes thump, thump. "Dad, I feel nervous." Dad kneels down and gives {him} a gentle hug.

Then it is time to say goodbye. Tears roll down {name}'s cheeks. "It's okay to cry," Dad says softly. They bump fists. They wink. "See you at four!" Dad waves and walks out. {name} keeps sniffling a little.

Then Teacher Wang comes over. She kneels down and hands {name} a tissue. "You miss Dad, don't you? I miss home sometimes too." She takes {his} hand. "Come, I'll show you a special place." {name} wipes away the tears and follows.

They reach a corner full of bright blocks. Red, blue, and yellow blocks sit in a big pile. A boy named Kai is building a tall tower. It wobbles and sways! {name} quickly holds it steady. "Thanks!" Kai smiles. "Want to build a castle together?"

Block by block, the castle grows. It has a door, windows, and a pointy tower. Then everyone sings, eats a snack, and plays on the slide. After nap time, Teacher Wang says, "We do this every day. Soon it will feel familiar." {name} nods. It feels warm inside.

The short hand on the clock points to four. {name} runs to the door. There is Dad! Bump, wink, "See you at four!" Dad smiles. "I always keep my promise." {name} waves to Kai. "See you tomorrow!" Then {name} holds Dad's hand and skips home.

questions: {name}跟爸爸說再見時哭了，王老師做了什麼來幫忙？
{name}在幼兒園認識了誰？你想在學校玩什麼？
我們也來發明一個專屬的再見暗號，你想要什麼動作呢？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起設計一個專屬再見暗號並練習幾次，每次接送時都使用它，並準時出現在約定的時間。

questions: When {name} cried at goodbye, what did Teacher Wang do to help?
Who did {name} meet at kindergarten? What would you like to play at school?
Let's invent our own goodbye. What moves should we use?
en.tip: Tonight, create your own special goodbye together and practice it a few times. Use it at every drop-off, and be right on time at pick-up.

zh: 天黑了，星星出來了。電視還亮亮的。爸爸說：「螢幕關一關。」{name}按下按鈕，嗒！電視也睡覺了。「嘟嘟！睏睏小火車，要出發囉！」{name}抱著小兔棉棉，上車囉！
「第一站，洗澡站！」嘩啦啦，溫水暖暖的。泡泡圓圓的，一顆、兩顆、三顆。{name}洗洗小手，洗洗小腳。棉棉坐在椅子上等。大毛巾軟軟的，香香的。
「嘟嘟！第二站，睡衣站！」睡衣軟軟的，像白雲一樣。伸出手，穿袖子。伸出腳，穿褲子。{name}幫棉棉蓋上小毯子。「好舒服喔！」
「嘟嘟！第三站，刷牙站！」牙刷小小的，牙膏一點點。刷刷刷，上面刷一刷。刷刷刷，下面刷一刷。咕嚕咕嚕，漱漱口。{name}對著鏡子笑一笑。牙齒白白亮亮的。
「嘟嘟！第四站，故事站！」{name}爬上小床。棉棉也躺好了。爸爸翻開小書，聲音輕輕的。小鴨回家了，小羊回家了。月亮慢慢爬上來。眼睛眨呀眨。
「嘟……第五站，小夜燈站。」爸爸關掉大燈。小夜燈亮起來，黃黃的，暖暖的。像一顆小月亮。房間好安靜。時鐘輕輕唱，滴答，滴答。
{name}打了個大哈欠。「爸爸，為什麼要睡覺？」爸爸摸摸{name}的頭。「睡覺時，身體會長大。明天醒來，又有力氣玩。」「明天要溜滑梯！」{name}小小聲說。
小火車慢慢停下來。嘟……嘟……好輕好輕。{name}抱緊棉棉。被子暖暖的。眼睛閉起來了。呼——呼——睏睏小火車，晚安。棉棉，晚安。{name}，晚安。
en: The sky grows dark. The TV is still bright. Papa says, "Screens off now." {name} presses the button. Click! The TV goes to sleep. "Toot toot! The Sleepy Train is leaving!" {name} hugs Cotton the bunny.
"First stop, Bath Station!" Splish, splash. The water is warm. Bubbles float up, one, two, three. {name} washes little hands and little toes. Cotton waits on a stool. Here comes a big, soft towel.
"Toot toot! Second stop, Pajama Station!" The pajamas are soft like clouds. One arm in. Two arms in. One leg in. Two legs in. {name} tucks a tiny blanket around Cotton. "So cozy!"
"Toot toot! Third stop, Toothbrush Station!" A tiny brush. A tiny dab of paste. Brush, brush, top teeth. Brush, brush, bottom teeth. Swish, swish, spit. {name} smiles in the mirror. Shiny and white!
"Toot toot! Fourth stop, Story Station!" {name} climbs into bed. Cotton snuggles in too. Papa opens a book. His voice is soft. The duck goes home. The lamb goes home. Blink, blink go sleepy eyes.
"Toot... last stop, Night-Light Station." Papa turns off the big light. The night-light glows, warm and gold. It looks like a tiny moon. The room is quiet. Tick, tock goes the clock.
{name} gives a big yawn. "Papa, why do we sleep?" Papa pats {name}'s head. "Sleep helps you grow. Tomorrow you'll have energy to play." "Tomorrow, the slide!" {name} whispers.
The Sleepy Train slows down, down, down. Toot... toot... so soft. {name} hugs Cotton close. The blanket is warm. Eyes close. Shh... Goodnight, Sleepy Train. Goodnight, Cotton. Goodnight, {name}.

questions: 睏睏小火車停了哪些站？你最喜歡哪一站？
{name}出發前，先把什麼關掉了？為什麼睡前要關螢幕呢？
爸爸說睡覺能幫身體做什麼？你明天睡飽了想玩什麼？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起當「睏睏小火車」，每到一個步驟就說「嘟嘟！下一站！」，並在出發前一起關掉所有螢幕。

questions: Which stops did the Sleepy Train make? Which one is your favorite?
What did {name} turn off before the train left? Why do screens go off before bed?
What did Papa say sleep helps our bodies do? What do you want to play after a good sleep?
en.tip: Tonight, play Sleepy Train together: say "Toot toot! Next stop!" at each bedtime step, and switch off all screens together before the train leaves.

zh: 天黑了，窗外好安靜。{name}坐在沙發上，看著平板裡的卡通。一集演完了，{name}說：「再看一集就好！」媽媽笑著指向窗外：「你看，月亮在做什麼？」
圓圓的月亮掛在天上。它慢慢把雲朵拉過來，像在蓋一條薄被子。媽媽輕輕說：「月亮要準備睡覺了。」{name}眨眨眼睛：「那我也關掉平板吧。」螢幕暗下來，房間只剩柔柔的燈光。
「眼睛休息了，頭腦也會慢慢想睡喔。」媽媽說。浴室裡，熱水嘩啦啦地流。{name}坐進暖暖的浴缸，泡泡軟軟的，香香的。窗外的月亮，好像也在雲裡洗澡，亮亮的，好乾淨。
洗好了，媽媽用大毛巾把{name}包起來，像包一顆小飯糰。{name}穿上軟綿綿的睡衣，好舒服喔。{he}看看窗外，月亮旁邊的星星，一顆一顆亮起來，好像也換上了睡衣。
接著是刷牙時間。刷刷刷，上面的牙齒。刷刷刷，下面的牙齒。{name}對著鏡子笑，牙齒白白亮亮的。{he}小聲說：「月亮，你也刷牙了嗎？」月亮靜靜地，又白又亮，好像在點頭。
{name}爬上床，抱著{his}小熊。爸爸拿來一本故事書，坐在床邊。他慢慢念，聲音低低的、暖暖的。故事裡，有一隻小兔子，在草地上跳來跳去，玩了一整天，好開心。
「小兔子睡飽了，明天才能跳得高高的。」爸爸說，「睡覺的時候，你的身體也在偷偷長大喔。」{name}打了一個小呵欠。{he}想著明天要去公園，要跑得快快的，要盪很高的鞦韆。
爸爸把燈調得暗暗的。窗外，月亮躲進軟軟的雲被子裡，只露出一點點光。風輕輕吹，星星輕輕閃。{name}閉上眼睛，小聲說：「晚安，月亮。」月亮也溫柔地陪著{him}，一起睡著了。
en: It is dark outside, and very quiet. {name} sits on the couch with a tablet. One cartoon ends. "Just one more!" says {name}. Mom smiles and points to the window. "Look. What is the moon doing?"

The round moon hangs in the sky. Slowly, it pulls the clouds close, like a thin blanket. "The moon is getting ready for bed," Mom whispers. {name} blinks. "Then I'll turn off my tablet too." The screen goes dark. Only soft light stays.

"Now your eyes can rest, and your brain can get sleepy," Mom says. In the bathroom, warm water splashes. {name} slides into the cozy bath. The bubbles are soft and smell sweet. Outside, the moon seems to wash in the clouds, clean and bright.

After the bath, Mom wraps {name} in a big towel, snug as a little rice ball. Then come the soft pajamas. So comfy! {name} peeks outside. Little stars twinkle on, one by one, as if they are changing into pajamas too.

Next it is time to brush. Brush, brush, the top teeth. Brush, brush, the bottom teeth. {name} smiles in the mirror. Shiny white teeth! "Moon, did you brush too?" {he} whispers. The moon glows white and bright, as if nodding.

{name} climbs into bed and hugs {his} teddy bear. Dad brings a storybook and sits close. He reads slowly, in a low, warm voice. In the story, a little bunny hops across the grass. It plays all day long, so happy.

"The bunny sleeps well, so tomorrow it can hop high," Dad says. "While you sleep, your body grows a little too." {name} gives a tiny yawn. Tomorrow is the park. {name} wants to run fast and swing up high.

Dad turns the lights down low. Outside, the moon tucks into its soft cloud blanket. Only a little glow peeks out. The wind blows gently. The stars blink slowly. {name} closes {his} eyes. "Goodnight, Moon." And together, they drift off to sleep.

questions: {name}關掉平板以後，做了哪些睡前的事？
你睡覺前最喜歡哪一個步驟？為什麼？
睡飽了以後，明天你想玩什麼？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起把睡前步驟畫成小圖卡（洗澡、睡衣、刷牙、故事、關燈），每完成一步就向窗外的月亮說一聲「我做好了」。

questions: What did {name} do after turning off the tablet?
Which bedtime step is your favorite? Why?
After a good sleep, what do you want to play tomorrow?
en.tip: Tonight, draw little picture cards of the bedtime steps together (bath, pajamas, teeth, story, lights low). After each step, say "Done!" to the moon outside.

zh: 白天，{name}和爺爺在合歡山上看雪。{name}堆了一個小雪人，還把手套按在雪地上，印出一個個小手印。傍晚，天空慢慢變成淡紫色，爺爺牽著{name}，一步一步走回溫暖的山屋。
山屋裡的火爐劈啪劈啪地響，窗外的雪輕輕飄落。可是{name}一點也不想睡，在房間裡跳來跳去：「爺爺，我還想再看一次雪人的照片！」爺爺笑著拿起平板，讓{name}看了最後一張，然後輕輕把螢幕關掉。
「螢幕亮亮的，眼睛會以為還是白天喔。」爺爺說，「我們讓它也去睡覺吧。」平板黑了下來，房間只剩下火爐暖暖的橘色光。{name}眨眨眼，覺得眼睛好像真的舒服了一點。
「可是這裡不是家呀，」{name}小聲說，「睡覺的步驟也一樣嗎？」爺爺點點頭：「一樣的。不管在哪裡，我們的睡前小步驟都會跟著走。第一步是什麼呢？」{name}想了想，笑著說：「洗澡！」
熱熱的水嘩啦嘩啦流下來，浴室裡飄著白白的水氣。{name}把白天的冷風和雪花都洗掉了，身體變得軟軟暖暖的。洗好後，{he}穿上從家裡帶來的睡衣，聞起來還有家裡洗衣精淡淡的香味。
接著，爺爺和{name}站在鏡子前一起刷牙。刷刷刷，上面的牙齒；刷刷刷，下面的牙齒。爺爺說：「今天吃的烤地瓜，也要跟牙齒說再見囉。」{name}漱漱口，對著鏡子露出亮晶晶的笑容。
{name}鑽進厚厚的棉被裡。爺爺坐在床邊，把燈調得暗暗的，翻開一本小故事書。讀完後，爺爺輕輕說：「你知道嗎？睡覺的時候，身體會偷偷長大一點點。明天，你才有力氣再去堆雪人。」
「那我要長得跟雪人一樣高。」{name}打了一個大大的呵欠。窗外的雪靜靜地下，火爐輕輕地響，爺爺的聲音越來越輕。{name}的眼睛慢慢閉上，像雪花一樣，輕輕地落進了甜甜的夢裡。晚安，合歡山。
en: All day long, {name} and Grandpa played in the snow on Hehuan Mountain. {name} built a little snowman and pressed mittens into the snow to make tiny handprints. When the sky turned soft purple, Grandpa held {his} hand, and they walked slowly back to the warm lodge.

Inside, the fire crackled, and snow drifted past the window. But {name} was not sleepy at all and bounced around the room. "Grandpa, can I see the snowman picture one more time?" Grandpa smiled, showed one last photo on the tablet, then gently switched the screen off.

"Bright screens tell our eyes it's still daytime," Grandpa said. "Let's let the tablet sleep, too." The screen went dark, and only the fire's orange glow filled the room. {name} blinked. {his} eyes already felt a little calmer.

"But we're not at home," {name} whispered. "Do the bedtime steps still work here?" Grandpa nodded. "They come with us wherever we go. What's the first step?" {name} thought for a moment and grinned. "Bath time!"

Warm water splashed down, and soft steam filled the bathroom. {name} washed away the cold wind and the snowflakes until everything felt warm and cozy. Then came the pajamas from home, which still smelled gently of home.

Next, Grandpa and {name} brushed their teeth side by side at the mirror. Brush, brush, brush, the top teeth. Brush, brush, brush, the bottom teeth. "Say bye-bye to the roasted sweet potato," Grandpa joked. {name} rinsed and gave the mirror a sparkly smile.

{name} snuggled under the thick quilt. Grandpa sat on the bed, turned the light down low, and read a short story. Then he whispered, "While you sleep, your body grows a tiny bit. And tomorrow, you'll have lots of energy to build another snowman."

"I want to grow as tall as a snowman," {name} said with a big yawn. Outside, the snow fell quietly. The fire whispered, and Grandpa's voice grew softer and softer. {name}'s eyes slowly closed, drifting down into sweet dreams like a snowflake. Goodnight, Hehuan Mountain.

questions: 爺爺為什麼要把平板關掉？關掉後{name}覺得怎麼樣？
在山屋裡，{name}睡前做了哪些步驟？你睡前也會這樣做嗎？
你覺得睡覺的時候，身體在做什麼呢？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起畫一張「睡前小步驟」圖：洗澡、睡衣、刷牙、故事、關燈，每完成一步就一起指一指，出門旅行時也帶著它。

questions: Why did Grandpa turn off the tablet? How did {name} feel afterward?
What bedtime steps did {name} do at the lodge? Do you do the same steps?
What do you think your body does while you sleep?
en.tip: Tonight, draw a bedtime-steps chart together: bath, pajamas, teeth, story, lights low. Point to each step as you finish it, and bring the chart along when you travel.

zh: 晚餐時間到了。媽媽端來一盤菜。盤子上有一條綠綠的東西。它長長的，身上一顆一顆凸凸的。{name}眨眨眼睛說：「哇！是小恐龍！」
媽媽笑著說：「這是苦瓜喔。」{name}歪著頭看。小恐龍不會跑。小恐龍不會叫。小恐龍只是靜靜躺在盤子上。{name}說：「我要當食物探險家！」
探險第一步，用眼睛看。綠綠的，亮亮的。凸凸的，像小山。中間還有白白的圈圈。{name}說：「小恐龍有斑點耶！」媽媽點點頭，眼睛笑彎彎。
探險第二步，用鼻子聞。{name}把鼻子湊近。嗅嗅，嗅嗅。香香的，又有一點點青草味。{name}皺皺鼻子，咯咯笑了。「小恐龍聞起來像花園！」
探險第三步，用耳朵聽。爸爸夾起一片，咬一口。喀滋！喀滋！聲音脆脆的。{name}睜大眼睛：「小恐龍會唱歌！」爸爸也哈哈笑了。
探險第四步，用嘴巴嚐。媽媽說：「只要咬一小口就好。」{name}拿起湯匙，挑了最小最小的一塊。像螞蟻一樣小。{name}深吸一口氣，啊嗚，放進嘴裡。
喀滋，喀滋。先是脆脆的。然後，苦苦的！{name}的嘴巴皺成一顆小酸梅。爸爸媽媽都笑了。{name}說：「小恐龍有點苦。我還不太喜歡。」媽媽說：「沒關係，你很勇敢喔。」
爸爸說：「我小時候也不喜歡苦瓜。現在我最愛吃了！」{name}看看盤子，對小恐龍揮揮手。「小恐龍，下次再來探險喔！」說不定有一天，{he}也會喜歡呢。
en: It was dinner time. Mom brought a plate. On it was something long and green. It was bumpy all over. {name} blinked. "Wow! A little dinosaur!"
Mom smiled. "That's bitter melon." {name} tilted {his} head. The dinosaur did not run. The dinosaur did not roar. It just lay there. "I'm a food explorer!" said {name}.
Step one: look. Green and shiny. Bumpy, like tiny hills. White rings in the middle. "The dinosaur has spots!" said {name}. Mom nodded with a happy smile.
Step two: sniff. {name} leaned in close. Sniff, sniff. It smelled fresh, a bit like grass. {name} wiggled {his} nose and giggled. "It smells like a garden!"
Step three: listen. Dad took a piece and bit it. Crunch! Crunch! {name}'s eyes went wide. "The dinosaur can sing!" Dad laughed and laughed.
Step four: taste. "Just one tiny bite," said Mom. {name} picked the smallest piece. It was ant-sized. {name} took a deep breath. Chomp! In it went.
Crunch, crunch. First it was crunchy. Then it was bitter! {name}'s mouth puckered up. Everyone giggled. "It's a little bitter. I don't love it yet." "That's okay," said Mom. "You were so brave."
"I didn't like it as a kid," said Dad. "Now it's my favorite!" {name} waved at the plate. "Bye, dinosaur! Let's explore again soon!" Maybe one day, {he} will love it too.

questions: {name}用哪些方法探險苦瓜？你最喜歡哪一步？
{name}咬了一小口，覺得怎麼樣？
有沒有一種食物，你以前不喜歡，現在喜歡了？
zh.tip: 這週吃飯時玩「食物探險家」：一起看、聞、聽、再嚐一小口新食物，不論喜不喜歡都說聲「你好勇敢」。

questions: How did {name} explore the bitter melon? Which step did you like best?
How did {name} feel after one tiny bite?
Is there a food you didn't like before but like now?
en.tip: This week, play "Food Explorer" at a meal: look, sniff, listen, then taste one tiny bite of a new food, and say "You were brave!" whether or not your child likes it.

zh: 客廳好熱鬧。積木堆成高塔，小汽車嘟嘟跑。娃娃排排坐，在喝假裝的茶。{name}玩得好開心，笑得咯咯咯。
窗外的太陽慢慢下山了。玩具們打了個大呵欠：「哈——好睏喔。」積木歪歪倒，汽車停不動。娃娃揉揉眼睛說：「我的家在哪裡？」
{name}看看地板。哎呀，到處都是玩具！紅積木躲在沙發下，藍汽車卡在拖鞋裡。{name}小聲說：「別擔心，我幫你們。」
媽媽走過來，笑咪咪地說：「我們來唱收玩具歌！」媽媽拍拍手，{name}也拍拍手。「收一收，放一放，玩具回家睡覺覺！」
先幫積木回家。{name}撿起紅積木，咚！跳進盒子裡。媽媽撿起黃積木，咚咚！也跳進去。積木一塊一塊，咚咚咚，排得整整齊齊。
接著是小汽車。「嘟嘟，倒車囉！」{name}把汽車開進車庫。叭叭！藍汽車找到車位了。媽媽說：「停得好棒，輪子都不會壓壞喔。」
最後是娃娃。{name}輕輕抱起娃娃，放到架子上。媽媽拿來小毯子，幫娃娃蓋好。娃娃好像在微笑：「謝謝你，晚安。」
地板亮晶晶，玩具都回家了。{name}說：「明天我一下就找到你們！」媽媽抱抱{him}，說：「一起收，好快喔。」晚安，小積木。晚安，小汽車。晚安，娃娃。
en: The living room is busy. Blocks stack up high. Cars go zoom, zoom. Dolls sit in a row for pretend tea. {name} plays and giggles, tee-hee.
Outside, the sun slips down. The toys give a big yawn. "Haaa, so sleepy." Blocks wobble. Cars stop. A doll rubs her eyes. "Where is my home?"
{name} looks at the floor. Oh my, toys everywhere! A red block hides under the sofa. A blue car is stuck in a slipper. "Don't worry," {name} whispers. "I'll help."
Mom comes over with a smile. "Let's sing the tidy-up song!" Mom claps. {name} claps too. "Tidy, tidy, one, two, three! Toys go home to sleep with me!"
First, the blocks. {name} picks up the red block. Plop! Into the box. Mom drops in a yellow one. Plop, plop! Soon the blocks sit snug and neat.
Next come the cars. "Beep, beep, backing up!" {name} drives them into the garage. Honk! The blue car finds its spot. "Great parking," says Mom. "Now the wheels stay safe."
Last, the dolls. {name} lifts each doll gently onto the shelf. Mom brings a tiny blanket. They tuck the dolls in. The dolls seem to smile. "Thank you. Goodnight."
The floor is clean and shiny. Every toy is home. "Tomorrow I'll find you fast!" says {name}. Mom gives {him} a hug. "Together is quick!" Goodnight, blocks. Goodnight, cars. Goodnight, dolls.

questions: {name}和媽媽是怎麼讓收玩具變好玩的？
你的玩具家在哪裡？積木和汽車住在哪裡呢？
如果玩具沒有回家，明天會怎麼樣？
zh.tip: 今晚睡前一起唱一首自編的「收玩具歌」，邊唱邊把玩具送回固定的家。可以替每個收納盒貼上玩具圖片，讓孩子自己找到家。

questions: How did {name} and Mom make tidying up fun?
Where do your toys live? Where do your blocks and cars go?
What might happen tomorrow if toys don't go home?
en.tip: Tonight before bed, sing a made-up tidy-up song together while putting toys in their homes. Stick a picture on each bin so your child can find each toy's home alone.

zh: 公園的沙坑，好好玩。{name}挖呀挖，沙沙沙。露露拍呀拍，啪啪啪。一座沙堡蓋好囉！奶奶坐在長椅上，笑著說：「點心時間快到囉。」
{name}看看小手。咦？手上灰灰的。這是什麼呢？「是細菌海盜！」{name}咯咯笑。小小的海盜，坐著小小的船。「嘿呦嘿呦，我們也要吃點心！」
露露看看小手，也笑了。「我手上也有海盜！」奶奶說：「玩完外面，要洗手。吃東西前，也要洗手。」露露點點頭：「上完廁所，也要洗！」
奶奶牽著兩個小朋友，走到公園的洗手台。水龍頭打開，嘩啦啦。先把小手沖濕，再擠一點肥皂。泡泡變多了，白白的，香香的。
「我們來唱歌！」露露說。{name}跟著一起唱：「搓搓手心，搓搓手背，手指縫縫鑽一鑽！」泡泡跳起舞來。海盜晃呀晃：「哎呀呀，好滑呀！」
還有大拇指，轉一圈，轉一圈。還有小指甲，刷刷刷，刷刷刷。{name}的手指好忙，像小刷子一樣。海盜的小船，咕嚕嚕，滑走囉！
歌唱完了，用清水沖一沖。嘩啦啦，泡泡不見了。海盜們揮揮手：「再見啦！」{name}用軟軟的小毛巾，把手擦乾。乾乾淨淨，真舒服。
奶奶打開點心盒，是脆脆的蘋果片！{name}拿一片給露露。露露也拿一片給{name}。兩雙乾淨的小手，碰一碰。「我們的手香香的！」喀滋喀滋，真好吃。
en: The park sandbox is so much fun. {name} digs and digs. Scoop, scoop! Lulu pats and pats. Pat, pat! Up goes a sand castle. Grandma smiles from the bench. "Snack time soon!"
{name} looks at {his} hands. Hmm? They look dusty and gray. "Germ pirates!" {name} giggles. Tiny pirates sail on tiny boats. "Yo-ho, yo-ho! We want snacks too!"
Lulu looks at her hands and laughs. "I have pirates too!" Grandma says, "After playing outside, we wash. Before eating, we wash." Lulu nods. "And after the potty!"
Grandma walks them to the park sink. She turns on the tap. Splash, splash! Wet hands first. Then a squirt of soap. The bubbles grow, white and fluffy. They smell so sweet.
"Let's sing!" says Lulu. {name} sings along. "Rub the palms, rub the backs, wiggle fingers in the cracks!" The bubbles dance. The pirates wobble. "Whoa, so slippery!"
Next come the thumbs. Twist and turn, twist and turn. Then the nails. Scrub, scrub, scrub! {name}'s fingers are busy little brushes. The pirate boats slide away. Whoosh!
The song is over. Now rinse with clean water. Splash, splash! The bubbles are gone. The pirates wave. "Bye-bye!" {name} dries {his} hands on a soft towel. Fresh and clean!
Grandma opens the snack box. Crunchy apple slices! {name} gives one to Lulu. Lulu gives one to {name}. Two pairs of clean hands tap together. "Our hands smell nice!" Crunch, crunch. Yum!

questions: {name}和露露在什麼時候要洗手呢？你今天什麼時候洗過手？
洗手的時候，{name}搓了手的哪些地方？你可以搓給我看看嗎？
為什麼吃點心前，{name}要先把手洗乾淨？
zh.tip: 這個星期每次洗手時，一起唱「搓搓手心，搓搓手背，手指縫縫鑽一鑽」，再加上轉轉大拇指、刷刷指甲，唱完才沖水擦乾。

questions: When did {name} and Lulu need to wash their hands? When did you wash yours today?
Which parts of the hands did {name} scrub? Can you show me?
Why did {name} wash before sharing the snack?
en.tip: This week, sing "Rub the palms, rub the backs, wiggle fingers in the cracks" every time you wash together, then twist the thumbs and scrub the nails before rinsing and drying.

zh: 城市的早晨，街上車子嘟嘟叫。{name}牽著媽媽的手，走進一間明亮的牙醫診所。牆上貼著好多笑咪咪的牙齒貼紙。櫃台阿姨說：「歡迎你，請先坐一下喔！」
沒多久，李醫生走出來了。她戴著藍色口罩，眼睛彎彎的。「{name}，你好！今天我們來數數你的牙齒，看看它們健不健康。」{name}點點頭，牽著媽媽走進小房間。
房間中間有一張大椅子。{name}坐上去，李醫生按下按鈕。椅子慢慢往上升，嗡嗡嗡！「哇，好像太空船！」{name}說。李醫生笑著說：「太空人準備好了嗎？三、二、一，出發！」
李醫生拿起一支小小的管子。「這是噴水先生，它會說噗咻！」她對著{name}的手心噴一下。涼涼的，好癢喔！{name}咯咯笑：「噴水先生好調皮！」
接著，李醫生拿出一根細細的小棒子，前面有一面圓圓的小鏡子。「這是數牙小幫手。它會輕輕點每一顆牙，幫我數數。」她先在{name}的指甲上點一點。叩叩叩，一點也不痛。
「我們約好一個暗號喔！」李醫生說，「如果你想休息，就舉起手，我馬上停下來等你。」{name}試著舉起手。李醫生立刻停住，比了一個讚。
「張大嘴巴，像小河馬一樣！」{name}張開嘴，數牙小幫手開始工作。「一、二、三……」數到一半，{name}的嘴巴好痠。{name}舉起手，李醫生馬上停下來，笑著等。{name}休息一下，深呼吸，又張開嘴巴。
「二十顆，全部都很健康！」李醫生說。噴水先生再噗咻一下，把牙齒洗得亮晶晶。椅子嗡嗡降落了。{name}從太空船走下來，手上拿著一張星星貼紙，開心地對媽媽說：「下次我還要坐太空船！」
en: The city was busy and bright. Cars beeped along the street. {name} held Mom's hand and walked into the dentist's office. Smiling tooth stickers covered the walls. "Welcome!" said the lady at the desk. "Please have a seat."

Soon Dr. Lee came out. She wore a blue mask, and her eyes crinkled. "Hello, {name}! Today we will count your teeth. We will check that they are healthy." {name} nodded and walked with Mom into a little room.

In the middle stood a big chair. {name} climbed up. Dr. Lee pressed a button. Hummm! The chair rose slowly. "It's like a spaceship!" said {name}. Dr. Lee laughed. "Ready, astronaut? Three, two, one, blast off!"
Dr. Lee held up a tiny tube. "This is Mr. Squirt. He says pssht!" She sprayed a little water on {name}'s palm. It felt cool and tickly! {name} giggled. "Mr. Squirt is silly!"
Next came a thin stick with a round little mirror. "This is the Tooth Counter. It taps each tooth so I can count." First, she tapped {name}'s fingernail. Tap, tap, tap. It did not hurt at all.
"Let's have a secret signal," said Dr. Lee. "If you need a break, raise your hand. I will stop and wait." {name} tried it. Up went {his} hand. Dr. Lee stopped right away and gave a thumbs-up.

"Open wide, like a little hippo!" The Tooth Counter got to work. "One, two, three..." Halfway through, {name}'s mouth felt tired. Up went a hand. Dr. Lee stopped and waited with a smile. {name} took a deep breath, then opened wide again.

"Twenty teeth, all healthy!" said Dr. Lee. Mr. Squirt went pssht and made them sparkle. The chair hummed back down. {name} stepped off the spaceship with a star sticker. "Mom, next time I want to fly again!"

questions: 李醫生在用噴水先生和數牙小幫手之前，先做了什麼？
{name}嘴巴累的時候怎麼做？李醫生怎麼回應？
如果你去看牙醫，你想幫哪個工具取什麼好玩的名字？
zh.tip: 今晚刷牙時玩「舉手暗號」遊戲：孩子一舉手，你就停下來等，讓孩子練習用舉手表達需要休息。

questions: What did Dr. Lee do before using Mr. Squirt and the Tooth Counter?
What did {name} do when {his} mouth got tired, and what did Dr. Lee do?
If you visit the dentist, what funny name would you give a tool?
en.tip: Tonight at toothbrushing, play the hand-signal game: when your child raises a hand, stop and wait, so raising a hand for a break feels easy.

zh: 週六下午，{name}和表哥小傑窩在沙發上，緊盯著平板裡的小恐龍跳過一座又一座火山。開始前，他們和爺爺約好只玩三十分鐘，還親手把計時器放在茶几上。
「叮鈴鈴！」計時器忽然響了。小恐龍正站在最後一關門口，{name}的手指停在半空中，嘴巴噘得能掛上一個油瓶。小傑也垮著臉說：「就差一點點耶！」
爺爺走過來，溫和地說：「差一點點最難停，對吧？先深呼吸三次，像吹泡泡一樣。」兩人吸氣、吐氣，越吹越誇張，最後笑成一團。{name}按下儲存，小恐龍乖乖待在原地等他們回來。
「走，帶你們去河濱公園，」爺爺眨眨眼，從櫃子裡拿出兩個捲起來的大東西，「今天有風箏比賽喔！」{name}好奇地摸了摸，一個是圓滾滾的紅色章魚，一個是長尾巴的綠色恐龍。
河濱公園的草地綠油油的，風呼呼地吹，天上早已飄著五顏六色的風箏。爺爺牽著兩人走到遠離河邊的大草坪。{name}抱著章魚風箏，小傑拿著恐龍風箏，兩人摩拳擦掌，準備一較高下。
{name}跑得飛快，章魚卻一頭栽進草裡，八隻腳亂七八糟。小傑的恐龍更好笑，竟然在空中翻了個筋斗。爺爺哈哈大笑：「別急，迎著風跑，線慢慢放，眼睛看著天空。」
{name}又試一次。這回風一推，章魚扭著腳往上竄，越飛越高，像在天上跳舞。小傑的恐龍也追了上來，兩隻風箏一前一後，你追我趕，惹得旁邊的小朋友拍手叫好。{name}仰著頭，覺得眼睛好舒服，連心都輕飄飄的。
比賽結束，章魚和恐龍並列最高，主持人送給他們一人一張貼紙。回家路上，夕陽把河水染成金色。小傑說：「我覺得放風箏比下一關還刺激！」{name}笑著點頭：「明天再跟爺爺約好時間，玩完遊戲，我們再來比一場！」
en: On Saturday afternoon, {name} and cousin Jack were snuggled on the sofa, watching a little dinosaur leap over volcano after volcano on the tablet. Before starting, they had agreed with Grandpa on thirty minutes, and set the timer on the table themselves.

Ring-a-ring! The timer went off. The dinosaur stood right at the door of the final level. {name}'s finger froze in midair, and {his} lips pushed out into the grumpiest pout ever. Jack flopped back. "We were so close!"

Grandpa came over and said gently, "So close is the hardest time to stop, isn't it? Let's take three big breaths, like blowing bubbles." They puffed and huffed, sillier each time, until they were giggling. {name} tapped save, and the dinosaur waited patiently.

"Come on, let's go to the riverside park," Grandpa said with a wink, pulling two rolled-up bundles from the closet. "There's a kite race today!" {name} unrolled one: a round red octopus. The other was a green dinosaur with a long tail.

The grass at the park was bright green, the wind was whooshing, and colorful kites already danced in the sky. Grandpa led them to a wide lawn far from the river. {name} held the octopus, Jack held the dinosaur, and they grinned, ready to compete.

{name} dashed off, but the octopus nosedived into the grass, its eight legs in a tangle. Jack's dinosaur did a somersault in midair! Grandpa laughed. "No rush. Run into the wind, let the string out slowly, and keep your eyes on the sky."

{name} tried again. This time the wind gave a push, and the octopus wiggled upward, higher and higher, as if it were dancing. Jack's dinosaur chased right behind it, and nearby kids clapped and cheered. Looking up, {name} felt {his} eyes relax, and {his} heart felt light as a feather.

When the race ended, the octopus and the dinosaur tied for highest, and each of them got a sticker. On the way home, the sunset turned the river gold. "Kites were way more exciting than the next level!" said Jack. {name} nodded. "Tomorrow we'll set a time with Grandpa, play our game, and then race again!"

questions: 計時器響的時候，{name}有什麼感覺？爺爺教了什麼方法幫忙？
放風箏的時候，{name}的眼睛和心情有什麼不一樣？
如果你玩到一半時間到了，你想選什麼好玩的事情接著做？
zh.tip: 這週玩平板前，和孩子一起設定計時器，並先想好一件「時間到之後」要一起做的活動，例如散步或讀一本書。

questions: How did {name} feel when the timer rang? What did Grandpa suggest to help?
How did {name}'s eyes and mood change while flying the kite?
If your time is up in the middle of a game, what fun thing would you like to do next?
en.tip: This week, set the timer together before screen time and pick one 'after the timer' activity in advance, like a walk or reading a book.

zh: 阿嬤住在台南的小巷子裡。巷口有一棵大榕樹，樹下總有貓咪在睡午覺。{name}最喜歡在這裡跳格子。可是明天，全家就要搬去台北了。{name}心裡有點興奮，也有點捨不得。
阿嬤拿來一個紙盒子。「這是回憶盒，」阿嬤笑著說，「把最喜歡的東西放進去吧。」{name}放進一顆小彈珠，一張全家福照片。還放了一片榕樹葉，綠綠的，有阿嬤家的味道。
搬家車開了好久好久。{name}一直抱著回憶盒，不肯放下。窗外的田變成高高的大樓。媽媽說：「台北到了。」{name}看著好多燈，眼睛亮亮的，可是想到阿嬤，鼻子又酸酸的。
新家在十二樓。房間空空的，白白的牆，好安靜。{name}坐在地上，小聲說：「這裡不像家。」爸爸坐過來，輕輕抱著{him}。「搬家會開心，也會難過，兩個都沒關係喔。」爸爸說。
{name}打開回憶盒。先拿出全家福照片，放在床頭。照片裡，阿嬤笑得好開心。再拿出小彈珠，放在窗台上。陽光一照，彈珠閃著藍藍的光。房間好像亮了一點點。
最後是那片榕樹葉。{name}把它夾進新的圖畫本裡。媽媽說：「我們打電話給阿嬤吧！」電話裡，阿嬤說：「巷口的貓咪很想你喔。」{name}咯咯笑了，心裡暖暖的。
隔天，{name}和媽媽一起搭電梯下樓。電梯裡有一個小女孩，抱著一顆皮球。她偷偷看著{name}，{name}也偷偷看著她。{name}深吸一口氣，勇敢地說：「你好，我剛搬來。」
「我叫小芸，住在十樓！」小女孩笑著說。「樓下有小公園，我帶你去玩！」在媽媽的陪伴下，兩個人在公園跳格子，玩得好開心。晚上，{name}在圖畫本上畫了新朋友，就畫在榕樹葉旁邊。
en: Grandma lived in a little alley in Tainan. A big banyan tree stood by the corner. Cats napped under it every afternoon. {name} loved playing hopscotch there. But tomorrow, the family was moving to Taipei. {name} felt excited, and a little sad too.

Grandma brought a paper box. "This is a memory box," she said, smiling. "Put your favorite things inside." {name} added a tiny marble and a family photo. Then a green banyan leaf. It smelled like Grandma's house.

The moving truck drove for a long, long time. {name} held the memory box the whole way. Fields turned into tall buildings. "We're in Taipei," said Mom. So many lights! But thinking of Grandma, {name} felt a little teary.

The new home was on the twelfth floor. The room was empty and quiet. "This doesn't feel like home," {name} whispered. Dad sat down and gave {him} a hug. "Moving can feel happy and sad," Dad said. "Both are okay."

{name} opened the memory box. First came the family photo, set by the bed. Grandma was smiling big. Next came the marble, placed on the windowsill. Sunlight made it glow bright blue. The room felt a little brighter.
Last was the banyan leaf. {name} tucked it into a new drawing book. "Let's call Grandma!" said Mom. On the phone, Grandma said, "The alley cats miss you." {name} giggled. It felt warm inside.
The next day, {name} and Mom rode the elevator down. A girl stood inside, holding a ball. She peeked at {name}. {name} peeked back. Then {name} took a deep breath. "Hi! I just moved here."

"I'm Yun! I live on the tenth floor!" she said. "There's a little park downstairs. Let's play!" With Mom watching, they played hopscotch together. That night, {name} drew a new friend, right beside the banyan leaf.

questions: {name}剛到新家時有什麼感覺？爸爸說了什麼？
如果你要做一個回憶盒，你會放進什麼？
{name}在電梯裡做了什麼勇敢的事？你會怎麼跟新朋友打招呼？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起找個小盒子，放進三樣珍貴的小東西，聊聊每樣東西背後的回憶。

questions: How did {name} feel in the new home at first? What did Dad say?
If you made a memory box, what would you put inside?
What brave thing did {name} do in the elevator? How would you say hi to a new friend?
en.tip: This week, find a small box with your child and put in three special things. Talk about the memory behind each one.

zh: 媽媽找到了新工作，全家要從熱鬧的城市搬到台東的山邊小鎮。{name}抱著紙箱，心裡又興奮又難過，像一杯同時加了糖和檸檬的汽水。最捨不得的，是最好的朋友小安。
出發前，小安送給{name}一張畫，上面是兩個人在公園盪鞦韆。「到了新家要寫信給我喔！」{name}用力點頭，把畫小心夾進{his}故事書裡，放在背包最上層。
新家的窗外，就是一層又一層的綠色山脈。可是房間空蕩蕩的，連回音都聽得見。{name}悶悶不樂地坐在箱子上。爸爸拿出那本故事書，媽媽拿出全家的舊相簿。「看，我們最喜歡的東西都跟著來了。」
第二天傍晚，爸爸牽著腳踏車說：「我們去探險吧！」父女……不，爸爸和{name}沿著稻田旁的自行車道慢慢騎。涼風拂面，遠山被夕陽染成橘紅色。{name}忍不住大喊：「哇，好像在畫裡騎車！」
騎累了，他們走進路口一家小小的麵店。老闆娘端來熱騰騰的湯麵，笑咪咪地多加了一顆滷蛋。「新搬來的吧？歡迎歡迎！」{name}吃得津津有味，連湯都喝得一滴不剩。
開學第一天，{name}緊張得手心冒汗。下課時，一個叫阿凱的男孩蹲在樹下，興奮地招手：「快來！是獨角仙！」那隻甲蟲黑亮亮的，角翹得高高的，正慢吞吞地爬上樹枝。
阿凱滔滔不絕地介紹各種甲蟲，說得眉飛色舞。{name}聽得目不轉睛，還問了好多問題。阿凱拍拍胸脯說：「週末我爸爸帶我去山邊看甲蟲，你也一起來吧！」
那天晚上，{name}拿出信紙，寫給小安：「我有新的腳踏車路線、最好吃的麵店，還認識了一個甲蟲博士。我還是很想你。」寫完，{name}把信折好，望向窗外的山，嘴角悄悄揚了起來。
en: Mom got a new job, so the whole family was moving from the busy city to a small town near the mountains in Taitung. Hugging a cardboard box, {name} felt excited and sad at once, like a soda with both sugar and lemon. Leaving best friend An was the hardest part.

Before they left, An gave {name} a drawing of the two of them swinging in the park. "Write to me from your new home!" {name} nodded hard and tucked the drawing carefully inside a favorite storybook, right at the top of {his} backpack.

Outside the new window, green mountains rose layer after layer. But the room was so empty it echoed. {name} slumped on a box. Dad pulled out the storybook, and Mom brought out the old family photo album. "Look, our favorite things came with us."

The next evening, Dad wheeled out the bikes. "Let's go exploring!" Dad and {name} pedaled slowly along a bike path beside the rice fields. A cool breeze swept past, and the sunset painted the mountains orange. "Wow," {name} shouted, "it's like riding through a picture!"

Tired and hungry, they stepped into a tiny noodle shop on the corner. The owner set down steaming bowls and, with a wink, added an extra braised egg. "New in town? Welcome!" {name} slurped every noodle and drank every last drop of soup.

On the first day of school, {name}'s palms were sweaty. At recess, a boy named Kai crouched under a tree, waving wildly. "Come quick! A rhinoceros beetle!" The glossy black beetle, its horn curved high, was creeping up a branch.

Kai chattered about beetle after beetle, his eyes sparkling. {name} listened closely and asked question after question. Kai grinned. "My dad takes me beetle-watching near the mountains on weekends. Want to come too?"

That night, {name} wrote to An: "I have a new bike path, the best noodle shop, and a friend who's a beetle expert. I still miss you a lot." Folding the letter, {name} gazed out at the dark mountains and smiled a quiet smile.

questions: {name}搬家時心裡有哪些感覺？你曾經同時有開心和難過的感覺嗎？
{name}在新家帶著哪些舊東西和回憶？
如果你搬到新地方，你會想先去找什麼新的喜歡的地方？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起散步，找一個附近的「新最愛角落」，並畫下來寄給一位想念的朋友或家人。

questions: What feelings did {name} have about moving? Have you ever felt happy and sad at the same time?
Which old things and memories came with {name} to the new home?
If you moved somewhere new, what new favorite place would you look for first?
en.tip: This week, take a walk together to find a "new favorite corner" nearby, then draw it and send it to a friend or relative your child misses.

zh: {name}在客廳玩積木。紅積木，藍積木，黃積木。一塊疊一塊，高高高！積木塔好高喔。{name}笑嘻嘻，拍拍{his}小手。
再放一塊就好。輕輕的，慢慢的。哎呀！積木塔晃一晃。嘩啦啦！全部倒下來了。積木滾滿地，咕嚕咕嚕。
{name}的肚子熱熱的。咕嚕嚕，轟隆隆！好像一座小火山。{name}抓起一塊積木，手舉得高高的。
爸爸走過來，蹲下來。「你好像很生氣。」爸爸說。「生氣沒關係。積木不丟喔，我們一起來吸氣。」{name}看著爸爸，手慢慢放下來。
「我們當小火龍吧！」爸爸說。「吸，好大一口氣。呼，慢慢吐出來。」一，大火龍吸氣，呼。二，大火龍吸氣，呼。三，大火龍吸氣，呼。
小火山變安靜了。肚子不熱了。{name}大聲說：「我好生氣！」爸爸點點頭：「為什麼生氣呢？」「因為塔倒了。我想要高高的塔！」
「那我們一起蓋，好不好？」爸爸說。{name}點點頭。爸爸拿大積木，放在下面。{name}拿小積木，放在上面。一塊疊一塊，穩穩的，高高的。
積木塔比剛才還要高！高到{name}要踮起腳。{name}和爸爸笑哈哈。「火龍好厲害！」{name}說。爸爸抱抱{him}，暖暖的。
en: {name} plays with blocks. Red blocks, blue blocks, yellow blocks. Stack, stack, stack! The tower grows so tall. {name} smiles and claps.
Just one more block. Slowly, gently. Oh no! The tower wobbles. Crash! Down it falls. Blocks roll all over the floor.
{name}'s tummy feels hot. Rumble, rumble, BOOM! It feels like a little volcano. {name} grabs a block and lifts it high.
Dad comes over and kneels down. "You look really mad," he says. "Mad is okay. Blocks stay down. Let's breathe together." {name} looks at Dad. The block comes down slowly.
"Let's be dragons!" says Dad. "Breathe in big. Blow out slow." One, dragon breath, whoosh. Two, dragon breath, whoosh. Three, dragon breath, whoosh.
The volcano grows quiet. The hot tummy cools. {name} says loudly, "I'm mad!" Dad nods. "Why are you mad?" "My tower fell. I want a tall tower!"
"Let's build together," says Dad. {name} nods. Dad puts big blocks at the bottom. {name} puts small blocks on top. Stack, stack, steady and tall.
The new tower is even taller! {name} stands on tiptoes to reach. {name} and Dad laugh. "Dragons are strong!" says {name}. Dad gives {him} a warm hug.

questions: 積木塔倒下來時，{name}覺得怎麼樣？
{name}和爸爸一起做了什麼，讓小火山安靜下來？
你生氣的時候，可以怎麼說出來？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子練習「火龍呼吸」：一起吸一大口氣，慢慢吐氣，數到三。生氣時，陪孩子說「我生氣，因為……」。

questions: How did {name} feel when the tower fell?
What did {name} and Dad do to calm the little volcano?
When you feel mad, what words can you use?
en.tip: This week, practice "dragon breaths" together: breathe in big, blow out slow, and count to three. When anger comes, help your child say, "I'm mad because…"

title.en: {name} and the Big Red Balloon Feeling

zh: 星期六早上，陽光暖暖的。{name}和媽媽一起來到公園。草地綠綠的，小鳥啾啾叫。{name}最喜歡的，是那座黃色的溜滑梯。它又高又長，滑下來好快好快。
溜滑梯前面排了一條隊伍。{name}乖乖站在最後面。前面有一個小妹妹，還有一個小弟弟。媽媽坐在旁邊的長椅上，對{name}揮揮手。
小妹妹滑下去了，咻！小弟弟也滑下去了，咻！終於輪到{name}了。{name}開心地抓住扶手，抬起腳，準備往上爬。
忽然，一個高高的大哥哥跑過來。他一下子就擠到{name}前面，咚咚咚爬上了階梯。{name}愣住了，小手還停在扶手上。
{name}的胸口熱熱的，臉也熱熱的。生氣的感覺越來越大，好像一顆紅氣球，一直鼓、一直鼓。{name}好想跺腳，好想大叫，好想把手上的樹葉丟出去。
可是{name}停了下來。{he}想起媽媽教過的方法。{name}慢慢吸一口氣，再慢慢吐出來。「一、二、三、四、五。」紅氣球好像漏了一點氣，變得小小的。
大哥哥滑下來，又跑回階梯前。{name}站得直直的，用清楚的聲音說：「我很生氣。剛剛是我先排的，該輪到我了。」大哥哥眨眨眼睛，臉紅了一下。
「對不起，我沒看到你。」大哥哥往後退一步，「你先溜吧！」{name}爬上去，咻地滑下來。接著換大哥哥，再換{name}。他們輪流溜了好多次，笑聲飛滿了公園。媽媽在長椅上，給{name}一個大大的笑臉。
en: It was a warm Saturday morning. {name} went to the park with Mom. The grass was green, and birds sang tweet, tweet. {name} loved the yellow slide best. It was tall and long and very fast.
Kids stood in a line by the slide. {name} waited at the very end. A little girl was in front, and a little boy too. Mom sat on a bench nearby and waved.
Whoosh! The little girl slid down. Whoosh! The little boy slid down too. At last, it was {name}'s turn. {name} grabbed the rail with a happy smile. One foot went up, ready to climb.
Suddenly, a tall big kid ran over. He squeezed right in front of {name}. Up the steps he went, clomp, clomp, clomp. {name} froze, one hand still on the rail.

{name} felt hot inside, and {his} cheeks felt hot too. The angry feeling grew and grew. It felt like a red balloon getting bigger. {name} wanted to stomp and shout. {name} wanted to throw the leaf in {his} hand.
But {name} stopped. Mom had taught a special trick. {name} took a slow breath in, then a slow breath out. "One, two, three, four, five." The red balloon let out some air. It felt much smaller now.
The big kid slid down and ran back to the steps. {name} stood tall and spoke clearly. "I'm angry. I was next. It's my turn." The big kid blinked, and his cheeks turned pink.

"Sorry, I didn't see you," he said, stepping back. "You go first!" {name} climbed up and slid down, whoosh! Then the big kid went, then {name} again. They took turns many times, laughing together. On the bench, Mom gave {name} a big smile.

questions: 大哥哥插隊的時候，{name}心裡有什麼感覺？{he}做了什麼讓紅氣球變小？
{name}是怎麼用說話告訴大哥哥自己的感覺？
如果你生氣得像一顆紅氣球，你可以怎麼做？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起練習「吹氣球呼吸」：慢慢吸氣、慢慢吐氣，數到五，再說一句「我很生氣，因為……」。

questions: How did {name} feel when the big kid cut in line? What did {he} do to make the red balloon smaller?
How did {name} use words to tell the big kid about the angry feeling?
If you feel as angry as a big red balloon, what can you do?
en.tip: Tonight, practice "balloon breathing" together: breathe in slowly, breathe out slowly, and count to five. Then practice saying, "I'm angry because…"

zh: 美術課上，陳老師說：「今天畫你最喜歡的動物！」{name}拿起藍色蠟筆，認真畫了一隻大鯨魚。{he}把尾巴塗得又圓又亮，還在旁邊畫了好多小泡泡，心裡越畫越開心。
坐在旁邊的阿哲探頭一看，忍不住哈哈大笑：「這是鯨魚嗎？看起來好像一顆藍色馬鈴薯！」幾個同學也跟著笑了。{name}的臉一下子變得好燙，胸口像有一團火在燒。
{name}的拳頭越握越緊，手裡的蠟筆都快被捏斷了。{he}好想把畫紙揉成一團丟出去，甚至想推阿哲一下。可是{name}想起陳老師說過：「生氣沒關係，但是不能打人、踢人或丟東西。」
於是{name}站起來，慢慢走到教室角落的「平靜小角落」。那裡有軟軟的抱枕、一個裝著閃亮亮片的瓶子，牆上還貼著一張小卡片，上面畫著一朵會呼吸的花。
{name}坐下來，搖一搖亮片瓶，看著亮片在水裡轉呀轉。{he}用鼻子慢慢吸氣，像在聞花香；再用嘴巴慢慢吐氣，像在吹蠟燭。一、二、三、四、五……{name}一邊數，一邊呼吸。
亮片慢慢沉到瓶底，{name}心裡的風暴也慢慢變小了。拳頭鬆開了，肩膀也不再緊緊的。陳老師走過來，輕聲問：「你準備好了嗎？」{name}點點頭，深深吸了最後一口氣。
{name}回到座位，看著阿哲說：「我很生氣，因為你笑我的畫。我很用心畫這隻鯨魚，我希望你不要再笑它。」阿哲愣了一下，耳朵都紅了。「對不起，我不是故意讓你難過的。其實你的泡泡畫得很好看。」
阿哲問：「我可以在你的鯨魚旁邊畫一條小魚陪它嗎？」{name}笑著說：「好啊，再畫一片海草吧！」兩個人一起拿起蠟筆，畫出一片熱鬧的大海。下課鐘響時，那隻藍色鯨魚已經有了好多新朋友。
en: In art class, Ms. Chen said, "Today, draw your favorite animal!" {name} picked up a blue crayon and carefully drew a big whale. {name} colored its round tail until it shone and added lots of little bubbles. The more {name} drew, the happier {he} felt.

Leo, who sat next to {name}, leaned over and burst out laughing. "Is that a whale? It looks like a blue potato!" A few other kids giggled too. {name}'s cheeks turned hot, and {his} chest felt like a fire was burning inside.

{name}'s fists squeezed tighter and tighter until the crayon almost snapped. {name} wanted to crumple up the drawing and throw it, or even push Leo. But then {he} remembered Ms. Chen's words: "It's okay to feel angry, but we don't hit, kick, or throw things."
So {name} stood up and walked slowly to the calm corner at the back of the classroom. It had soft pillows, a jar full of sparkly glitter, and a little card on the wall showing a flower that breathes.

{name} sat down and gave the glitter jar a shake, watching the sparkles swirl and spin. {name} breathed in slowly through the nose, like smelling a flower, then breathed out slowly, like blowing out a candle. One, two, three, four, five, {he} counted with each breath.

Little by little, the glitter settled at the bottom of the jar, and the storm inside {name} grew smaller too. {his} fists opened, and {his} shoulders softened. Ms. Chen came over and whispered, "Are you ready?" {name} nodded and took one last deep breath.

{name} went back to the table and looked at Leo. "I'm angry because you laughed at my drawing. I worked really hard on this whale, and I need you to stop laughing at it." Leo blinked, and his ears turned pink. "I'm sorry. I didn't mean to make you sad. Your bubbles are really cool."

"Can I draw a little fish to keep your whale company?" Leo asked. {name} smiled. "Sure! And some seaweed too!" Together they picked up their crayons and filled the page with a busy, bright ocean. When the bell rang, the blue whale had lots of new friends.

questions: {name}生氣的時候，身體有什麼感覺？{he}做了什麼讓自己平靜下來？
{name}回到座位時，用什麼話告訴阿哲自己的感覺？
如果有人笑你的作品，你會怎麼說出「我很生氣，因為……」？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起練習「聞花香、吹蠟燭」的慢呼吸，一邊數到五；也可以一起做一個屬於家裡的亮片平靜瓶。

questions: How did {name}'s body feel when {he} got angry, and what did {he} do to calm down?
What words did {name} use to tell Leo how {he} felt?
If someone laughed at something you made, how would you say "I'm angry because..."?
en.tip: Tonight, practice "smell the flower, blow out the candle" breathing together while counting to five. You could also make a glitter calm jar for your home.

zh: 叮咚，叮咚！門打開了。媽媽回家了。媽媽抱著小寶寶。是弟弟！弟弟好小好小。弟弟睡得香香的。{name}踮起腳，看了又看。
弟弟哭了，哇哇哇！媽媽抱弟弟。爸爸拍弟弟。大家都看弟弟。{name}站在旁邊。{name}的心，悶悶的。
{name}想到蛋糕。一塊蛋糕切一半。一半給弟弟，一半給{him}。愛也要切開嗎？{name}好擔心。{he}的嘴巴扁扁的。
{name}走到媽媽身邊。小聲說：「媽媽，我也要抱抱。」媽媽笑了。媽媽張開手。抱抱，緊緊的抱抱。
{name}說：「愛會變少嗎？」媽媽摸摸{his}頭。「愛不像蛋糕喔。愛像夜市的燈。」「點亮一盞新的燈，別的燈也一樣亮。」
{name}想一想。夜市的燈，一盞，兩盞，三盞。亮晶晶，亮晶晶。每一盞都好亮。{name}笑了，笑得好甜。
晚上，弟弟又哭了。哇哇哇，哇哇哇！媽媽說：「大哥哥大姊姊，可以幫忙嗎？」不對，媽媽說：「{name}，你會唱歌嗎？」{name}點點頭。
{name}輕輕唱。「睡吧睡吧，小寶貝。」弟弟不哭了。弟弟睡著了。媽媽抱著{name}，爸爸也抱著{name}。燈亮亮，心暖暖。晚安。
en: Ding-dong! The door opens. Mom is home. She holds a tiny baby. It is baby brother! He is so small. He sleeps so sweetly. {name} tiptoes to look.
Waah, waah! The baby cries. Mom holds him. Dad pats him. Everyone looks at the baby. {name} stands to the side. {name} feels a little sad.
{name} thinks of a cake. Cut a cake in half. Half for the baby. Half for {name}. Must love be cut too? {name} feels worried.
{name} goes to Mom. {name} whispers, "Mom, I want a hug too." Mom smiles. She opens her arms. A big, tight hug!
"Will love get smaller?" asks {name}. Mom pats {his} head. "Love is not like cake. Love is like night market lights. A new light makes no light dimmer."
{name} thinks and thinks. Night market lights. One light, two lights, three. Shiny, shiny, bright as can be! Every light still glows. {name} smiles a big smile.
At night, the baby cries again. Waah, waah, waah! Mom asks, "{name}, can you sing for him?" {name} nods. This is a big-sibling job!
