{name} sings softly. "Sleep, sleep, little one." The baby stops crying. He falls asleep. Mom hugs {name}. Dad hugs {name} too. Lights glow, hearts warm. Goodnight.

questions: {name}心裡悶悶的時候，{he}做了什麼？
為什麼媽媽說愛像夜市的燈？
如果你想要抱抱，你會怎麼跟爸爸媽媽說？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起想一首「哥哥姊姊的歌」，讓孩子唱給寶寶聽，並留五分鐘只屬於你們兩個的抱抱時間。

questions: What did {name} do when {he} felt sad?
Why did Mom say love is like night market lights?
If you want a hug, how would you tell Mom or Dad?
en.tip: Tonight, make up a 'big sibling song' together for the baby, and save five minutes of hug time just for the two of you.

zh: 今天，{name}和媽媽去動物園。看完獅子，看完大象。哇！前面有一個遊戲區。滑梯好高，鞦韆好長。還有一隻木頭長頸鹿，脖子長長，搖呀搖。
{name}跑過去，想要騎長頸鹿。咦？有一個小朋友也跑來了。他叫小安，戴著黃色帽子。兩個人都伸出小手，一起摸到長頸鹿的耳朵。
「我想騎！」{name}說。「我也想騎！」小安說。長頸鹿眨眨木頭眼睛，好像在笑。{name}想了想，沒有拉，也沒有搶。{he}小聲問：「你騎完，可以換我嗎？」
小安點點頭。「好呀！我們數數，一人跳十下！」小安爬上長頸鹿。蹦，蹦，蹦！{name}在旁邊數：「一、二、三……」數到五，{name}好想騎喔。等待，真的好難。
可是，{name}有一個好點子。{he}學長頸鹿，把脖子伸得長長的。「六、七、八！」小安看了哈哈笑。媽媽也笑了。等待，變成好好玩的遊戲！
「九、十！」小安跳下來。「換你囉！」{name}爬上去，抓好把手。蹦，蹦，蹦！這次換小安數數。小安學長頸鹿吃樹葉，嘴巴嚼呀嚼，嚼呀嚼。
「十！」換小安了。再換{name}，再換小安。蹦一蹦，數一數，笑一笑。兩個人輪來輪去，一點也不急。木頭長頸鹿搖呀搖，好像也很開心。
太陽慢慢下山了，要回家囉。{name}揮揮手：「小安，明天見！」小安也揮揮手。{name}牽著媽媽的手，一邊走，一邊數：「一、二、三……」
en: Today {name} and Mom visit the zoo. They see the lions. They see the elephants. Look! A play area! The slide is tall. The swing is long. And there is a wooden giraffe that rocks.
{name} runs to ride the giraffe. Oh! Another kid runs over too. His name is An. He wears a yellow cap. Both kids touch the giraffe's ears at once.
"I want to ride!" says {name}. "Me too!" says An. The giraffe seems to smile. {name} thinks. No pulling. No grabbing. "Can I have a turn when you're done?"
An nods. "Yes! Let's count. Ten bounces each!" An climbs up. Boing, boing, boing! {name} counts, "One, two, three..." At five, {name} wiggles. Waiting is so hard!
Then {name} has an idea. {name} stretches tall like a giraffe. "Six, seven, eight!" An giggles. Mom giggles too. Now waiting is a funny game!
"Nine, ten!" An hops down. "Your turn!" {name} climbs up and holds on. Boing, boing, boing! Now An counts. He munches pretend leaves. Munch, munch, munch!
"Ten!" Now it's An's turn. Then {name}. Then An again. Bounce and count. Count and laugh. Nobody is in a hurry. The giraffe rocks and rocks.
The sun sinks low. Time to go home. "Bye, An! See you soon!" An waves back. {name} holds Mom's hand. All the way home, they count, "One, two, three..."

questions: {name}和小安都想騎長頸鹿時，{name}說了什麼？
等待的時候，{name}做了什麼好玩的事？
如果你很想玩別人的玩具，你會怎麼說？
zh.tip: 這週玩玩具時，試試「一人數十下」的輪流遊戲，並一起練習說：「你玩完，可以換我嗎？」

questions: What did {name} say when both kids wanted the giraffe?
What funny thing did {name} do while waiting?
If you really want a friend's toy, what could you say?
en.tip: This week, try a "count to ten each" turn game with a toy, and practice saying together, "Can I have a turn when you're done?"

title.en: {name}'s Magic Words at the Breakfast Shop

zh: 早上好熱鬧。叭叭，公車開過去。媽媽牽著{name}的手。街角有一家早餐店。香香的味道飄出來。{name}的肚子咕嚕咕嚕叫。
早餐店好忙喔。鍋子滋滋響，蛋餅翻翻翻。煎台後面站著阿姨。阿姨圍著黃色圍裙。她笑笑地說：「早安！」{name}揮揮手：「阿姨早！」
媽媽小聲說：「試試魔法話？」{name}想一想，點點頭。{name}踮起腳尖說：「阿姨，請給我溫豆漿。」阿姨眼睛彎彎：「好有禮貌喔！」
阿姨端來一杯豆漿。白白的，暖暖的。杯子上有一根吸管。{name}捧著杯子說：「謝謝阿姨！」阿姨笑得好開心。她說：「不客氣，小可愛！」
{name}要去坐位子。腳步咚咚咚，好快喔。哎呀！撞到一張小凳子。凳子歪一歪，喀啦一聲。旁邊的爺爺嚇一跳。爺爺的報紙掉下去了。
{name}停下來，看看爺爺。{name}說：「爺爺，對不起。」{name}扶好小凳子，放得穩穩的。再撿起報紙，交給爺爺。爺爺摸摸鬍子，呵呵笑。
爺爺說：「謝謝你幫忙！」{name}笑了，爺爺也笑了。阿姨在煎台後面笑。媽媽也在旁邊笑。大家都笑咪咪的。{name}的心裡暖暖的。
{name}坐下來，喝一口豆漿。咕嘟咕嘟，好香好甜。請、謝謝、對不起。三句魔法話，叮叮叮。{name}小聲說：「明天還要說！」媽媽點點頭，摸摸{his}頭。
en: The morning is busy. Beep beep goes the bus. Mom holds {name}'s hand. There is a breakfast shop on the corner. It smells so yummy! {name}'s tummy rumbles.
The shop is busy too. The pan goes sizzle, sizzle. Egg pancakes flip, flip, flip. An auntie stands by the stove. She wears a yellow apron. "Good morning!" she says. {name} waves hello.
Mom whispers, "Try a magic word?" {name} thinks, then nods. Up on tiptoes, {name} says, "Warm soy milk, please." The auntie's eyes crinkle. "Such nice manners!"
She brings a cup of soy milk. It is white and warm. A straw pokes out the top. {name} holds it and says, "Thank you!" The auntie beams. "You're welcome, sweetie!"
{name} hurries to a seat. Tap, tap, tap go quick feet. Oops! {name} bumps a little stool. It wobbles. Clack! A grandpa jumps a bit. His newspaper slips to the floor.
{name} stops and looks at Grandpa. "I'm sorry, Grandpa," {name} says. {name} sets the stool straight and steady. Then {name} picks up the newspaper. Grandpa strokes his beard and chuckles.
"Thank you for helping!" says Grandpa. {name} smiles. Grandpa smiles too. The auntie smiles by the stove. Mom smiles nearby. Everyone is smiling. {name} feels warm inside.
{name} sits and sips the soy milk. Gulp, gulp. So sweet! Please, thank you, sorry. Three magic words. Ding, ding, ding! "I'll say them again tomorrow," {name} whispers. Mom nods and hugs {him}.

questions: {name}想要豆漿的時候，說了什麼魔法話？
{name}撞到凳子以後，做了哪些事讓爺爺開心？
今天有誰幫助你？你可以怎麼跟他說？
zh.tip: 這週吃早餐時，和孩子輪流說「請」和「謝謝」，每說一次就一起「叮」一聲當作魔法音效。

questions: What magic word did {name} say to get the soy milk?
After bumping the stool, what did {name} do to help Grandpa feel better?
Who helped you today? What could you say to them?
en.tip: At breakfast this week, take turns saying "please" and "thank you," and add a cheerful "ding!" together each time as a magic sound.

zh: 晚上到了，月亮出來了。爸爸輕輕關掉大燈。喀噠！房間變暗了。牆上出現好多影子。{name}抱緊小熊，小聲說：「爸爸，我有點怕。」
爸爸坐到床邊，摸摸{his}頭。「怕怕沒關係，爸爸在這裡。」爸爸拿出一支小手電筒。「我們來玩找影子，好不好？」{name}點點頭，小熊也點點頭。
咦，門邊有個高高的影子。高高的，黑黑的，動也不動。{name}打開手電筒，亮亮的光照過去。原來是{his}外套！掛在門後，安安靜靜。「外套晚安！」
叩、叩、叩。窗戶在響呢。叩、叩、叩。{name}拉拉爸爸的手。爸爸把光照向窗外。原來是一根小樹枝。風輕輕吹，樹枝輕輕敲。「樹枝晚安！」
地上有個圓圓的影子。圓圓的，軟軟的。光照過去，是{his}小球！還有積木，還有繪本。玩具都在，一樣也沒少。只是燈在休息而已。
爸爸打開小夜燈。暖暖的、黃黃的光，像一顆小月亮。房間沒有變，椅子還在，書架也還在。{name}抱著小熊，覺得好安心。
爸爸拉開窗簾。天上好多星星，一閃一閃，亮晶晶。「星星會整晚陪你。」爸爸說：「爸爸就在隔壁，你叫我，我就來。」{name}笑了。
{name}關掉手電筒，放在枕頭邊。小夜燈亮亮，星星眨眨眼。風呼呼，樹枝叩叩。小熊靠著{name}，暖呼呼。「外套晚安，星星晚安。」{name}慢慢睡著了。
en: Night came, and the moon came out. Dad turned off the big light. Click! The room got dark. Shadows filled the walls. {name} hugged Teddy tight. "Dad, I feel a little scared."
Dad sat on the bed. "It's okay to feel scared. I'm right here." He held up a little flashlight. "Let's go on a shadow hunt!" {name} nodded. Teddy nodded too.
Look! A tall shape stood by the door. Tall and dark and very still. {name} clicked on the flashlight. The light showed... {his} jacket! It hung on the door. "Goodnight, jacket!"
Tap, tap, tap. Something tapped the window. Tap, tap, tap. {name} held Dad's hand. Dad shone the light outside. It was a little branch. The wind made it tap. "Goodnight, branch!"
A round shadow sat on the floor. Round and soft. The light showed {his} ball! There were blocks and books too. Everything was still there. The lights were just resting.
Dad turned on the night light. It glowed warm and yellow, like a tiny moon. The chair was there. The shelf was there. {name} cuddled Teddy and felt safe.
Dad opened the curtain. So many stars! Twinkle, twinkle, shining bright. "The stars keep watch all night," said Dad. "I'm next door. Just call me." {name} smiled.

{name} turned off the flashlight and set it by the pillow. The night light glowed. The stars blinked. Tap, tap, went the branch. Teddy felt warm and cozy. "Goodnight, jacket. Goodnight, stars." Soon {name} was fast asleep.

questions: {name}看到高高的影子時，和爸爸一起做了什麼？
晚上聽到聲音時，你覺得可能是什麼呢？
你覺得怕怕的時候，什麼東西能讓你安心？
zh.tip: 今晚關燈後，和孩子用手電筒玩一次「找影子」，一起跟房間裡的東西說晚安，並約定好「叫一聲，大人就會來」。

questions: What did {name} and Dad do when they saw the tall shadow?
When you hear a sound at night, what could it be?
When you feel scared, what helps you feel safe?
en.tip: Tonight after lights out, play a short flashlight shadow hunt and say goodnight to things in the room. Agree that if your child calls, a grown-up will come.

zh: 森林裡有一條小溪。溪水清清的，嘩啦嘩啦地流。今天，爺爺帶{name}來到溪邊。小熊阿布和小兔米米也來了。大家要比賽樹葉小船！爺爺坐在大石頭上，笑著說：「我來當裁判。」
{name}撿了一片大大的黃葉子。{he}把葉子折一折，捲一捲，做成一艘小船。阿布用綠葉子做船，米米用紅葉子做船。三艘小船排在一起，好漂亮。爺爺站在溪邊，牽著大家的手。
「預備，開始！」爺爺喊。三艘小船放進水裡，順著溪水往前漂。{name}拍拍手，大聲說：「加油，加油！」可是一陣小風吹來，黃色小船晃了晃，咕咚一聲，翻過去了。
綠色小船先到終點，紅色小船第二。{name}的船，最後才慢慢漂過去。{name}嘟起嘴巴，眼睛熱熱的。{he}小聲說：「我好想贏喔。」爺爺摸摸{his}頭說：「難過沒關係，我們先吸一口氣。」
{name}慢慢吸氣，再慢慢吐氣。一次，兩次，三次。心裡的難過，好像變小了一點。阿布走過來說：「你的船好大，好厲害。」米米也說：「我們一起看看，它為什麼會翻？」
爺爺把黃色小船撈起來，交給{name}。{name}仔細看一看。船的兩邊太矮了，底部又歪歪的。「原來是這樣！」{name}說。阿布點點頭說：「我的船底是平平的喔。」{he}把方法教給{name}。
{name}又撿一片新葉子。這次，{he}把船底折得平平的，兩邊折得高高的。折到一半，葉子破了一個小洞。{name}沒有放棄，又換一片葉子，再慢慢折一次。新的小船站得穩穩的。
第二場比賽開始了！小風又吹來，黃色小船晃一晃，卻沒有翻。米米的船先到，{name}的船第二，阿布第三。{name}跑去對米米說：「恭喜你！」再對阿布說：「謝謝你教我。」傍晚到了，大家牽著爺爺的手，開心地回家。
en: A little stream ran through the forest. Its clear water went splish, splash. Today Grandpa took {name} to the stream. Bo the bear cub and Mimi the bunny came too. They would race leaf boats! Grandpa sat on a big rock. "I'll be the judge," he smiled.

{name} picked a big yellow leaf. {he} folded it and rolled it into a little boat. Bo made a boat from a green leaf. Mimi made one from a red leaf. Three boats sat in a row. Grandpa stood close and held everyone's hands.

"Ready, set, go!" called Grandpa. The three boats went into the water. They floated down the stream. {name} clapped and cheered, "Go, go, go!" Then a little breeze blew. The yellow boat wobbled. Plop! It tipped over.

The green boat finished first. The red boat came second. {name}'s boat drifted in last. {name} pouted, and {his} eyes felt hot. "I really wanted to win," {he} whispered. Grandpa patted {his} head. "It's okay to feel sad. Let's take a big breath first."

{name} breathed in slowly, then out slowly. Once, twice, three times. The sad feeling got a little smaller. Bo came over. "Your boat was so big. It was great!" Mimi said, "Let's look together. Why did it tip?"

Grandpa fished out the yellow boat and gave it to {name}. {name} looked closely. The sides were too low. The bottom was crooked. "So that's why!" said {name}. Bo nodded. "My boat has a flat bottom." He showed {name} how to fold it.

{name} picked a fresh leaf. This time {he} made the bottom flat and the sides tall. Halfway through, the leaf tore a tiny hole. {name} did not give up. {he} chose another leaf and folded slowly again. The new boat stood steady.

The second race began! A breeze blew again. The yellow boat wobbled, but it stayed up. Mimi's boat came first, {name}'s came second, and Bo's came third. {name} hugged Mimi. "Congratulations!" Then {he} told Bo, "Thanks for helping me." As evening came, everyone held Grandpa's hands and went happily home.

questions: {name}的船翻了、輸了的時候，{he}做了什麼讓心情變好？
你輸了遊戲的時候，心裡有什麼感覺？可以怎麼做？
第二場比賽後，{name}對朋友說了什麼？為什麼這樣很棒？
zh.tip: 這週玩遊戲輸了時，和孩子一起練習「慢慢吸三口氣」，再說一句「恭喜你」或「我們再玩一次」。

questions: When {name}'s boat tipped and lost, what did {he} do to feel better?
How do you feel when you lose a game? What could you do?
What did {name} say to friends after the second race? Why was that kind?
en.tip: This week, when someone loses a game, practice three slow breaths together, then say "Congratulations!" or "Let's play again."

zh: 星期三放學後，學校的圍棋社教室安安靜靜，只聽得見棋子落在棋盤上的清脆聲響。{name}第一次參加比賽，對手是同年級的阿哲。{name}深吸一口氣，捏起一顆黑子，小心翼翼地放在角落。
一開始，{name}下得很順手，黑子一顆接一顆，像小士兵排好隊伍。可是阿哲不慌不忙，白子悄悄繞到旁邊，把{his}一大塊黑棋團團圍住。{name}盯著棋盤，左看右看，卻怎麼也找不到逃出去的路。
「我輸了。」{name}小聲說，臉頰燙得像剛出爐的饅頭。{he}沒等老師講評，就把書包一背，躲到走廊盡頭的窗邊。{name}心想：「圍棋太難了，我再也不要下了。」
這時，六年級的小雯學姊走了過來。她沒有說「別難過」，只是靠在窗邊，陪{name}一起看操場上的麻雀蹦蹦跳跳。過了一會兒，她從背包裡拿出一本皺巴巴的筆記本。
「你猜這是什麼？」小雯學姊翻開筆記本，裡面密密麻麻畫滿了棋盤，每一頁旁邊都寫著字：「輸了，因為太貪心。」「輸了，忘記看右下角。」{name}瞪大眼睛問：「這些全部都是你輸的棋？」
學姊噗哧一笑：「一百零三盤，一盤不少。去年我還輸給一年級的小朋友呢！」她指著最後幾頁，「可是你看，後面的輸，跟前面的輸，已經不一樣了。每輸一次，我就多學會一招。」
{name}低頭看著那些歪歪扭扭的棋盤，心裡的悶氣慢慢消了。{he}深深吸了一口氣，再慢慢吐出來。「學姊，我可以也做一本嗎？」學姊點點頭，從背包裡撕下一張乾淨的紙，遞給{him}。
{name}走回教室，阿哲正在收棋子。{name}伸出手，大方地說：「你下得真好，恭喜你！下星期可以再跟我下一盤嗎？」阿哲愣了一下，隨即笑得眼睛彎彎：「好啊！到時候我教你那招包圍術！」窗外，小雯學姊悄悄豎起了大拇指。
en: On Wednesday after school, the Go club room was quiet except for the soft click of stones on wooden boards. It was {name}'s very first match, against a classmate named Jay. {name} took a deep breath, picked up a black stone, and carefully placed it in a corner.

At first, the game went well. Black stones lined up like tiny soldiers. But Jay stayed calm. His white stones crept around the side until a whole group of black stones was surrounded. {name} stared at the board, searching every direction, but there was no way out.

"I lost," {name} whispered, cheeks burning hot as a fresh bun. Without waiting for the teacher's comments, {name} grabbed a backpack and hurried to the window at the end of the hallway. Go is too hard, {name} thought. I'm never playing again.

Then Wendy, a sixth grader, walked over. She didn't say, "Don't be sad." She just leaned on the windowsill and watched the sparrows hopping across the playground with {name}. After a while, she pulled a crumpled notebook out of her bag.

"Guess what this is," Wendy said, flipping it open. Every page was crowded with little drawn boards and notes: "Lost. Too greedy." "Lost. Forgot the bottom corner." {name}'s eyes went wide. "Are these all games you lost?"

Wendy giggled. "One hundred and three. Last year I even lost to a first grader!" She pointed to the last pages. "But look. These losses aren't like the early ones. Every time I lost, I learned one new trick."

{name} looked at the wobbly drawings, and the heavy feeling slowly melted away. {name} breathed in deeply, then let the air out nice and slow. "Can I make a notebook too?" Wendy nodded, tore out a clean page, and handed it over.

Back in the classroom, Jay was putting stones away. {name} held out a hand. "You played really well. Congratulations! Can we play again next week?" Jay blinked, then grinned. "Sure! I'll show you my surrounding trick!" Outside the window, Wendy gave a quiet thumbs-up.

questions: {name}輸棋之後，心情怎麼樣？後來{he}做了什麼讓自己好一點？
小雯學姊為什麼要把輸掉的棋都記下來？
如果你在遊戲中輸了，你會對贏的人說什麼？
zh.tip: 這星期和孩子玩一個小遊戲，不論輸贏都互相握手說「謝謝你陪我玩」，並一起說出一件從這局學到的事。

questions: How did {name} feel after losing? What helped {him} feel better?
Why did Wendy write down all the games she lost?
If you lose a game, what could you say to the winner?
en.tip: This week, play a simple game together and, win or lose, shake hands and say "Thanks for playing with me," then each share one thing you learned from that round.

zh: 下雨天，{name}不能出去玩。{he}在客廳裡拍著小紅球。咚、咚、咚，球跳得好高。奶奶說：「小心喔，球在屋裡要輕輕玩。」{name}點點頭，說：「好！」
可是球越拍越開心。咚！小紅球跳上了桌子。叮的一聲，奶奶最愛的藍色茶杯倒了。{name}趕快扶起來，杯子上多了一條細細的裂痕。那是爺爺送給奶奶的杯子。
{name}的心跳得好快。{he}把茶杯藏進櫃子最裡面。再用一條小毛巾蓋住。奶奶在廚房裡唱著歌，什麼都沒發現。{name}小聲地說：「沒有人會知道的。」
下午，{name}想畫畫，可是畫不下去。{he}想吃餅乾，可是吃不下。心裡好像放了一顆大石頭，沉甸甸的。小貓咪咪走過來，喵喵叫。{name}摸摸咪咪，還是覺得好重。
奶奶走到櫃子前，說：「該喝下午茶囉。我的藍杯子呢？」奶奶找了又找。{name}的手心冒出汗來。{he}好想躲起來。可是看到奶奶著急的樣子，{name}慢慢走了過去。
{name}深深吸了一口氣。「奶奶，對不起。我在屋裡玩球，把杯子撞裂了。我很害怕，就把它藏起來了。」說完，{name}的眼淚掉了下來。心裡的大石頭，卻好像不見了。
奶奶蹲下來，緊緊抱住{name}。「謝謝你告訴我，這需要好大的勇氣。」奶奶摸摸杯子說：「裂痕不大，我們可以一起修好它。」{name}眨眨眼，問：「真的嗎？」奶奶笑著點點頭。
奶奶拿出特別的膠水，{name}幫忙扶著杯子。裂痕被補好了，像一條金色的小河。奶奶說：「我們叫它勇敢的杯子吧。」從那天起，奶奶喝茶時都會用它。每次看到它，{name}都笑得好開心。
en: It was a rainy day, so {name} played inside. {he} bounced a little red ball. Bounce, bounce, bounce! Grandma said, "Gently, please. Indoor balls need soft hands." {name} nodded and said, "Okay!"

But bouncing was so much fun. Boing! The red ball jumped onto the table. Clink! Grandma's favorite blue teacup tipped over. {name} set it up fast. Now it had a thin crack. Grandpa had given Grandma that cup.
{name}'s heart beat fast. {he} hid the cup deep in the cupboard. Then {he} covered it with a small towel. Grandma sang in the kitchen. She did not notice. "Nobody will know," {name} whispered.

All afternoon, {name} tried to draw, but couldn't. Cookies did not taste good. The secret felt heavy, like a big stone. Mimi the cat came by and said, "Meow." {name} petted her. The heavy feeling stayed.

At teatime, Grandma opened the cupboard. "Where is my blue cup?" She looked and looked. {name}'s hands felt sweaty. Hiding seemed easier. But Grandma looked so worried. Slowly, {name} walked over to her.
{name} took a deep breath. "Grandma, I'm sorry. I played ball inside and cracked your cup. I was scared, so I hid it." Tears rolled down. Yet the heavy stone felt gone.

Grandma knelt and gave {name} a big hug. "Thank you for telling me. That took courage." She looked at the cup. "The crack is small. We can fix it together." "Really?" asked {name}. Grandma smiled and nodded.

Grandma brought special glue. {name} held the cup steady. The mended crack shone like a little golden river. "Let's call it the brave cup," said Grandma. Now she drinks tea from it every day. And {name} smiles each time.

questions: {name}把杯子藏起來後，心裡有什麼感覺？
{name}說實話之後，奶奶做了什麼？
如果你不小心弄壞東西，你會怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子練習一句話：「我有一件事想告訴你。」當孩子說實話時，先抱抱並謝謝孩子的勇氣，再一起想辦法。

questions: How did {name} feel after hiding the cup?
What did Grandma do when {name} told the truth?
What would you do if you broke something by accident?
en.tip: This week, practice the phrase "I have something to tell you." When your child tells the truth, hug them and thank them for being brave before solving the problem together.

title.en: {name} and the New Friend at Lunch

zh: 星期一，班上來了一位新同學，叫做阿明。他從很遠的南方小鎮搬來，說話的腔調像唱歌一樣，尾音總是輕輕往上揚。老師請他自我介紹時，他緊張得手指絞在一起，聲音小得像蚊子。
到了午餐時間，阿明說：「我想要喝湯。」幾個同學立刻學他的腔調，故意拉長聲音，笑得前仰後合。阿明的臉漲得通紅，低頭扒飯，連最喜歡的玉米都沒吃幾口。{name}看在眼裡，心裡像被小石頭壓住一樣悶悶的。
第二天，同樣的事又發生了。{name}端著餐盤，猶豫了一下，然後走到阿明旁邊坐下。「這個位子有人坐嗎？」阿明搖搖頭，眼睛亮了一點。{name}問起他的家鄉，阿明說那裡有一整片會發光的螢火蟲田，{name}聽得津津有味。
下午的體育課要打躲避球。隊長們挑人時，沒有人喊阿明的名字，他孤零零地站在場邊。{name}舉起手大聲說：「我們隊要阿明！」有人在後面竊竊私語，{name}假裝沒聽見，拉著阿明跑進場內。
沒想到，阿明身手矯健得像一隻小猴子。球一飛來，他就靈巧地一閃，接著穩穩接住，再用力一擲，把對方最後一個人打出場外。全隊歡聲雷動，連剛才笑他的同學都張大了嘴巴，一時說不出話來。
可是放學前，{name}在走廊聽見有人說：「明天再學他講話，一定更好笑。」{name}的心怦怦跳。去找老師，會不會被說是愛告狀？{name}站在辦公室門口，來回踱步了三趟，最後深吸一口氣，敲了敲門。
林老師專心聽完，溫和地說：「謝謝你告訴我。有人被欺負，從來都不是他的錯。你來找我，是在幫阿明找幫手，不是告狀。」第二天，林老師讓全班輪流分享自己家鄉的說話方式，有人說台語，有人說客家話，教室裡笑聲不斷，卻沒有人再取笑別人。
午餐時，阿明的桌旁擠滿了想聽螢火蟲故事的同學。他抬起頭，對{name}眨眨眼，用那唱歌般的腔調說：「謝謝你，好朋友。」{name}咧嘴一笑，把自己的玉米分了一半給他。
en: On Monday, a new classmate named Ming joined the class. He had moved from a small town far to the south, and his voice had a sing-song accent that lifted at the end of each sentence. When he introduced himself, he twisted his fingers and spoke in a tiny whisper.

At lunch, Ming said, "I'd like some soup, please." A few kids copied his accent right away, stretching out the words and giggling. Ming's cheeks turned red. He stared at his tray and barely touched his corn. {name} watched, and a heavy feeling settled in {his} chest.

The next day, it happened again. {name} held {his} tray for a moment, then walked over and sat beside Ming. "Is this seat free?" Ming shook his head, and his eyes brightened a little. He told {name} about the fields back home, glowing with fireflies, and {name} listened, completely hooked.

In the afternoon, the class played dodgeball. When the captains picked teams, nobody called Ming. He stood alone at the edge. {name} raised a hand. "Our team wants Ming!" Someone whispered behind {him}, but {name} pretended not to hear and pulled Ming onto the court.

Ming turned out to be as quick as a monkey. He dodged, caught the ball cleanly, and threw it hard, knocking out the last player on the other team. Everyone cheered. Even the kids who had laughed at lunch stood there with their mouths hanging open.

But before home time, {name} heard someone in the hallway say, "Tomorrow let's copy him again. It'll be even funnier." {name}'s heart thumped. Would telling the teacher be tattling? {name} paced outside the office three times, took a deep breath, and knocked.

Ms. Lin listened carefully. "Thank you for telling me," she said gently. "When someone gets picked on, it's never their fault. Coming to me is getting help for Ming, not tattling." The next day, she had everyone share how people talk back home. The room filled with laughter, but no one made fun of anyone.

At lunch, kids crowded around Ming to hear about the fireflies. He looked up, winked at {name}, and said in his sing-song voice, "Thanks, my friend." {name} grinned and shared half of {his} corn with him.

questions: 阿明被取笑時，{name}做了哪些事來幫他？
{name}為什麼猶豫要不要告訴老師？你覺得告訴大人是告狀還是求助？
如果你看到有同學被笑，你可以怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子練習一句話：「老師，有人需要幫忙。」並一起想想在學校可以找哪些大人幫忙。

questions: What did {name} do to help Ming when he was laughed at?
Why did {name} worry about telling the teacher? Is telling a grown-up tattling or getting help?
What could you do if you saw a classmate being laughed at?
en.tip: This week, practice one sentence with your child: "Teacher, someone needs help." Then name together the grown-ups at school your child can go to.

zh: 窗邊有一個圓圓的魚缸。魚缸裡住著小金魚泡泡。泡泡是一條很老很老的金魚。牠陪了{name}好多年。每天早上，{name}都會說：「泡泡早安！」泡泡就吐出一串小泡泡。咕嚕，咕嚕，好像在回答。
可是今天早上，泡泡沒有游。牠靜靜地浮在水裡。媽媽輕輕走過來，坐在{name}旁邊。媽媽柔柔地說：「泡泡很老了，牠安安靜靜地死了。」{name}看著魚缸，眼睛熱熱的。眼淚一滴一滴掉下來。
{name}趴在媽媽懷裡哭。媽媽也流下眼淚。媽媽說：「我也很想泡泡。」媽媽輕輕拍著{name}的背。拍一拍，再拍一拍。{name}小聲問：「哭是不是不好？」媽媽說：「我們哭，是因為我們好愛牠。」
哭完了，{name}覺得有一點累。媽媽倒了一杯溫溫的牛奶。牛奶暖暖的，杯子也暖暖的。媽媽問：「你記得泡泡最會做什麼嗎？」{name}想了想，說：「牠會轉圈圈！」媽媽笑著點點頭。
媽媽拿出紙和彩色筆。{name}畫了一條橘色的小金魚。小金魚在轉圈圈，一圈，兩圈，三圈。{name}又畫泡泡躲在小石頭後面。還畫了泡泡吐出一串小泡泡。媽媽畫了泡泡游過來吃飯的樣子。
{name}把每一張畫排好。一張，兩張，三張，四張。{name}說：「這是泡泡的故事書。」媽媽說：「我們可以常常翻開來看。」{name}輕輕摸著畫裡的泡泡。心裡還是有點酸酸的，可是也暖暖的。
下午，媽媽拿來一個小花盆。{name}用小鏟子放進鬆鬆的土。媽媽把一株小橘花交給{name}。橘橘的花，跟泡泡一樣的顏色。{name}輕輕把花種好，澆一點點水。小花盆就放在窗邊，放在魚缸原來的地方。
天慢慢黑了，窗外好安靜。{name}躺在小床上，媽媽蓋好被子。月光淡淡地照在小橘花上。媽媽說：「難過會慢慢變輕，愛會一直在。」{name}點點頭，小聲說：「泡泡晚安。」小花靜靜的，房間也靜靜的。{name}慢慢閉上眼睛，睡著了。
en: A round fishbowl sat by the window. Inside lived a goldfish named Bubbles. Bubbles was very, very old. He had been with {name} for many years. Every morning, {name} said, "Good morning, Bubbles!" Bubbles blew a line of tiny bubbles back.

But this morning, Bubbles did not swim. He floated very still. Mom came and sat beside {name}. "Bubbles was very old," she said softly. "He died peacefully." {name} looked at the bowl. Warm tears began to fall.

{name} cried in Mom's arms. Mom cried a little too. "I miss Bubbles as well," she said. She patted {name}'s back. Pat, pat, and pat again. "Is it bad to cry?" {name} whispered. "We cry because we loved him so much," Mom said.

After crying, {name} felt a little tired. Mom poured a cup of warm milk. The milk was warm. The cup was warm too. "What was Bubbles' best trick?" Mom asked. {name} thought. "He swam in circles!" Mom smiled and nodded.

Mom brought paper and crayons. {name} drew a little orange fish. It swam in circles, one, two, three. Then {name} drew Bubbles hiding behind a pebble. Next came Bubbles blowing bubbles. Mom drew Bubbles swimming up for breakfast.

{name} lined up all the pictures. One, two, three, four. "This is Bubbles' storybook," said {name}. "We can look at it often," said Mom. {name} gently touched the drawn fish. It still felt a little sad. But it felt warm too.

In the afternoon, Mom brought a small pot. {name} scooped in soft, loose soil. Mom handed over a little orange flower. It was orange, just like Bubbles. {name} planted it gently and gave it a sip of water. They set it by the window, right where the bowl used to be.

Slowly, night came, quiet and soft. {name} snuggled into bed, and Mom tucked the blanket in. Moonlight shone on the orange flower. "Sad feelings get softer," Mom said. "The love stays." {name} nodded. "Goodnight, Bubbles." The room was still. Soon {name} was fast asleep.

questions: {name}難過的時候，媽媽做了什麼？
你最喜歡的動物或寵物，會做什麼好玩的事？
如果你想念一個朋友，你會怎麼記得牠？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起畫一張「最喜歡的回憶」，並說說：「難過的時候可以哭，我會陪著你。」

questions: What did Mom do when {name} felt sad?
What fun things does a favorite animal or pet do?
If you missed a friend, how would you remember them?
en.tip: Tonight, draw a favorite memory together and say, "It's okay to cry when you're sad. I'm right here with you."

zh: 麻糬是一隻好老好老的狗，毛色像烤過的麻糬一樣淡黃。上個星期，牠在最愛的軟墊上睡著，就再也沒有醒來。爸爸說，牠走得很安詳。家裡突然安靜得出奇，{name}每天放學，還是會不自覺地朝門口望一眼。
星期六早上，爸爸揹起背包，說：「我們去爬麻糬最喜歡的那座小山吧。」{name}點點頭，把一本空白筆記本和彩色筆塞進{his}小背包。山路兩旁開滿白色的小花，風一吹，草葉沙沙作響，好像有誰在後面跟著跑。
走到第一個轉彎，爸爸停下來笑了。「記得嗎？麻糬就是在這裡追蝴蝶，結果一頭栽進草叢，滿臉都是蒲公英。」{name}忍不住噗哧一笑，可是笑著笑著，眼淚卻撲簌簌地掉下來。{he}趕緊用袖子擦，怕爸爸看見。
爸爸蹲下來，輕輕抱住{name}。「想哭就哭吧，我昨晚也偷偷哭了。」{name}抬起頭，驚訝地看著爸爸。「真的嗎？」爸爸點點頭：「因為我們好愛牠啊。」兩個人靠在一起，等眼淚慢慢停了，才牽著手繼續往上走。
半山腰有一張木頭長椅。{name}坐下來，打開筆記本，畫了一隻胖胖的狗，耳朵一高一低。「麻糬的耳朵從來不會一樣高。」爸爸湊過來看，說得煞有其事：「還有牠的尾巴，搖起來像螺旋槳，差點把我的咖啡掃翻。」{name}笑著把螺旋槳尾巴也畫上去。
他們你一言我一語，回憶像泉水一樣湧出來：麻糬偷吃襪子、怕吸塵器、下雨天躲在{name}床邊打呼嚕。{name}一頁一頁地畫，一行一行地寫，連麻糬「汪汪」叫著討零食的模樣也沒漏掉。筆記本漸漸變得沉甸甸的。
終於爬到山頂。那裡有一棵大樟樹，麻糬以前總愛趴在樹蔭下吹風。{name}把筆記本翻到最後一頁，寫下：「麻糬的山坡。」心裡還是有一點酸酸的，可是不再像石頭那麼重了，反而有一種暖暖的感覺，慢慢擴散開來。
太陽漸漸西斜，他們沿著小路下山。爸爸問：「下次還想再來嗎？」「想！」{name}緊緊抱著回憶本，「我要再多想起一些麻糬的事，把本子畫滿。」晚風輕輕吹過山坡，像一條尾巴，在身旁開心地搖啊搖。
en: Mochi was a very, very old dog, pale and golden like a toasted rice cake. Last week, he fell asleep on his favorite cushion and never woke up. Dad said he died peacefully. Now the house felt strangely quiet, and every day after school, {name} still glanced at the door.

On Saturday morning, Dad grabbed his backpack. "Let's climb Mochi's favorite hill," he said. {name} nodded and tucked a blank notebook and some colored pencils into a small bag. White flowers lined the trail, and the grass rustled in the wind, as if someone were trotting behind them.

At the first bend, Dad stopped and laughed. "Remember when Mochi chased a butterfly right here and tumbled into the weeds? His whole face was covered in dandelion fluff!" {name} giggled, but the giggle turned into tears. {name} wiped them away fast, hoping Dad wouldn't notice.

Dad knelt down and hugged {name} gently. "It's okay to cry. I cried last night too." {name} looked up, surprised. "Really?" Dad nodded. "Because we loved him so much." They held each other until the tears slowed, then walked on, hand in hand.

Halfway up stood a wooden bench. {name} sat down, opened the notebook, and drew a chubby dog with one ear up and one ear down. "Mochi's ears were never even." Dad leaned in. "And his tail spun like a propeller. It nearly knocked over my coffee!" {name} laughed and added a propeller tail.

The memories kept bubbling up: Mochi stealing socks, hiding from the vacuum, snoring beside {name}'s bed on rainy nights. {name} drew page after page, even Mochi barking "Woof! Woof!" for treats. Slowly, the notebook grew heavy and full.

At the top stood a big camphor tree, where Mochi loved to nap in the shade. On the last page, {name} wrote, "Mochi's Hill." {his} heart still ached a little, but it no longer felt heavy as a stone. Instead, a warm feeling spread slowly through it.

As the sun sank lower, they headed home down the path. "Want to come back someday?" Dad asked. "Yes!" {name} hugged the memory book tight. "I'll remember more about Mochi and fill every page." The evening breeze swished across the hill, like a happy tail wagging beside them.

questions: {name}在山路上想起麻糬時，為什麼會又笑又哭？
爸爸說他也哭了，你覺得{name}聽到後心裡有什麼感覺？
如果要做一本回憶本，你想畫下哪一段特別的回憶？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起做一頁回憶畫，畫下一個想念的寵物或人，並說說那段回憶的故事。告訴孩子：「想念是因為我們很愛。」

questions: Why did {name} laugh and cry at the same time on the trail?
How do you think {name} felt when Dad said he cried too?
If you made a memory book, which special memory would you draw?
en.tip: This week, make one memory page together, drawing a pet or person you miss and telling the story behind it. Tell your child, "We miss them because we love them."

zh: 今天天氣好晴朗。爸爸牽著{name}，走過熱鬧的城市。叭叭！公車開過去。{name}和爸爸走進小小的診所。門口有一隻胖胖的熊貓玩偶，在對{name}揮手。
候診室好安靜。小魚缸裡，魚兒吐泡泡，啵、啵、啵。{name}坐在爸爸腿上。「今天要打疫苗喔。」爸爸說。{name}的小手縮起來了。「打針會痛嗎？」{name}小聲問。
「{name}！」護理師阿姨笑咪咪地叫。她的名字是小美阿姨。她的口罩上畫著小白兔。{name}慢慢走進去。醫生伯伯說：「你好！我們來幫身體變強壯。」他先聽聽{name}的心跳，咚咚、咚咚。
小美阿姨拿出一支小小的針。{name}抱緊爸爸。「我有點怕怕。」小美阿姨蹲下來，輕輕地說：「怕怕沒關係喔。這是一個保護盾。它會教身體打敗壞細菌。」
「保護盾？」{name}眨眨眼。「對呀！像超級英雄的盾牌。」小美阿姨說。{name}想一想，舉起手臂。「咻！擋住細菌！」爸爸笑了，醫生伯伯也笑了。熊貓玩偶好像也在笑。
爸爸伸出大大的手。「來，握著爸爸。」{name}緊緊握住。「一、二、三。」小美阿姨數著。刺一下，好快！像小螞蟻咬一口。{name}哇的哭了一下下，眼淚掉下來。
「哭一哭沒關係。」爸爸抱抱{name}，摸摸{his}背。小美阿姨貼上一個小OK繃。「好了喔！保護盾已經裝好了。」{name}吸吸鼻子，看看手臂。咦，已經不太痛了。
小美阿姨拿出一盒貼紙。有星星、小狗，還有盾牌。{name}挑了亮亮的盾牌。「謝謝阿姨！」{name}把貼紙貼在手上，跟熊貓玩偶說掰掰。牽著爸爸，{name}開心地走回家，一蹦、一跳。
en: The sun was shining bright. Dad held {name}'s hand in the busy city. Beep, beep! A bus rolled by. They went into a little clinic. A chubby toy panda waved hello.
The waiting room was quiet. Fish blew bubbles in a tank. Pop, pop, pop! {name} sat on Dad's lap. "Today is vaccine day," Dad said. {name} curled up small. "Will the shot hurt?"
"{name}!" called a smiling nurse. Her name was Nurse May. Her mask had a bunny on it. The doctor said, "Hello! Let's help your body stay strong." He listened to {name}'s heart. Thump, thump!
Nurse May showed a tiny needle. {name} hugged Dad tight. "I feel a little scared." Nurse May knelt down. "It's okay to feel scared. This is a shield. It teaches your body to fight germs."
"A shield?" {name} blinked. "Yes! Like a superhero shield," said Nurse May. {name} lifted an arm. "Whoosh! Stop, germs!" Dad laughed. The doctor laughed too. Even the panda seemed to smile.
Dad held out his big hand. "Hold on to me." {name} squeezed it tight. "One, two, three," counted Nurse May. A quick pinch, like a tiny ant bite! {name} cried a little.
"It's okay to cry," Dad said. He gave {name} a big hug. Nurse May added a small bandage. "All done! Your shield is ready." {name} sniffed and looked. Hey, it barely hurt now!

Nurse May held out a sticker box. Stars, puppies, and shiny shields! {name} picked a shiny shield. "Thank you!" {name} waved bye to the panda. Then {name} skipped home, holding Dad's hand. Hop, hop, hop!

questions: {name}覺得怕怕的時候，爸爸做了什麼？
小美阿姨說打針像什麼？它會幫身體做什麼？
如果你去打針，你想握誰的手？
zh.tip: 這週可以在家玩「看醫生」遊戲，輪流當護理師，數「一、二、三」後輕捏手臂，再一起喊「保護盾裝好了！」。

questions: What did Dad do when {name} felt scared?
What did Nurse May say a shot is like? How does it help our body?
If you get a shot, whose hand would you like to hold?
en.tip: This week, play "clinic" at home: take turns being the nurse, count "one, two, three," give a gentle arm squeeze, and cheer "Shield ready!" together.

zh: 星期六下午，{name}想看卡通。媽媽拿出廚房的計時器。「我們看兩集，轉到這裡就好。」{name}點點頭，自己轉好計時器。「說好囉！」媽媽笑著說。卡通開始了，小狐狸豆豆和刺蝟球球出場啦！
今天，球球要做一個大蛋糕。豆豆聞一聞麵粉，鼻子好癢。「哈啾！」好大的噴嚏！麵粉飛得到處都是。球球變成白白的雪球！球球滾呀滾，滾進豆豆的懷裡。{name}笑得在沙發上打滾。最好笑的地方要來了！
「叮鈴鈴！叮鈴鈴！」計時器響了。媽媽走過來，按下暫停。「哎唷！」{name}嘟著嘴說。「正好笑耶！再一下下嘛！」{name}把{his}抱枕抱得緊緊的。媽媽蹲下來，輕輕抱一抱。「停在好笑的地方，真的很可惜，對不對？」
「我們來當氣球好不好？」媽媽說。{name}吸了一口好大的氣。一直吸，一直吸，鼓得圓圓的。然後慢慢吐出來，「噗嚕嚕嚕——」好像氣球咻地飛走了。{name}忍不住笑出來。再吹一次，心裡的氣也跑光光了。
「那現在要玩什麼呢？」媽媽問。{name}看看客廳四周。角落有一個大紙箱。昨天，它裝著新被子回家。{name}想到一個好點子。「我要讓豆豆和球球，從電視裡跑出來！」媽媽眨眨眼說：「好期待喔！」
爸爸幫忙在紙箱上，開一個大窗戶。{name}在紙上畫狐狸和刺蝟。再用膠帶黏在吸管上。球球的刺好難畫喔。畫出來，好像一根一根薯條！「這是薯條刺蝟！」爸爸笑得肚子好疼。
布偶戲開演囉！{name}躲在紙箱後面，搖一搖豆豆。「哈……哈……哈啾！」球球咕嚕咕嚕滾下舞台。奶奶拍拍手。小貓咪咪也跑來看。「喵——」咪咪撲向球球。全家人笑成一團。
演完了，{name}伸個大懶腰，眨眨眼睛。眼睛好舒服，好像休息過了。媽媽拿來一本故事書。大家擠在沙發上一起讀。「明天看卡通，我還要自己轉計時器。」{name}說。「然後再演一場薯條刺蝟！」
en: On Saturday afternoon, {name} wanted to watch cartoons. Mom brought out the kitchen timer. "Let's watch two shows. The timer will tell us when." {name} nodded and turned the timer. "It's a deal!" said Mom. On came Fox Dodo and Hedgehog Bobo!

Today, Bobo was baking a giant cake. Dodo sniffed the flour. Then came a huge sneeze. "Ah-CHOO!" Flour flew everywhere. Bobo turned into a fluffy white snowball! Bobo rolled and rolled, right into Dodo's arms. {name} giggled and giggled. The funniest part was coming next!

"Ring-a-ling! Ring-a-ling!" The timer rang. Mom came over and pressed pause. "Oh no!" {name} grumbled. "It was so funny! Just one more minute!" {name} squeezed {his} pillow tight. Mom knelt down for a gentle hug. "Stopping at a funny part is hard, isn't it?"

"Let's be balloons," said Mom. {name} took a big, big breath. In it went, all puffy and round. Then out it came, slowly. "Pbbbbbt!" It sounded like a balloon zooming away. {name} couldn't stop laughing. One more puff, and the grumpy feeling floated off too.

"So what shall we play now?" asked Mom. {name} looked around the living room. In the corner sat a big cardboard box. Yesterday it had held a new blanket. {name} had a great idea. "I'll bring Dodo and Bobo out of the TV!" Mom winked. "I can't wait!"

Dad helped cut a big window in the box. {name} drew a fox and a hedgehog. Then they got taped onto straws. Bobo's spikes were tricky to draw. They looked like french fries! "It's a french fry hedgehog!" Dad laughed until his tummy hurt.

The puppet show began! {name} hid behind the box and wiggled Dodo. "Ah... ah... CHOO!" Bobo tumbled off the stage. Grandma clapped. Mimi the cat ran over to watch. "Meow!" Mimi pounced on Bobo. The whole family laughed together.

After the show, {name} gave a big stretch and blinked. {his} eyes felt cozy and rested. Mom brought a storybook. Everyone snuggled on the sofa to read. "Tomorrow I'll set the timer again," said {name}. "Then we'll do another french fry hedgehog show!"

questions: 計時器響的時候，{name}心裡覺得怎麼樣？後來{name}做了什麼讓自己舒服一點？
{name}和媽媽在看卡通前說好了什麼？我們也可以一起說好嗎？
關掉電視以後，你最想跟家人玩什麼？
zh.tip: 今晚看影片前，讓孩子自己轉計時器並說「說好囉！」；鈴響時一起當「氣球」深呼吸三次，再選一個不用螢幕的遊戲。

questions: How did {name} feel when the timer rang? What did {name} do to feel better?
What did {name} and Mom agree on before the cartoon started? Can we make a deal like that too?
When the TV is off, what would you most like to play with our family?
en.tip: Tonight, before any show, let your child set the timer and say "It's a deal!" When it rings, take three balloon breaths together, then pick one screen-free game.

zh: 早上，太陽暖暖的。{name}和爸爸站在陽台上。陽台有小花，還有綠綠的草。啾啾！啾啾！是誰在唱歌呀？
{name}往對面大樓看。屋簷下，有一個小鳥窩。麻雀媽媽飛進去，又飛出來。啾啾！啾啾！窩裡好熱鬧。
「我想看清楚一點！」{name}說。{name}抓住欄杆，想要往上爬。爸爸輕輕牽住{his}小手。「腳腳踩地板，我們想別的辦法。」
「陽台是看風景、種花的地方。」爸爸笑著說。「我們來做一個探險工具！」{name}眼睛亮亮的。「什麼工具呀？」
爸爸拿來紙捲筒，還有膠帶。{name}拿來彩色筆。畫星星，畫小鳥，畫圓圈。黏一黏，接一接。長長的紙望遠鏡做好了！
{name}和爸爸站在窗邊。腳腳踩地板，爸爸在身旁。{name}舉起紙望遠鏡，瞇起一隻眼睛。看呀看，看呀看。
「我看到了！」{name}小聲說。窩裡有三隻小麻雀。小嘴巴張得大大的。啾啾！啾啾！麻雀媽媽送來一隻小蟲。
「牠們在吃早餐！」{name}笑了。爸爸也笑了。{name}把望遠鏡抱在懷裡。「明天，我們再來探險！」爸爸說：「好，一起來！」
en: The morning sun is warm. {name} and Dad stand on the balcony. There are flowers and green leaves. Cheep, cheep! Who is singing?
{name} looks at the next building. A little nest hides under the roof. Mama Sparrow flies in. She flies out again. Cheep, cheep! The nest is busy.
"I want a closer look!" says {name}. {name} grabs the railing to climb. Dad gently holds {his} hand. "Feet on the floor. Let's find another way."
"Balconies are for looking and for plants," Dad smiles. "Let's make an explorer tool!" {name}'s eyes shine. "What kind of tool?"
Dad brings cardboard tubes and tape. {name} brings bright markers. Draw stars, draw birds, draw circles. Stick, stick, stick! A long cardboard telescope is ready!
{name} and Dad stand by the window. Feet on the floor, Dad close by. {name} lifts the telescope and shuts one eye. Look, look, look!
"I see them!" whispers {name}. Three baby sparrows sit in the nest. Their beaks open wide. Cheep, cheep! Mama brings a tiny bug.
"They're eating breakfast!" {name} laughs. Dad laughs too. {name} hugs the telescope close. "Tomorrow we'll explore again!" Dad says, "Yes, together!"

questions: {name}想看小鳥窩時，爸爸想了什麼好辦法？
在窗邊或陽台看外面時，我們的腳要放在哪裡？誰要陪在旁邊？
如果你想看清楚窗外的東西，你會怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起做一個紙望遠鏡，並練習一句話：「腳腳踩地板，大人在旁邊。」每次到窗邊前一起說一遍。

questions: When {name} wanted to see the nest, what good idea did Dad have?
When we look out a window or balcony, where do our feet go? Who stands with us?
If you want a closer look at something outside, what could you do?
en.tip: This week, make a cardboard telescope together and practice the phrase "Feet on the floor, grown-up close by." Say it together each time you go to a window.

zh: 星期三的體育課，陽光灑滿整個操場。林老師吹了一聲哨子，宣布今天要玩新遊戲「火箭接力」。大家兩人一組，從起點跑到橘色的三角錐，再跑回來，用擊掌當作終點。{name}和同學們興奮得跳來跳去，等不及要出發了。
輪到小安和阿凱那一組時，阿凱一跑回來，就突然把小安抱起來轉圈圈，大喊：「火箭升空囉！」小安的腳懸在半空中，雙手緊緊抓著阿凱的袖子。「放我下來！我不要！」小安說。可是阿凱笑得太大聲，好像根本沒聽見。
{name}站在旁邊，心裡突然揪了一下。{he}想起過年的時候，大阿姨一直想親{name}的臉頰。{name}說了「不要，謝謝」，大家卻只是笑著說「好可愛喔」。那種說了話卻沒人聽見的感覺，悶悶的，好像胸口塞了一團濕濕的棉花。
後來，是媽媽蹲下來，輕聲問：「你想用什麼方式跟阿姨打招呼呢？」{name}伸出手掌，阿姨馬上笑著跟{him}擊了一個響亮的掌。那一刻，{name}覺得自己的話被好好接住了。想到這裡，{name}深深吸了一口氣。
{name}跑到兩人面前，聲音有點抖，每個字卻都很清楚：「阿凱，小安說不要了！請你放她下來。」阿凱愣了一下，看見小安皺著眉頭，趕快輕輕把她放回草地上。小安拍拍衣服，小聲說：「我不喜歡被突然抱起來，我嚇了一跳。」
阿凱的臉紅紅的：「對不起，我以為這樣很好玩。」林老師走過來，蹲在三個人旁邊，認真聽完每個人說的話。她對{name}點點頭：「謝謝你勇敢說出來，替朋友，也替自己。」接著，她吹響哨子，請全班圍成一個圈坐下。
林老師問大家：「怎麼樣才能讓遊戲對每個人都好玩呢？」{name}舉起手說：「想抱人、牽手或把別人抬起來以前，先問一問。如果對方說不要，就換成擊掌或揮揮手。」大家都點點頭。林老師在白板的遊戲規則下面，寫了大大的四個字：「先問一問」。
遊戲重新開始了。阿凱跑回終點，先問小安：「我可以抱你轉一圈嗎？」小安搖搖頭：「不要，我們擊掌好嗎？」「好！」兩隻手「啪」地拍在一起。後來{name}想牽小安排隊，也先問了一聲。小安揮揮手說想自己走，{name}笑著說：「沒問題！」林老師在一旁也笑了。
en: On Wednesday, sunshine poured over the school field. Ms. Lin blew her whistle and announced a brand-new game called Rocket Relay. Partners would race to the orange cone, zoom back, and finish with a high five. {name} bounced up and down with the rest of the class, ready to go.

When it was An and Kai's turn, Kai dashed back, scooped An up, and spun around. "Rocket blast-off!" he shouted. An's feet dangled in the air, and her hands gripped Kai's sleeve. "Put me down! I don't want to!" But Kai was laughing too loudly to hear.

Watching them, {name} felt a tight squeeze inside. At New Year, Auntie had kept trying to kiss {name}'s cheek. {name} had said, "No, thank you," but everyone just laughed and said, "So cute!" Not being heard had felt heavy, like a wet sponge stuck in {his} chest.

Then Mom had knelt down and asked softly, "How would you like to say hello to Auntie?" {name} held up a hand, and Auntie smiled and gave it a big, smacking high five. In that moment, {name} felt truly listened to. Remembering it now, {name} took a deep breath.

{name} ran over. The words came out a little wobbly, but clear. "Kai, An said no! Please put her down." Kai blinked, saw An's worried frown, and set her gently on the grass. An brushed off her shirt. "I don't like being picked up by surprise. It startled me."

Kai's cheeks turned pink. "Sorry. I thought it was fun." Ms. Lin came over, crouched beside the three of them, and listened carefully to each one. She nodded at {name}. "Thank you for speaking up, for your friend and for you too." Then she blew her whistle and called everyone into a circle.

"How can we make this game fun for everyone?" Ms. Lin asked. {name} raised a hand. "Before we hug, hold hands, or lift someone up, we ask first. If they say no, we do a high five or a wave instead." Everyone nodded, and Ms. Lin wrote two big words under the game rules: ASK FIRST.

The game began again. Kai raced back and asked, "Can I spin you around?" An shook her head. "No, thanks. High five?" "Okay!" Smack! Later, {name} asked to hold An's hand in line. An waved and said she'd rather walk alone. "No problem!" {name} said with a grin, and Ms. Lin smiled nearby.

questions: 小安說「不要」的時候，{name}做了什麼？你覺得小安那時候心裡感覺怎麼樣？
如果有人想抱你或親你，可是你不想，你可以怎麼說、怎麼做？
別人對你說「不要」的時候，你會怎麼回應？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起練習一句話：「不要，謝謝，我們擊掌好嗎？」並在家族聚會前先問孩子想用擁抱、擊掌還是揮手打招呼，然後尊重孩子的選擇。若大人需要協助，可撥打113保護專線。

questions: What did {name} do when An said no? How do you think An felt at that moment?
If someone wants to hug or kiss you and you don't want to, what could you say or do?
What do you do when someone tells you no?
en.tip: This week, practice one phrase together: "No, thank you. High five instead?" Before family gatherings, ask your child whether they'd like to greet with a hug, a high five, or a wave, and respect their choice. Adults in Taiwan who need support can call the 113 child protection hotline.

zh: 妹妹小米出生後，家裡變得好熱鬧。奶奶一進門，就說：「小米好可愛！」媽媽抱著小米，輕輕哼著歌。{name}拿著新畫的彩虹，跑過去說：「你們看！」可是大家都在看小米。{name}低下頭，覺得自己好像隱形了。
{name}走回房間，抱著小熊坐在床邊。{his}心裡酸酸的，悶悶的。「為什麼大家都只看妹妹？」{name}小聲問小熊。小熊不會回答。{name}有一點想哭，也有一點生氣。那種感覺好像小刺，一直扎著心。
晚上，爸爸來說故事。{name}抓著爸爸的手說：「爸爸，大家都只看小米。我不喜歡這樣。」爸爸把{name}抱進懷裡。「謝謝你告訴我。」爸爸說，「有這種感覺沒關係。」爸爸想了想，又問：「每個星期六，我們去公園散步，只有我們兩個，好不好？」
星期六早上，陽光暖暖的。{name}牽著爸爸的手，走進公園。「今天是我們的專屬時間。」爸爸笑著說。他們撿紅紅的落葉，比誰的最大。鴿子咕咕叫，一邊走一邊點頭。爸爸還教{name}唱一首散步歌。
走到盪鞦韆旁邊，{name}說：「等小米長大，我要教她盪鞦韆！」可是{name}自己還不太會。{his}腳亂踢一通，鞦韆只晃一點點。爸爸說：「腳往前伸，再往後彎。」{name}試了一次，又一次。鞦韆終於盪得好高！
「我還要教小米找瓢蟲！」{name}在草叢裡仔細看。看了好久，終於找到一隻小小的紅瓢蟲。爸爸拿出小筆記本，寫下「教妹妹清單」。第一項：盪鞦韆。第二項：找瓢蟲。每個星期六，清單都變得更長了。
有一天下午，小米哇哇大哭。媽媽怎麼哄都哄不好。{name}走到搖籃旁，輕輕唱起那首散步歌。小米慢慢不哭了，眨眨眼睛，看著{name}。她的小手抓住{name}的手指。媽媽笑著說：「她最喜歡聽你唱歌了。」
媽媽張開雙手，把{name}和小米一起抱住。爸爸也擠過來，大家抱成一團。「抱得下嗎？」{name}問。「當然，」媽媽說，「再多人都抱得下。」{name}靠近小米，小聲說：「等你長大，我教你盪鞦韆喔。」小米咯咯笑了。
en: When baby Mimi came home, the house got busy. Grandma rushed in and said, "Mimi is so cute!" Mom held Mimi and hummed softly. {name} ran over with a new rainbow drawing. "Look!" But everyone was looking at Mimi. {name} felt invisible.

{name} went back to the bedroom and hugged a teddy bear. Inside, everything felt tight and sour. "Why does everyone only look at the baby?" {name} whispered. Teddy did not answer. It felt like a little thorn poking inside.

At story time, Dad came in. {name} held his hand. "Dad, everyone only looks at Mimi. I don't like it." Dad pulled {name} into a big hug. "Thank you for telling me. It's okay to feel that way." Then he smiled. "How about Saturday walks in the park? Just us two."

On Saturday morning, the sun felt warm. {name} held Dad's hand as they walked into the park. "This is our special time," Dad said. They picked up red leaves to find the biggest one. Pigeons cooed and bobbed their heads. Dad taught {name} a walking song.

At the swings, {name} said, "When Mimi grows up, I'll teach her to swing!" But {name} was still learning too. Kicking wildly, the swing barely moved. "Legs out, then tuck them back," said Dad. {name} tried again and again. Up, up went the swing!

"I'll teach Mimi to find ladybugs too!" {name} searched the grass very carefully. At last, a tiny red ladybug crawled out. Dad took out a small notebook and wrote, "Things to Teach Mimi." Swinging. Ladybugs. Every Saturday, the list grew longer.

One afternoon, Mimi cried and cried. Mom rocked her, but nothing worked. {name} went to the cradle and softly sang the walking song. Slowly, Mimi stopped crying. She blinked and grabbed {name}'s finger. Mom smiled. "She loves it when you sing."

Mom opened her arms wide and hugged {name} and Mimi together. Dad squeezed in too. "Is there room for everyone?" {name} asked. "Always," said Mom. "There's always room." {name} leaned close to Mimi. "Someday I'll teach you to swing." Mimi giggled.

questions: {name}覺得大家只看妹妹的時候，{he}做了什麼？
如果你心裡也有酸酸悶悶的感覺，你會想告訴誰？
{name}想教小米很多事，你想教家裡的小寶寶什麼呢？
zh.tip: 這個星期安排一段只屬於你和孩子的「專屬時間」，哪怕只有十五分鐘，並一起寫一張「我可以教寶寶的清單」。

questions: What did {name} do when everyone only looked at the baby?
If you had a tight, sour feeling inside, who would you tell?
{name} wanted to teach Mimi many things. What would you like to teach a baby?
en.tip: This week, set aside a special just-us time with your child, even fifteen minutes, and make a "Things I Can Teach the Baby" list together.
